```tsx
// app/study-session/_components/SoundPicker.tsx
'use client';

import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  SOUND_CATEGORY_META,
  getAvailableCategories,
  soundsByCategory,
  type SoundCategory,
} from '@/lib/study-sounds';

interface SoundPickerProps {
  selectedId: string | null;
  /** الصوت الذي يجري تحميله حالياً — null إن لم يكن هناك تحميل */
  loadingId?: string | null;
  onSelect: (id: string | null) => void;
  volume: number;
  onVolumeChange: (v: number) => void;
}

export function SoundPicker({
  selectedId,
  loadingId = null,
  onSelect,
  volume,
  onVolumeChange,
}: SoundPickerProps) {
  const categories = useMemo(() => getAvailableCategories(), []);
  const [activeCat, setActiveCat] = useState<SoundCategory>(
    categories[0] ?? 'ambient',
  );

  const sounds = useMemo(() => soundsByCategory(activeCat), [activeCat]);

  return (
    <div className="space-y-3">
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between">
        <h2 className="flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-ink">
          <span aria-hidden="true">🎵</span>
          صوت الخلفية
        </h2>
        {selectedId && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onSelect(null)}
            className="rounded-field px-2 py-1 text-xs font-semibold text-coral-ink transition-colors hover:bg-coral/10"
          >
            ⏹ إيقاف
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      {/* Tabs للفئات */}
      {categories.length > 1 && (
        <div
          role="tablist"
          className="scrollbar-none -mx-1 flex gap-1 overflow-x-auto px-1"
        >
          {categories.map((cat) => {
            const meta = SOUND_CATEGORY_META[cat];
            const active = activeCat === cat;
            return (
              <button
                key={cat}
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={active}
                type="button"
                onClick={() => setActiveCat(cat)}
                className={`flex flex-shrink-0 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-chip px-3 py-1.5 text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none ${
                  active
                    ? 'bg-teal text-on-teal'
                    : 'bg-paper-deep text-ink-soft hover:bg-teal-tint hover:text-teal'
                }`}
              >
                <span aria-hidden="true">{meta.emoji}</span>
                <span className="whitespace-nowrap">{meta.label}</span>
              </button>
            );
          })}
        </div>
      )}

      {/* أصوات الفئة */}
      <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2 sm:grid-cols-4">
        {sounds.map((sound) => {
          const active = selectedId === sound.id;
          const loading = loadingId === sound.id;
          return (
            <button
              key={sound.id}
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onSelect(active ? null : sound.id)}
              disabled={loading}
              aria-pressed={active}
              aria-label={`${sound.label}${
                active ? ' — يعمل الآن' : loading ? ' — جاري التحميل' : ''
              }`}
              className={`relative flex flex-col items-center gap-1 rounded-field border px-1.5 py-3 text-[11px] font-bold transition-all duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none disabled:cursor-progress ${
                active
                  ? 'border-teal bg-teal-tint text-teal'
                  : loading
                    ? 'border-gold bg-gold-tint text-gold-ink'
                    : 'border-line bg-paper-soft text-ink-soft hover:border-teal/40 hover:bg-teal-tint/40'
              }`}
            >
              {/* مؤشر نشط / تحميل */}
              {(active || loading) && (
                <span
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className={`absolute end-1.5 top-1.5 h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full motion-reduce:animate-none ${
                    loading ? 'animate-pulse bg-gold' : 'animate-pulse bg-teal'
                  }`}
                />
              )}

              <span className="text-2xl leading-none" aria-hidden="true">
                {loading ? (
                  <svg
                    className="h-6 w-6 animate-spin text-gold-ink motion-reduce:animate-none"
                    viewBox="0 0 24 24"
                    fill="none"
                  >
                    <circle
                      cx="12"
                      cy="12"
                      r="10"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth="3"
                      opacity="0.25"
                    />
                    <path
                      d="M22 12a10 10 0 0 1-10 10"
                      stroke="currentColor"
                      strokeWidth="3"
                      strokeLinecap="round"
                    />
                  </svg>
                ) : (
                  sound.emoji
                )}
              </span>
              <span className="truncate text-center leading-tight">
                {loading ? 'جاري...' : sound.label}
              </span>
            </button>
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* تلميح للملفات الكبيرة */}
      {loadingId && (
        <p
          role="status"
          aria-live="polite"
          className="flex items-center gap-2 rounded-field border border-gold/30 bg-gold-tint/50 px-3 py-2 text-[11px] font-semibold text-gold-ink"
        >
          <span
            aria-hidden="true"
            className="h-1.5 w-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-gold-ink motion-reduce:animate-none"
          />
          الملف قيد التحميل — قد يستغرق بعض الوقت للملفات الكبيرة.
        </p>
      )}

      {/* مستوى الصوت */}
      {selectedId && (
        <div className="space-y-2 border-t border-line-soft pt-3">
          <label
            htmlFor="sound-volume"
            className="flex items-center justify-between text-xs font-bold text-ink-muted"
          >
            <span>مستوى الصوت</span>
            <span className="num-inline font-mono">
              {Math.round(volume * 100)}%
            </span>
          </label>
          <input
            id="sound-volume"
            type="range"
            min="0"
            max="1"
            step="0.05"
            value={volume}
            onChange={(e) => onVolumeChange(parseFloat(e.target.value))}
            dir="ltr"
            className="w-full accent-teal"
          />
        </div>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/study-session/_components/TimerRing.tsx
'use client';

interface TimerRingProps {
  /** 0 إلى 1 — تقدم الوقت المنقضي */
  progress: number;
  remainingSeconds: number;
  phase: 'study' | 'break';
  status: 'idle' | 'running' | 'paused';
  sessionIndex: number;
  totalSessions: number;
  /** توقيت انتهاء المرحلة الحالية (ms) — null عند عدم التشغيل */
  endsAt: number | null;
  /** آخر دقيقة */
  warning: boolean;
  /** اكتملت كل الجلسات للتو */
  celebrate: boolean;
}

// ==================== Geometry ====================
const SIZE = 300;
const C = SIZE / 2;
const ARC_R = 116;
const ARC_STROKE = 5;
const CIRCUMFERENCE = 2 * Math.PI * ARC_R;
const TICK_COUNT = 60;

interface Tick {
  x1: string;
  y1: string;
  x2: string;
  y2: string;
  major: boolean;
}

// تُحسب مرة واحدة — toFixed لضمان تطابق الخادم والعميل
const TICKS: readonly Tick[] = Array.from({ length: TICK_COUNT }, (_, i) => {
  const a = (i / TICK_COUNT) * 2 * Math.PI;
  const major = i % 5 === 0;
  const r1 = major ? 129 : 135;
  const r2 = 143;
  return {
    x1: (C + r1 * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2),
    y1: (C + r1 * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2),
    x2: (C + r2 * Math.cos(a)).toFixed(2),
    y2: (C + r2 * Math.sin(a)).toFixed(2),
    major,
  };
});

function pad(n: number): string {
  return String(n).padStart(2, '0');
}

function clockParts(ts: number): { time: string; period: string } {
  const d = new Date(ts);
  const h = d.getHours();
  return {
    time: `${h % 12 || 12}:${pad(d.getMinutes())}`,
    period: h >= 12 ? 'م' : 'ص',
  };
}

export function TimerRing({
  progress,
  remainingSeconds,
  phase,
  status,
  sessionIndex,
  totalSessions,
  endsAt,
  warning,
  celebrate,
}: TimerRingProps) {
  const clamped = Math.min(1, Math.max(0, progress));
  const dashOffset = CIRCUMFERENCE * (1 - clamped);
  const litTicks = Math.floor(clamped * TICK_COUNT);

  const minutes = Math.floor(remainingSeconds / 60);
  const seconds = remainingSeconds % 60;

  const isStudy = phase === 'study';
  const isRunning = status === 'running';
  const breathing = !isStudy && isRunning;
  const ringColor = isStudy || celebrate ? 'var(--teal)' : 'var(--gold)';

  // الانتقال الناعم فقط أثناء التشغيل — حتى لا يدور المؤشر للخلف عند الإعادة
  const smooth = isRunning
    ? 'stroke-dashoffset 400ms linear, stroke 300ms ease'
    : 'stroke 300ms ease';

  const statusText = celebrate
    ? '✓ اكتملت جلساتك'
    : status === 'idle'
      ? 'جاهز للبدء'
      : status === 'paused'
        ? 'متوقف مؤقتاً'
        : isStudy
          ? '🎯 وقت التركيز'
          : '☕ وقت الراحة';

  // أثناء الراحة: الجلسة المنتهية هي sessionIndex (وليس التالية)
  const currentSession = Math.min(
    isStudy ? sessionIndex + 1 : sessionIndex,
    totalSessions,
  );
  const end = endsAt !== null ? clockParts(endsAt) : null;

  return (
    <div className="flex flex-col items-center gap-5">
      {/* مؤشر الجلسات */}
      <div
        className="flex items-center gap-1.5"
        role="img"
        aria-label={`الجلسة ${currentSession} من ${totalSessions}`}
      >
        {Array.from({ length: totalSessions }).map((_, i) => {
          const done = celebrate || i < sessionIndex;
          const current = !celebrate && isStudy && i === sessionIndex && status !== 'idle';
          return (
            <span
              key={i}
              aria-hidden="true"
              className={`h-2 w-2 rounded-full transition-all duration-300 motion-reduce:transition-none ${
                done
                  ? 'bg-teal'
                  : current
                    ? 'bg-teal/60 ring-2 ring-teal/30'
                    : 'bg-line'
              }`}
            />
          );
        })}
      </div>

      {/* الدائرة */}
      <div
        className={`relative aspect-square w-full max-w-[320px] ${
          breathing ? 'ring-breathe' : ''
        }`}
      >
        <svg
          viewBox={`0 0 ${SIZE} ${SIZE}`}
          className="absolute inset-0 h-full w-full -rotate-90"
          aria-hidden="true"
        >
          {/* هالة التنبيه — آخر دقيقة */}
          {warning && (
            <circle
              cx={C}
              cy={C}
              r={148}
              fill="none"
              stroke={ringColor}
              strokeWidth={1.5}
              className="ring-warn"
            />
          )}

          {/* هالة الاحتفال */}
          {celebrate && (
            <circle
              cx={C}
              cy={C}
              r={124}
              fill="none"
              stroke="var(--gold)"
              strokeWidth={1}
              className="ring-bloom"
              style={{ transformOrigin: 'center' }}
            />
          )}

          {/* علامات المينا — تضيء مع التقدم */}
          {TICKS.map((t, i) => (
            <line
              key={i}
              x1={t.x1}
              y1={t.y1}
              x2={t.x2}
              y2={t.y2}
              stroke={i < litTicks ? ringColor : 'var(--line-strong)'}
              strokeWidth={t.major ? 1.8 : 1}
              strokeLinecap="round"
              opacity={i < litTicks ? 1 : t.major ? 0.9 : 0.55}
              style={{ transition: 'stroke 300ms ease, opacity 300ms ease' }}
            />
          ))}

          {/* خط داخلي رفيع */}
          <circle
            cx={C}
            cy={C}
            r={103}
            fill="none"
            stroke="var(--line-soft)"
            strokeWidth={1}
          />

          {/* المسار */}
          <circle
            cx={C}
            cy={C}
            r={ARC_R}
            fill="none"
            stroke="var(--line)"
            strokeWidth={ARC_STROKE}
          />

          {/* القوس */}
          <circle
            cx={C}
            cy={C}
            r={ARC_R}
            fill="none"
            stroke={ringColor}
            strokeWidth={ARC_STROKE}
            strokeLinecap="round"
            strokeDasharray={CIRCUMFERENCE}
            strokeDashoffset={dashOffset}
            style={{ transition: smooth }}
          />

          {/* رأس يتحرك على القوس */}
          <g
            style={{
              transform: `rotate(${clamped * 360}deg)`,
              transformOrigin: `${C}px ${C}px`,
              transition: isRunning ? 'transform 400ms linear' : 'none',
            }}
          >
            <circle
              cx={C + ARC_R}
              cy={C}
              r={7}
              fill="var(--paper-soft)"
              stroke={ringColor}
              strokeWidth={2.5}
              style={{ transition: 'stroke 300ms ease' }}
            />
          </g>
        </svg>

        {/* المحتوى المركزي */}
        <div className="absolute inset-0 flex flex-col items-center justify-center gap-1.5">
          <p className="text-xs font-bold tracking-wide text-ink-muted">
            {statusText}
          </p>
          <p
            role="timer"
            dir="ltr"
            aria-label={`${minutes} دقيقة و ${seconds} ثانية`}
            className="font-mono text-5xl font-medium leading-none text-ink sm:text-6xl"
            style={{ fontVariantNumeric: 'tabular-nums' }}
          >
            {pad(minutes)}
            <span className={isRunning ? 'ring-colon' : ''}>:</span>
            {pad(seconds)}
          </p>
          <p className="text-[11px] text-ink-muted">
            الجلسة{' '}
            <span className="num-inline font-mono">{currentSession}</span> من{' '}
            <span className="num-inline font-mono">{totalSessions}</span>
          </p>
          <p className="h-4 text-[11px] text-ink-muted">
            {end && (
              <>
                تنتهي الساعة{' '}
                <span className="num-inline font-mono">{end.time}</span>{' '}
                {end.period}
              </>
            )}
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// app/study-session/page.tsx
'use client';

import Link from 'next/link';
import {
  useCallback,
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type CSSProperties,
} from 'react';
import { useTheme } from '@/components/ThemeProvider';
import { useToast } from '@/components/ui/Toast';
import { Button } from '@/components/ui/Button';
import { TimerRing } from './_components/TimerRing';
import { SoundPicker } from './_components/SoundPicker';
import { HealthTab } from './_components/HealthTab';
import { ALERT_SOUND, findSound } from '@/lib/study-sounds';
import { recordFocusSession, getTodayStr } from '@/hooks/useRecentViews';
import {
  IconArrowLeft,
  IconClose,
  IconExpand,
  IconHealth,
  IconPlay,
  IconSun,
  IconMoon,
} from '@/components/ui/Icons';

// ==================== Constants ====================
const CONFIG_KEY = 'lawazem_focus_config_v1';
const TODAY_KEY = 'lawazem_focus_today_v1';

interface Preset {
  id: string;
  label: string;
  hint: string;
  study: number;
  breakMin: number;
  sessions: number;
}

const PRESETS: readonly Preset[] = [
  { id: 'classic', label: '25 / 5', hint: 'كلاسيكي', study: 25, breakMin: 5, sessions: 4 },
  { id: 'long', label: '50 / 10', hint: 'مطوّل', study: 50, breakMin: 10, sessions: 3 },
  { id: 'deep', label: '90 / 15', hint: 'عميق', study: 90, breakMin: 15, sessions: 2 },
] as const;

const TIPS: readonly string[] = [
  'ضع هاتفك بعيداً عن متناول يدك — ربع ساعة بلا إشعارات تصنع فرقاً.',
  'اكتب هدف الجلسة قبل أن تبدأ؛ الهدف الواضح يختصر نصف الطريق.',
  'في الراحة قم وتمدّد واشرب ماءً — ولا تنتقل إلى شاشة أخرى.',
  'المراجعة الموزّعة أنفع من الحشو الليلي — كرّر قليلاً كل يوم.',
  'ابدأ بالمادة الأصعب في وقت ذروتك، واترك الأخف لنهاية اليوم.',
];

type Status = 'idle' | 'running' | 'paused';
type Phase = 'study' | 'break';
type Tab = 'timer' | 'health';

// ==================== Helpers ====================
function clampInt(v: number, min: number, max: number): number {
  return Math.min(max, Math.max(min, Math.round(v)));
}

function fmtTitle(sec: number): string {
  const m = Math.floor(sec / 60);
  const s = sec % 60;
  return `${String(m).padStart(2, '0')}:${String(s).padStart(2, '0')}`;
}

function readToday(): number {
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(TODAY_KEY);
    if (!raw) return 0;
    const p = JSON.parse(raw) as { d?: unknown; n?: unknown };
    return p.d === getTodayStr() && typeof p.n === 'number' ? p.n : 0;
  } catch {
    return 0;
  }
}

function writeToday(n: number): void {
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(TODAY_KEY, JSON.stringify({ d: getTodayStr(), n }));
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

// ==================== Inline Icons ====================
function IconPause() {
  return (
    <svg className="h-4 w-4" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="currentColor" aria-hidden="true">
      <rect x="6" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1" />
      <rect x="14" y="5" width="4" height="14" rx="1" />
    </svg>
  );
}
function IconRestart() {
  return (
    <svg
      className="h-4 w-4"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={2.2}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <path d="M21 12a9 9 0 1 1-3-6.7" />
      <path d="M21 4v5h-5" />
    </svg>
  );
}
function IconTimer() {
  return (
    <svg className="h-4 w-4" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2} aria-hidden="true">
      <circle cx="12" cy="13" r="8" />
      <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 9v4l3 2M9 2h6" />
    </svg>
  );
}

function Kbd({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) {
  return (
    <kbd className="rounded-[4px] border border-line bg-paper-deep px-1.5 py-0.5 font-mono text-[10px] text-ink-soft">
      {children}
    </kbd>
  );
}

// ==================== Sound Loading Timeout (ms) ====================
const SOUND_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS = 45_000; // 45 ثانية للملفات الكبيرة جداً

// ==================== Page ====================
export default function StudySessionPage() {
  const toast = useToast();
  const { theme, toggleTheme } = useTheme();

  const [tab, setTab] = useState<Tab>('timer');
  const [focusMode, setFocusMode] = useState(false);

  // Config
  const [studyMin, setStudyMin] = useState(25);
  const [breakMin, setBreakMin] = useState(5);
  const [totalSessions, setTotalSessions] = useState(4);
  const [task, setTask] = useState('');
  const [hydrated, setHydrated] = useState(false);

  // Runtime
  const [status, setStatus] = useState<Status>('idle');
  const [phase, setPhase] = useState<Phase>('study');
  const [sessionIndex, setSessionIndex] = useState(0);
  const [remaining, setRemaining] = useState(25 * 60);
  const [deadline, setDeadline] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [celebrate, setCelebrate] = useState(false);

  // Today / tips
  const [todayCount, setTodayCount] = useState(0);
  const [tipIdx, setTipIdx] = useState(0);

  // Audio
  const ambientAudioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const alertAudioRef = useRef<HTMLAudioElement | null>(null);
  const [selectedSound, setSelectedSound] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [soundLoading, setSoundLoading] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [volume, setVolume] = useState(0.5);

  // Refs للتحكم بالمؤقّتات والـhandlers
  const soundLoadTimeoutRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);
  const soundCleanupRef = useRef<(() => void) | null>(null);

  // ===== Hydrate config =====
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem(CONFIG_KEY);
      if (raw) {
        const c = JSON.parse(raw) as Partial<{
          studyMin: number;
          breakMin: number;
          totalSessions: number;
          task: string;
        }>;
        if (typeof c.studyMin === 'number') setStudyMin(clampInt(c.studyMin, 1, 180));
        if (typeof c.breakMin === 'number') setBreakMin(clampInt(c.breakMin, 1, 60));
        if (typeof c.totalSessions === 'number') setTotalSessions(clampInt(c.totalSessions, 1, 10));
        if (typeof c.task === 'string') setTask(c.task.slice(0, 80));
      }
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
    setTodayCount(readToday());
    const dayOfYear = Math.floor(Date.now() / 86_400_000);
    setTipIdx(dayOfYear % TIPS.length);
    setHydrated(true);
  }, []);

  // ===== Persist config =====
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!hydrated) return;
    try {
      localStorage.setItem(
        CONFIG_KEY,
        JSON.stringify({ studyMin, breakMin, totalSessions, task }),
      );
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }, [hydrated, studyMin, breakMin, totalSessions, task]);

  // ===== Sync remaining with studyMin when idle =====
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === 'idle') setRemaining(studyMin * 60);
  }, [studyMin, status]);

  // ===== Setup alert audio =====
  useEffect(() => {
    const audio = new Audio(ALERT_SOUND);
    audio.volume = 0.6;
    audio.preload = 'auto';
    alertAudioRef.current = audio;
    return () => {
      audio.pause();
      audio.src = '';
    };
  }, []);

  // ===== Cleanup sound on unmount =====
  useEffect(() => {
    return () => {
      if (soundLoadTimeoutRef.current) {
        clearTimeout(soundLoadTimeoutRef.current);
      }
      if (soundCleanupRef.current) {
        soundCleanupRef.current();
      }
    };
  }, []);

  // ===== Celebrate auto-clear =====
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!celebrate) return;
    const id = setTimeout(() => setCelebrate(false), 8000);
    return () => clearTimeout(id);
  }, [celebrate]);

  // ===== Document title =====
  const baseTitleRef = useRef('');
  useEffect(() => {
    baseTitleRef.current = document.title;
    return () => {
      document.title = baseTitleRef.current;
    };
  }, []);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status === 'running') {
      document.title = `${fmtTitle(remaining)} · ${phase === 'study' ? 'تركيز' : 'راحة'}`;
    } else {
      document.title = baseTitleRef.current;
    }
  }, [status, remaining, phase]);

  // ===== Wake Lock =====
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'running') return;
    if (typeof navigator === 'undefined' || !('wakeLock' in navigator)) return;

    let cancelled = false;
    const holder: { sentinel: WakeLockSentinel | null } = { sentinel: null };

    const acquire = async () => {
      try {
        const s = await navigator.wakeLock.request('screen');
        if (cancelled) {
          void s.release().catch(() => {});
          return;
        }
        holder.sentinel = s;
      } catch {
        /* غير مدعوم أو مرفوض */
      }
    };

    const onVisibility = () => {
      if (
        document.visibilityState === 'visible' &&
        (!holder.sentinel || holder.sentinel.released)
      ) {
        void acquire();
      }
    };

    void acquire();
    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibility);
      void holder.sentinel?.release().catch(() => {});
    };
  }, [status]);

  // ===== Phase transition handler =====
  const handlePhaseComplete = useCallback(() => {
    const alert = alertAudioRef.current;
    if (alert) {
      alert.currentTime = 0;
      void alert.play().catch(() => {});
    }

    if (phase === 'study') {
      recordFocusSession(studyMin);
      const n = readToday() + 1;
      writeToday(n);
      setTodayCount(n);

      const nextIndex = sessionIndex + 1;
      if (nextIndex >= totalSessions) {
        setStatus('idle');
        setPhase('study');
        setSessionIndex(0);
        setRemaining(studyMin * 60);
        setDeadline(null);
        setCelebrate(true);
        toast.show(
          `🎉 أنجزت ${totalSessions} جلسات = ${totalSessions * studyMin} دقيقة!`,
          'success',
        );
        return;
      }
      setPhase('break');
      setSessionIndex(nextIndex);
      setRemaining(breakMin * 60);
      setDeadline(Date.now() + breakMin * 60 * 1000);
      toast.show(`☕ راحة ${breakMin} دقائق`, 'info');
    } else {
      setPhase('study');
      setRemaining(studyMin * 60);
      setDeadline(Date.now() + studyMin * 60 * 1000);
      toast.show(`🎯 لنبدأ الجلسة ${sessionIndex + 1}`, 'info');
    }
  }, [phase, sessionIndex, totalSessions, studyMin, breakMin, toast]);

  const handlerRef = useRef(handlePhaseComplete);
  useEffect(() => {
    handlerRef.current = handlePhaseComplete;
  }, [handlePhaseComplete]);

  // ===== Timer interval =====
  useEffect(() => {
    if (status !== 'running' || deadline === null) return;
    let cancelled = false;
    const id = setInterval(() => {
      if (cancelled) return;
      const rem = Math.max(0, Math.ceil((deadline - Date.now()) / 1000));
      if (rem <= 0) {
        cancelled = true;
        clearInterval(id);
        handlerRef.current();
        return;
      }
      setRemaining(rem);
    }, 250);
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
      clearInterval(id);
    };
  }, [status, deadline]);

  // ===== Controls =====
  const handleStart = useCallback(() => {
    const alert = alertAudioRef.current;
    if (alert) {
      const v = alert.volume;
      alert.volume = 0;
      void alert
        .play()
        .then(() => {
          alert.pause();
          alert.currentTime = 0;
          alert.volume = v;
        })
        .catch(() => {
          alert.volume = v;
        });
    }

    setCelebrate(false);

    if (status === 'idle') {
      setPhase('study');
      setSessionIndex(0);
      setRemaining(studyMin * 60);
      setDeadline(Date.now() + studyMin * 60 * 1000);
      setStatus('running');
    } else if (status === 'paused') {
      setDeadline(Date.now() + remaining * 1000);
      setStatus('running');
    }
  }, [status, studyMin, remaining]);

  const handlePause = useCallback(() => {
    if (status !== 'running') return;
    setStatus('paused');
    setDeadline(null);
  }, [status]);

  const handleReset = useCallback(() => {
    setStatus('idle');
    setPhase('study');
    setSessionIndex(0);
    setRemaining(studyMin * 60);
    setDeadline(null);
    setCelebrate(false);
  }, [studyMin]);

  const handleToggle = useCallback(() => {
    if (status === 'running') handlePause();
    else handleStart();
  }, [status, handlePause, handleStart]);

  // ===== Keyboard shortcuts =====
  useEffect(() => {
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent) => {
      if (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey || e.altKey || e.repeat) return;
      const el = e.target as HTMLElement | null;
      const tag = el?.tagName;
      if (
        tag === 'INPUT' ||
        tag === 'TEXTAREA' ||
        tag === 'SELECT' ||
        el?.isContentEditable
      ) {
        return;
      }

      if (e.key === 'Escape' && focusMode) {
        setFocusMode(false);
        return;
      }
      if (tab !== 'timer') return;

      if (e.code === 'Space') {
        if (tag === 'BUTTON') return;
        e.preventDefault();
        handleToggle();
      } else if (e.code === 'KeyR') {
        if (status !== 'idle') handleReset();
      } else if (e.code === 'KeyF') {
        setFocusMode((v) => !v);
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [tab, focusMode, status, handleToggle, handleReset]);

  // ========================================================================
  // 🔊 Sound Handling (مع دعم الملفات الكبيرة)
  // ========================================================================
  /**
   * يوقف أي تحميل جاري، ويلغي المؤقّتات والـlisteners.
   * يُستدعى قبل تشغيل صوت جديد، أو عند unmount.
   */
  const clearSoundLoad = useCallback(() => {
    if (soundLoadTimeoutRef.current) {
      clearTimeout(soundLoadTimeoutRef.current);
      soundLoadTimeoutRef.current = null;
    }
    if (soundCleanupRef.current) {
      soundCleanupRef.current();
      soundCleanupRef.current = null;
    }
  }, []);

  /**
   * يعطي وصفاً مقروءاً لكود الخطأ في HTMLAudioElement.
   */
  const describeMediaError = useCallback((err: MediaError | null): string => {
    if (!err) return 'تعذّر تشغيل الصوت';
    switch (err.code) {
      case 1:
        return 'تم إلغاء التحميل';
      case 2:
        return 'خطأ في الشبكة — تحقق من اتصالك';
      case 3:
        return 'الملف تالف أو ناقص';
      case 4:
        return 'صيغة الملف غير مدعومة في متصفحك';
      default:
        return 'تعذّر تشغيل الصوت';
    }
  }, []);

  const handleSoundSelect = useCallback(
    (id: string | null) => {
      const audio = ambientAudioRef.current;
      if (!audio) return;

      // أوقف أي صوت حالي + امسح أي تحميل معلّق
      clearSoundLoad();
      audio.pause();
      audio.removeAttribute('src');
      audio.load();

      // إلغاء الاختيار
      if (id === null || id === selectedSound) {
        setSelectedSound(null);
        setSoundLoading(null);
        return;
      }

      const sound = findSound(id);
      if (!sound) return;

      // ضع الصوت في حالة تحميل
      setSoundLoading(id);

      // ═══ معالجات الأحداث ═══
      const handleError = () => {
        const msg = describeMediaError(audio.error);
        console.error('[sound] error:', audio.error, sound.source);
        toast.show(`${msg}: ${sound.label}`, 'error');
        clearSoundLoad();
        audio.removeAttribute('src');
        audio.load();
        setSelectedSound(null);
        setSoundLoading(null);
      };

      const handleCanPlay = () => {
        // الصوت جاهز للتشغيل — شغّله
        clearSoundLoad();
        audio.loop = sound.loop;
        audio.volume = volume;
        void audio
          .play()
          .then(() => {
            setSelectedSound(id);
            setSoundLoading(null);
          })
          .catch((playErr: unknown) => {
            console.error('[sound] play failed:', playErr, sound.source);
            const msg =
              playErr instanceof DOMException && playErr.name === 'NotAllowedError'
                ? 'المتصفح منع التشغيل — اضغط على الصفحة أولاً ثم أعد المحاولة'
                : 'تعذّر تشغيل الصوت';
            toast.show(msg, 'error');
            setSelectedSound(null);
            setSoundLoading(null);
          });
      };

      audio.addEventListener('error', handleError);
      audio.addEventListener('canplay', handleCanPlay);

      // خزّن دالة التنظيف
      soundCleanupRef.current = () => {
        audio.removeEventListener('error', handleError);
        audio.removeEventListener('canplay', handleCanPlay);
      };

      // ═══ ابدأ التحميل ═══
      audio.preload = 'auto';
      audio.src = sound.source;
      audio.load();

      // ═══ Timeout احتياطي للملفات الضخمة ═══
      soundLoadTimeoutRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
        // إذا الصوت بدأ يشتغل، تجاهل
        if (!audio.paused && audio.readyState >= 2) return;
        console.error('[sound] load timeout:', sound.source);
        toast.show(
          `انتهت مهلة التحميل لـ«${sound.label}» — الملف ضخم، جرّب مرة ثانية`,
          'error',
        );
        clearSoundLoad();
        audio.pause();
        audio.removeAttribute('src');
        audio.load();
        setSelectedSound(null);
        setSoundLoading(null);
      }, SOUND_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS);
    },
    [selectedSound, volume, toast, clearSoundLoad, describeMediaError],
  );

  const handleVolumeChange = useCallback((v: number) => {
    setVolume(v);
    if (ambientAudioRef.current) {
      ambientAudioRef.current.volume = v;
    }
  }, []);

  // ===== Derived =====
  const activePreset =
    PRESETS.find(
      (p) =>
        p.study === studyMin &&
        p.breakMin === breakMin &&
        p.sessions === totalSessions,
    )?.id ?? null;

  const totalForPhase = phase === 'study' ? studyMin * 60 : breakMin * 60;
  const progress = totalForPhase > 0 ? 1 - remaining / totalForPhase : 0;
  const isBreakActive = phase === 'break' && status !== 'idle';
  const warning = status === 'running' && remaining <= 60 && remaining > 0;

  const emptyMessage =
    todayCount === 0
      ? 'لسا ما بدأت اليوم — جلسة واحدة تكفي لتفتح الطريق.'
      : `أنجزت ${todayCount} ${todayCount === 1 ? 'جلسة' : 'جلسات'} اليوم — استمر بهذا الإيقاع.`;

  const shellClass = focusMode
    ? 'campus-paper fixed inset-0 z-[60] overflow-y-auto'
    : 'campus-paper relative min-h-[calc(100dvh-var(--nav-h))] pb-24 md:pb-10';

  return (
    <main className={shellClass}>
      {/* ظلّ الراحة */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-0 transition-opacity duration-[1600ms] motion-reduce:transition-none"
        style={{
          opacity: isBreakActive ? 1 : 0,
          background:
            'radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 55% at 50% 35%, color-mix(in srgb, var(--gold) 9%, transparent), transparent 75%)',
        }}
      />

      {/* خروج من الوضع الغامر */}
      {focusMode && (
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setFocusMode(false)}
          aria-label="الخروج من الوضع الغامر"
          className="fixed end-4 top-4 z-[70] flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-field border border-line bg-paper-soft text-ink-soft transition-colors hover:border-teal/40 hover:text-teal focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-teal"
        >
          <IconClose aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />
        </button>
      )}

      <div
        className={`relative mx-auto max-w-5xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6 sm:py-10 ${
          focusMode ? 'flex min-h-full flex-col justify-center' : ''
        }`}
      >
        {!focusMode && (
          <>
            {/* Header */}
            <header className="flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
              <Link
                href="/"
                className="group inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-field text-sm font-semibold text-teal transition-colors hover:text-teal-hover motion-reduce:transition-none"
              >
                <span className="transition-transform duration-200 group-hover:-translate-x-1 motion-reduce:transition-none motion-reduce:group-hover:translate-x-0">
                  <IconArrowLeft aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />
                </span>
                رجوع إلى لوحة الأقسام
              </Link>

              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={toggleTheme}
                aria-label={theme === 'dark' ? 'الوضع النهاري' : 'الوضع الليلي'}
                className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-field border border-line bg-paper-soft text-ink-soft transition-colors hover:border-teal/40 hover:text-teal focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-teal"
              >
                {theme === 'dark' ? (
                  <IconSun aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />
                ) : (
                  <IconMoon aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />
                )}
              </button>
            </header>

            {/* Title */}
            <div className="mt-6 animate-slide-up motion-reduce:animate-none">
              <span className="stage-badge">مساحة التركيز</span>
              <h1 className="mt-3 font-display text-3xl font-bold leading-tight text-ink sm:text-4xl">
                جلسة دراسة
              </h1>
              <p className="mt-2 max-w-xl text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-soft">
                نظّم وقتك بجلسات تركيز وراحة. اختر صوت خلفية هادئ، وتابع تقدمك في
                صحتك الدراسية.
              </p>
            </div>

            {/* Tabs */}
            <div
              role="tablist"
              aria-label="أقسام جلسة الدراسة"
              className="mt-6 flex gap-1.5 rounded-2xl border border-line bg-white/60 p-1.5 backdrop-blur-sm dark:bg-white/[0.04] animate-slide-up motion-reduce:animate-none"
            >
              <button
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={tab === 'timer'}
                onClick={() => setTab('timer')}
                className={`flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold transition-all duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none ${
                  tab === 'timer'
                    ? 'bg-teal text-white shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(14,74,74,0.24)] dark:shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.30)]'
                    : 'text-ink/60 hover:bg-ink/5 hover:text-ink'
                }`}
              >
                <IconTimer />
                <span>المؤقت</span>
                {status === 'running' && (
                  <span
                    aria-hidden="true"
                    className="h-1.5 w-1.5 animate-pulse rounded-full bg-current motion-reduce:animate-none"
                  />
                )}
              </button>
              <button
                role="tab"
                aria-selected={tab === 'health'}
                onClick={() => setTab('health')}
                className={`flex flex-1 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-xl px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-bold transition-all duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none ${
                  tab === 'health'
                    ? 'bg-teal text-white shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(14,74,74,0.24)] dark:shadow-[0_2px_8px_rgba(0,0,0,0.30)]'
                    : 'text-ink/60 hover:bg-ink/5 hover:text-ink'
                }`}
              >
                <IconHealth aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />
                <span>صحتك الدراسية</span>
              </button>
            </div>
          </>
        )}

        {/* Tab Content */}
        <div className={focusMode ? '' : 'mt-6'}>
          {/* ─── Timer Tab ─── */}
          <div hidden={tab !== 'timer'}>
            <div
              className={`grid gap-6 ${
                focusMode ? 'mx-auto w-full max-w-xl' : 'lg:grid-cols-[1fr_320px]'
              }`}
            >
              <section
                className={
                  focusMode
                    ? 'p-2 sm:p-4'
                    : 'card-editorial paper-texture ink-reveal p-5 sm:p-8'
                }
                style={{ '--i': 0 } as CSSProperties}
              >
                {/* شريط علوي */}
                {!focusMode && (
                  <div className="mb-5 flex items-center justify-between gap-3">
                    <span className="badge badge-teal">
                      <span aria-hidden="true">🎯</span>
                      اليوم:
                      <span className="num-inline font-mono font-bold">
                        {todayCount}
                      </span>
                      {todayCount === 1 ? 'جلسة' : 'جلسات'}
                    </span>
                    <button
                      type="button"
                      onClick={() => setFocusMode(true)}
                      aria-label="الوضع الغامر"
                      title="الوضع الغامر (F)"
                      className="inline-flex h-9 items-center gap-1.5 rounded-field border border-line bg-paper-soft px-3 text-xs font-bold text-ink-soft transition-colors hover:border-teal/40 hover:text-teal focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-teal"
                    >
                      <IconExpand aria-hidden="true" className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
                      <span>وضع غامر</span>
                    </button>
                  </div>
                )}

                {/* مهمة الجلسة */}
                {focusMode ? (
                  task.trim() && (
                    <p className="margin-mark mx-auto mb-4 max-w-sm text-center text-sm font-semibold text-ink-soft">
                      {task}
                    </p>
                  )
                ) : (
                  <div className="mb-6">
                    <label htmlFor="session-task" className="sr-only">
                      مهمة الجلسة
                    </label>
                    <input
                      id="session-task"
                      type="text"
                      value={task}
                      maxLength={80}
                      onChange={(e) => setTask(e.target.value)}
                      placeholder="ماذا ستدرس الآن؟ مثال: فسلجة — المحاضرة 3"
                      className="field-editorial text-center"
                    />
                  </div>
                )}

                <TimerRing
                  progress={celebrate ? 1 : progress}
                  remainingSeconds={remaining}
                  phase={phase}
                  status={status}
                  sessionIndex={sessionIndex}
                  totalSessions={totalSessions}
                  endsAt={status === 'running' ? deadline : null}
                  warning={warning}
                  celebrate={celebrate}
                />

                {/* رسالة دافئة */}
                {status === 'idle' && !celebrate && (
                  <div className="mx-auto mt-6 max-w-sm text-center">
                    <p className="text-sm font-semibold text-ink-soft">
                      {emptyMessage}
                    </p>
                    <p className="mt-1.5 text-xs leading-relaxed text-ink-muted">
                      {TIPS[tipIdx]}
                    </p>
                  </div>
                )}

                <div className="mt-8 flex flex-col gap-2 sm:flex-row sm:justify-center">
                  {status !== 'running' ? (
                    <Button
                      size="lg"
                      onClick={handleStart}
                      className="w-full sm:w-auto sm:min-w-44"
                      icon={<IconPlay aria-hidden="true" className="h-4 w-4" />}
                    >
                      {status === 'paused' ? 'متابعة' : 'بدء الجلسة'}
                    </Button>
                  ) : (
                    <Button
                      size="lg"
                      variant="secondary"
                      onClick={handlePause}
                      className="w-full sm:w-auto sm:min-w-44"
                      icon={<IconPause />}
                    >
                      إيقاف مؤقت
                    </Button>
                  )}
                  {status !== 'idle' && (
                    <Button
                      size="lg"
                      variant="ghost"
                      onClick={handleReset}
                      className="w-full sm:w-auto"
                      icon={<IconRestart />}
                    >
                      إعادة
                    </Button>
                  )}
                </div>

                {/* اختصارات */}
                <p className="mt-5 hidden items-center justify-center gap-3 text-[11px] text-ink-muted md:flex">
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Kbd>Space</Kbd> بدء / إيقاف
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Kbd>R</Kbd> إعادة
                  </span>
                  <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5">
                    <Kbd>F</Kbd> وضع غامر
                  </span>
                </p>
              </section>

              <aside className={focusMode ? 'hidden' : 'space-y-4'}>
                {/* Presets */}
                <div
                  className="card-editorial ink-reveal p-5"
                  style={{ '--i': 1 } as CSSProperties}
                >
                  <h2 className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2 text-sm font-bold text-ink">
                    <span aria-hidden="true">⏱️</span>
                    إعدادات الجلسة
                  </h2>

                  <div className="grid grid-cols-3 gap-2">
                    {PRESETS.map((p) => {
                      const active = activePreset === p.id;
                      return (
                        <button
                          key={p.id}
                          type="button"
                          onClick={() => {
                            setStudyMin(p.study);
                            setBreakMin(p.breakMin);
                            setTotalSessions(p.sessions);
                          }}
                          disabled={status === 'running'}
                          aria-pressed={active}
                          className={`rounded-field border px-2 py-3 text-center text-xs font-bold transition-all duration-200 motion-reduce:transition-none disabled:opacity-50 ${
                            active
                              ? 'border-teal bg-teal-tint text-teal'
                              : 'border-line bg-paper-soft text-ink-soft hover:border-teal/40'
                          }`}
                        >
                          <p className="num-inline font-mono text-sm leading-none">
                            {p.label}
                          </p>
                          <p className="mt-1 text-[10px] opacity-70">{p.hint}</p>
                        </button>
                      );
                    })}
                  </div>

                  <div className="mt-4 flex items-center justify-between gap-3 border-t border-line-soft pt-4">
                    <span className="text-xs font-bold text-ink-muted">
                      عدد الجلسات
                    </span>
                    <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setTotalSessions((s) => Math.max(1, s - 1))
                        }
                        disabled={status === 'running' || totalSessions <= 1}
                        aria-label="تقليل"
                        className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-field border border-line bg-paper-soft text-lg font-bold text-ink-soft transition-colors hover:border-teal/40 hover:text-teal disabled:opacity-40"
                      >
                        −
                      </button>
                      <span className="num-inline min-w-[2ch] text-center font-mono text-base font-bold text-ink">
                        {totalSessions}
                      </span>
                      <button
                        type="button"
                        onClick={() =>
                          setTotalSessions((s) => Math.min(10, s + 1))
                        }
                        disabled={status === 'running' || totalSessions >= 10}
                        aria-label="زيادة"
                        className="flex h-8 w-8 items-center justify-center rounded-field border border-line bg-paper-soft text-lg font-bold text-ink-soft transition-colors hover:border-teal/40 hover:text-teal disabled:opacity-40"
                      >
                        +
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                </div>

                {/* Sound */}
                <div
                  className="card-editorial ink-reveal p-5"
                  style={{ '--i': 2 } as CSSProperties}
                >
                  <SoundPicker
                    selectedId={selectedSound}
                    loadingId={soundLoading}
                    onSelect={handleSoundSelect}
                    volume={volume}
                    onVolumeChange={handleVolumeChange}
                  />
                </div>
              </aside>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* ─── Health Tab ─── */}
          <div hidden={tab !== 'health'}>
            <HealthTab onGoToTimer={() => setTab('timer')} />
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {/* Ambient audio element */}
      <audio ref={ambientAudioRef} preload="none" />
    </main>
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// components/anatomy/Atlas3D.tsx
/**
 * أطلس ثلاثي الأبعاد: الجمجمة والهيكل العظمي حتى الصدر، مع عضلات الوجه والرقبة.
 * النموذج: public/atlas/head-neck(.glb|-lite.glb) — BodyParts3D (DBCLS) وZ-Anatomy (انظر ATTRIBUTION.md).
 * الحالة العامة (التحديد، الاختبار، الفلاتر) في FaceAtlas؛ الرؤية والمقطع والشفافية محلية هنا.
 */
import { Canvas, useFrame, useThree, type ThreeEvent } from '@react-three/fiber';
import { Html, OrbitControls, useGLTF, useProgress } from '@react-three/drei';
import {
  Suspense, useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ComponentRef, type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import {
  Color, MathUtils, Plane, TOUCH, Vector3,
  type BufferGeometry, type Group, type Mesh, type MeshStandardMaterial, type Object3D, type Scene as ThreeScene,
} from 'three';

import { MUSCLE_BY_ID, type ZoomId } from '@/lib/anatomy-data';
import { DEPTH_LABEL, type Depth } from '@/lib/anatomy-layers';
import { MUSCLE_MESHES } from '@/lib/anatomy-meshes';
import type { Pose } from '@/lib/anatomy-pose';
import {
  ALL_CONTEXT_IDS, ALL_MUSCLE_GROUP_IDS, ALL_MUSCLE_IDS, DEFAULT_VISIBILITY, describePart, labelOfPart, partVisible,
  presetVisibility, type PartInfo, type PresetId, type Visibility,
} from './atlas3d-model';
import Atlas3DTools, { SECTION_RANGE, VIEW_LABEL, type Section, type ToolState, type ViewId } from './Atlas3DTools';

// ==================== الأنواع ====================
type Tone = 'sel' | 'ok' | 'bad';

export interface Atlas3DProps {
  zoom: ZoomId;
  selItems: readonly { id: string; tone: Tone }[];
  highlight: ReadonlySet<string> | null;
  arrowIds: readonly string[];
  pose: Pose;
  kRef: { current: number };
  hideNames: boolean;
  onPick: (id: string) => void;
  onFail: () => void;
  /** يطلب من الصفحة تقريب منطقة (عند اختيار إعداد مسبق) */
  onZoomRequest?: (z: ZoomId) => void;
}

interface Palette { bone: string; muscle: string; context: string; sel: string; ok: string; bad: string; bg: string }

const URL_FULL = '/atlas/head-neck.glb';
const URL_LITE = '/atlas/head-neck-lite.glb';
const FOV = 30;
const QUALITY_KEY = 'anatomy-3d-quality';

const LIGHT: Palette = { bone: '#E9E1CE', muscle: '#A8503A', context: '#C9AC9B', sel: '#0E6B73', ok: '#3D6E4A', bad: '#B8860B', bg: '#F7F6F1' };
const DARK: Palette = { bone: '#D2CAB5', muscle: '#D98B73', context: '#8F7B72', sel: '#7FD3DC', ok: '#7BC28A', bad: '#E8BC6A', bg: '#1D262B' };

function readPalette(el: HTMLElement): Palette {
  const cs = getComputedStyle(el);
  const v = (n: string): string => cs.getPropertyValue(n).trim();
  let dark = false;
  try {
    const deep = v('--paper-deep');
    dark = deep !== '' && new Color(deep).getHSL({ h: 0, s: 0, l: 0 }).l < 0.2;
  } catch {
    dark = false;
  }
  const fb = dark ? DARK : LIGHT;
  let context = fb.context;
  try {
    context = `#${new Color(fb.muscle).lerp(new Color(fb.bone), 0.55).getHexString()}`;
  } catch {
    /* القيمة الاحتياطية */
  }
  return { ...fb, context, ok: v('--success') || fb.ok, bg: v('--paper-soft') || fb.bg };
}

const hash01 = (s: string): number => {
  let h = 2166136261;
  for (let i = 0; i < s.length; i++) h = Math.imul(h ^ s.charCodeAt(i), 16777619);
  return ((h >>> 0) % 1000) / 1000;
};

// ==================== قطع النموذج ====================
interface Part extends PartInfo {
  label: string;
  geometry: BufferGeometry;
  center: Vector3;
  radius: number;
}

function usePartList(url: string): Part[] {
  const gltf = useGLTF(url);
  return useMemo(() => {
    const out: Part[] = [];
    gltf.scene.traverse((o: Object3D) => {
      const m = o as Mesh;
      if (!m.isMesh) return;
      const raw = (typeof m.userData.name === 'string' ? m.userData.name : m.name.replace(/_/g, ' ')) as string;
      const info = describePart(raw);
      m.geometry.computeBoundingBox();
      const box = m.geometry.boundingBox;
      const center = new Vector3();
      let radius = 0.2;
      if (box) {
        box.getCenter(center);
        radius = box.getSize(new Vector3()).length() / 2;
      }
      out.push({ ...info, label: labelOfPart(info, (id) => MUSCLE_BY_ID[id]?.en), geometry: m.geometry, center, radius });
    });
    return out;
  }, [gltf]);
}

// ==================== الكاميرا ====================
const FRAMES: Record<ZoomId, { target: [number, number, number]; height: number }> = {
  whole: { target: [0, -1.1, 0.1], height: 6.3 },
  eyes: { target: [0, 0.4, 0.8], height: 1.4 },
  nose: { target: [0, 0.1, 0.9], height: 1.2 },
  mouth: { target: [0, -0.45, 0.8], height: 1.3 },
  side: { target: [0.6, 0.0, 0.3], height: 2.0 },
  neck: { target: [0, -1.5, 0.0], height: 3.4 },
  throat: { target: [0, -1.0, 0.4], height: 2.0 },
  posterior: { target: [0.7, -1.3, -0.1], height: 2.2 },
};

const VIEW_DIR: Record<ViewId, [number, number, number]> = {
  front: [0, 0.05, 1], left: [1, 0.05, 0], right: [-1, 0.05, 0], back: [0, 0.05, -1], top: [0, 1, 0.12], bottom: [0, -1, 0.2],
};

function reducedMotion(): boolean {
  try {
    return window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

interface FocusReq { id: string; n: number }

function CameraRig({
  zoom, view, focus, parts, controls, freeTouch,
}: {
  zoom: ZoomId;
  view: { id: ViewId; n: number } | null;
  focus: FocusReq | null;
  parts: readonly Part[];
  controls: { current: ComponentRef<typeof OrbitControls> | null };
  freeTouch: boolean;
}) {
  const { camera, invalidate, size } = useThree();
  const aspect = size.width / Math.max(1, size.height);
  const goal = useRef<{ target: Vector3; dist: number; dir: Vector3 | null; instant: boolean } | null>(null);
  const first = useRef(true);
  const off = useMemo(() => new Vector3(), []);
  const lastDist = useRef(8);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = (controls.current as unknown as { domElement?: HTMLElement } | null)?.domElement;
    if (el) el.style.touchAction = freeTouch ? 'none' : 'pan-y';
  }, [controls, freeTouch]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const f = FRAMES[zoom];
    const needW = Math.max(1.7, f.height * 0.62);
    const fit = Math.max(f.height, needW / aspect);
    const dist = fit / (2 * Math.tan(MathUtils.degToRad(FOV / 2)));
    lastDist.current = dist;
    goal.current = {
      target: new Vector3(...f.target),
      dist,
      dir: first.current ? new Vector3(...VIEW_DIR.front).normalize() : null,
      instant: first.current || reducedMotion(),
    };
    first.current = false;
    invalidate();
  }, [zoom, invalidate, aspect]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!view) return;
    const g = goal.current;
    goal.current = {
      target: g?.target ?? new Vector3(...FRAMES[zoom].target),
      dist: g?.dist ?? lastDist.current,
      dir: new Vector3(...VIEW_DIR[view.id]).normalize(),
      instant: reducedMotion(),
    };
    invalidate();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [view, invalidate]);

  // الانتقال إلى العضلة المحددة (الجهة الأقرب للكاميرا)
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!focus) return;
    const cands = parts.filter((p) => p.muscleId === focus.id);
    if (cands.length === 0) return;
    let best = cands[0];
    let bd = Infinity;
    for (const p of cands) {
      const d = p.center.distanceTo(camera.position);
      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = p; }
    }
    if (!best) return;
    const radius = cands.filter((p) => Math.sign(p.center.x) === Math.sign(best.center.x)).reduce((m, p) => Math.max(m, p.radius), best.radius);
    const dist = MathUtils.clamp(radius * 3.4, 1.3, 5);
    lastDist.current = dist;
    goal.current = { target: best.center.clone(), dist, dir: null, instant: reducedMotion() };
    invalidate();
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [focus?.n]);

  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const c = controls.current;
    const g = goal.current;
    if (!c || !g) return;
    const k = g.instant ? 1 : 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 7);
    off.copy(camera.position).sub(c.target);
    let len = off.length();
    if (len < 1e-4) off.set(0, 0.05, 1);
    if (g.dir) off.normalize().lerp(g.dir, k).normalize();
    else off.normalize();
    len = MathUtils.lerp(len, g.dist, k);
    off.multiplyScalar(len);
    c.target.lerp(g.target, k);
    camera.position.copy(c.target).add(off);
    c.update();
    const dirDone = !g.dir || off.clone().normalize().distanceTo(g.dir) < 0.01;
    if (c.target.distanceTo(g.target) < 0.002 && Math.abs(len - g.dist) < 0.01 && dirDone) goal.current = null;
    else invalidate();
  });

  return null;
}

// ==================== حركة الرأس والفك ====================
const HEAD_PIVOT: [number, number, number] = [0, -0.09, -0.12];
const JAW_PIVOT: [number, number, number] = [0, 0.18, 0.14];
const neg = (p: [number, number, number]): [number, number, number] => [-p[0], -p[1], -p[2]];

function HeadRig({ pose, kRef, children }: { pose: Pose; kRef: { current: number }; children: ReactNode }) {
  const ref = useRef<Group>(null);
  const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
  const animated = (pose.tilt ?? 0) !== 0 || (pose.turn ?? 0) !== 0 || (pose.fx ?? 0) !== 0;

  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const g = ref.current;
    if (!g) return;
    const k = kRef.current;
    const tx = (pose.fx ?? 0) * k * 0.28;
    const ty = (pose.turn ?? 0) * k * 0.45;
    const tz = -(pose.tilt ?? 0) * k * 0.25;
    g.rotation.x = MathUtils.damp(g.rotation.x, tx, 14, dt);
    g.rotation.y = MathUtils.damp(g.rotation.y, ty, 14, dt);
    g.rotation.z = MathUtils.damp(g.rotation.z, tz, 14, dt);
    const moving = Math.abs(g.rotation.x - tx) > 5e-4 || Math.abs(g.rotation.y - ty) > 5e-4 || Math.abs(g.rotation.z - tz) > 5e-4;
    if (animated || moving) invalidate();
  });

  return (
    <group ref={ref} position={HEAD_PIVOT}>
      <group position={neg(HEAD_PIVOT)}>{children}</group>
    </group>
  );
}

function JawRig({ pose, kRef, children }: { pose: Pose; kRef: { current: number }; children: ReactNode }) {
  const ref = useRef<Group>(null);
  const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
  const animated = (pose.jaw ?? 0) !== 0;

  useFrame((_, dt) => {
    const g = ref.current;
    if (!g) return;
    const target = Math.max(0, pose.jaw ?? 0) * kRef.current * 0.2;
    g.rotation.x = MathUtils.damp(g.rotation.x, target, 14, dt);
    if (animated || Math.abs(g.rotation.x - target) > 5e-4) invalidate();
  });

  return (
    <group ref={ref} position={JAW_PIVOT}>
      <group position={neg(JAW_PIVOT)}>{children}</group>
    </group>
  );
}

// ==================== المواد ====================
interface ShaderLike { fragmentShader: string; uniforms: Record<string, { value: unknown }> }

/** إضاءة حافّة خفيفة (Fresnel) تُبرز شكل العضلة وحجمها */
function rimPatch(shader: ShaderLike): void {
  shader.uniforms.rimColor = { value: new Color('#ffffff') };
  shader.fragmentShader = shader.fragmentShader
    .replace('#include <common>', '#include <common>\nuniform vec3 rimColor;')
    .replace(
      '#include <emissivemap_fragment>',
      '#include <emissivemap_fragment>\n  float rimF = pow(1.0 - saturate(dot(normalize(normal), normalize(vViewPosition))), 2.6);\n  totalEmissiveRadiance += rimColor * rimF * 0.2;',
    );
}

// ==================== قطعة واحدة ====================
interface Look {
  palette: Palette;
  tones: ReadonlyMap<string, Tone>;
  highlight: ReadonlySet<string> | null;
  vis: Visibility;
  autoHide: ReadonlySet<string>;
  peel: Depth;
  boneOpacity: number;
  muscleOpacity: number;
  focus: boolean;
  anySelected: boolean;
  moving: boolean;
  plane: Plane | null;
  kRef: { current: number };
  hover: string | null;
  pickedKey: string | null;
  setHover: (key: string | null, label?: string) => void;
  onPickPart: (p: Part) => void;
}

function PartMesh({ part, look }: { part: Part; look: Look }) {
  const gl = useThree((s) => s.gl);
  const invalidate = useThree((s) => s.invalidate);
  const mat = useRef<MeshStandardMaterial>(null);
  const { palette, tones, highlight } = look;
  const id = part.muscleId;
  const tone = id ? tones.get(id) : look.pickedKey === part.key ? ('sel' as const) : undefined;
  const pulse = tone === 'sel' && look.moving && id !== null;

  useFrame(() => {
    const m = mat.current;
    if (!m || !pulse) return;
    m.emissiveIntensity = 0.1 + 0.55 * look.kRef.current;
    invalidate();
  });

  const baseColor = useMemo(() => {
    const base = part.kind === 'bone' ? palette.bone : id ? palette.muscle : palette.context;
    const c = new Color(base);
    c.offsetHSL(0, 0, (hash01(part.name) - 0.5) * (part.kind === 'bone' ? 0.05 : 0.11));
    return `#${c.getHexString()}`;
  }, [part.kind, part.name, id, palette]);

  const hidden =
    !partVisible(part, look.vis, look.peel) || (id !== null && look.autoHide.has(id) && !tone);
  if (hidden) return null;

  const dim = id !== null && highlight !== null && !highlight.has(id) && !tone;
  const faded = look.focus && look.anySelected && part.kind === 'muscle' && !tone;
  const hovered = look.hover === part.key;
  let color = baseColor;
  if (tone === 'sel') color = palette.sel;
  else if (tone === 'ok') color = palette.ok;
  else if (tone === 'bad') color = palette.bad;
  else if (hovered) color = `#${new Color(baseColor).lerp(new Color('#ffffff'), 0.25).getHexString()}`;

  const base = part.kind === 'bone' ? look.boneOpacity : look.muscleOpacity;
  const opacity = dim ? Math.min(base, 0.12) : faded ? Math.min(base, 0.3) : base;
  const transparent = opacity < 1;
  const sectioned = look.plane !== null;

  return (
    <mesh
      key={sectioned ? 's' : 'n'}
      geometry={part.geometry}
      renderOrder={transparent ? 1 : 0}
      onClick={(e: ThreeEvent<MouseEvent>) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        if (e.delta > 6) return;
        look.onPickPart(part);
      }}
      onPointerOver={(e: ThreeEvent<PointerEvent>) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
        look.setHover(part.key, part.label);
        gl.domElement.style.cursor = 'pointer';
      }}
      onPointerOut={() => {
        look.setHover(null);
        gl.domElement.style.cursor = '';
      }}
    >
      <meshStandardMaterial
        ref={mat}
        color={color}
        emissive={tone || hovered ? color : '#000000'}
        emissiveIntensity={tone === 'sel' ? 0.22 : tone ? 0.18 : hovered ? 0.1 : 0}
        roughness={part.kind === 'bone' ? 0.8 : 0.46}
        metalness={0.02}
        transparent={transparent}
        opacity={opacity}
        depthWrite={!transparent}
        side={sectioned ? 2 : 0}
        clippingPlanes={look.plane ? [look.plane] : null}
        onBeforeCompile={rimPatch}
      />
    </mesh>
  );
}

// ==================== أسماء مثبّتة على العضلات المحددة ====================
function PinnedLabels({ ids, parts }: { ids: readonly string[]; parts: readonly Part[] }) {
  return (
    <>
      {ids.slice(0, 6).map((id) => (
        <PinnedLabel key={id} id={id} parts={parts} />
      ))}
    </>
  );
}

function PinnedLabel({ id, parts }: { id: string; parts: readonly Part[] }) {
  const ref = useRef<Group>(null);
  const cands = useMemo(() => parts.filter((p) => p.muscleId === id), [parts, id]);
  const camera = useThree((s) => s.camera);

  useFrame(() => {
    const g = ref.current;
    if (!g || cands.length === 0) return;
    let best = cands[0];
    let bd = Infinity;
    for (const p of cands) {
      const d = p.center.distanceTo(camera.position);
      if (d < bd) { bd = d; best = p; }
    }
    if (best) g.position.copy(best.center);
  });

  if (cands.length === 0) return null;
  const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
  return (
    <group ref={ref}>
      <Html center zIndexRange={[5, 0]} style={{ pointerEvents: 'none' }}>
        <span className="fa3-pin" dir="ltr">{m?.short ?? m?.en ?? id}</span>
      </Html>
    </group>
  );
}

// ==================== المشهد ====================
interface SceneProps extends Atlas3DProps {
  url: string;
  palette: Palette;
  ts: ToolState;
  view: { id: ViewId; n: number } | null;
  focusReq: FocusReq | null;
  autoHide: ReadonlySet<string>;
  hover: string | null;
  pickedKey: string | null;
  setHover: (key: string | null, label?: string) => void;
  onPickPart: (p: Part) => void;
  partsRef: { current: readonly Part[] };
  captureRef: { current: (() => string | null) | null };
  bg: string;
}

function Scene(props: SceneProps) {
  const { ts } = props;
  const parts = usePartList(props.url);
  const controls = useRef<ComponentRef<typeof OrbitControls>>(null);
  const { gl, scene, camera, invalidate } = useThree();

  useEffect(() => {
    props.partsRef.current = parts;
  }, [parts, props.partsRef]);

  useEffect(() => {
    gl.localClippingEnabled = true;
  }, [gl]);

  useEffect(() => {
    props.captureRef.current = () => {
      const prev = gl.getClearAlpha();
      gl.setClearColor(new Color(props.bg), 1);
      gl.render(scene as ThreeScene, camera);
      const url = gl.domElement.toDataURL('image/png');
      gl.setClearColor(new Color(props.bg), prev);
      invalidate();
      return url;
    };
    return () => {
      props.captureRef.current = null;
    };
  }, [gl, scene, camera, invalidate, props.bg, props.captureRef]);

  useFrame(() => {
    if (ts.autoRotate) invalidate();
  });

  const plane = useMemo(() => new Plane(new Vector3(-1, 0, 0), 0), []);
  if (ts.section.on) {
    const n = ts.section.axis === 'x' ? [1, 0, 0] : ts.section.axis === 'y' ? [0, 1, 0] : [0, 0, 1];
    const s = ts.section.flip ? 1 : -1;
    plane.normal.set(n[0] ?? 0, n[1] ?? 0, n[2] ?? 0).multiplyScalar(s);
    plane.constant = ts.section.flip ? -ts.section.pos : ts.section.pos;
  }

  const tones = useMemo(() => new Map(props.selItems.map((s) => [s.id, s.tone] as const)), [props.selItems]);
  const moving = Object.keys(props.pose).length > 0;
  const look: Look = {
    palette: props.palette,
    tones,
    highlight: props.highlight,
    vis: ts.vis,
    autoHide: props.autoHide,
    peel: ts.peel,
    boneOpacity: ts.boneOpacity,
    muscleOpacity: ts.muscleOpacity,
    focus: ts.focus && !props.hideNames,
    anySelected: props.selItems.length > 0,
    moving,
    plane: ts.section.on ? plane : null,
    kRef: props.kRef,
    hover: props.hover,
    pickedKey: props.pickedKey,
    setHover: props.setHover,
    onPickPart: props.onPickPart,
  };

  const fixed = parts.filter((p) => !p.head);
  const head = parts.filter((p) => p.head && !p.jaw);
  const jaw = parts.filter((p) => p.head && p.jaw);
  const selIds = props.selItems.filter((s) => s.tone === 'sel').map((s) => s.id);

  return (
    <>
      <ambientLight intensity={0.62} />
      <hemisphereLight args={['#ffffff', '#b8a99a', 0.9]} />
      <directionalLight position={[3, 4, 6]} intensity={2.0} />
      <directionalLight position={[-4, 1, 3]} intensity={0.8} />
      <directionalLight position={[0, 3, -5]} intensity={0.7} />

      <OrbitControls
        ref={controls}
        makeDefault
        enableDamping
        dampingFactor={0.12}
        rotateSpeed={0.7}
        zoomSpeed={0.8}
        autoRotate={ts.autoRotate}
        autoRotateSpeed={1.4}
        screenSpacePanning
        minDistance={0.7}
        maxDistance={22}
        touches={{ ONE: TOUCH.ROTATE, TWO: TOUCH.DOLLY_PAN }}
      />
      <CameraRig zoom={props.zoom} view={props.view} focus={props.focusReq} parts={parts} controls={controls} freeTouch={ts.freeTouch} />

      <group>{fixed.map((p) => <PartMesh key={p.key} part={p} look={look} />)}</group>
      <HeadRig pose={props.pose} kRef={props.kRef}>
        {head.map((p) => <PartMesh key={p.key} part={p} look={look} />)}
        <JawRig pose={props.pose} kRef={props.kRef}>
          {jaw.map((p) => <PartMesh key={p.key} part={p} look={look} />)}
        </JawRig>
      </HeadRig>

      {ts.labels && !props.hideNames && selIds.length <= 3 && <PinnedLabels ids={selIds} parts={parts} />}
    </>
  );
}

// ==================== الواجهة ====================
const INITIAL_TS = (): ToolState => {
  let quality: 'full' | 'lite' = 'full';
  let freeTouch = false;
  try {
    const stored = localStorage.getItem(QUALITY_KEY);
    const mem = (navigator as Navigator & { deviceMemory?: number }).deviceMemory ?? 8;
    const small = Math.min(window.screen.width, window.screen.height) < 700;
    quality = stored === 'lite' || stored === 'full' ? stored : small || mem <= 2 ? 'lite' : 'full';
    freeTouch = window.innerWidth >= 700;
  } catch {
    /* القيم الافتراضية */
  }
  return {
    vis: DEFAULT_VISIBILITY,
    peel: 1,
    boneOpacity: 1,
    muscleOpacity: 1,
    section: { on: false, axis: 'x', pos: 0, flip: false } satisfies Section,
    autoRotate: false,
    labels: true,
    focus: true,
    freeTouch,
    quality,
  };
};

export default function Atlas3D(props: Atlas3DProps) {
  const wrapRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const alive = useRef(true);
  const fromCanvas = useRef(false);
  const partsRef = useRef<readonly Part[]>([]);
  const captureRef = useRef<(() => string | null) | null>(null);
  const [palette, setPalette] = useState<Palette>(LIGHT);
  const [ts, setTs] = useState<ToolState>(INITIAL_TS);
  const [hist, setHist] = useState<Visibility[]>([]);
  const [hoverKey, setHoverKey] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [hoverLabel, setHoverLabel] = useState('');
  const [view, setView] = useState<{ id: ViewId; n: number } | null>(null);
  const [viewMenu, setViewMenu] = useState(false);
  const [tools, setTools] = useState(false);
  const [picked, setPicked] = useState<{ key: string; label: string; kind: 'bone' | 'muscle' } | null>(null);
  const [focusReq, setFocusReq] = useState<FocusReq | null>(null);
  const [missing, setMissing] = useState(false);
  const { onFail, onPick } = props;
  const { active: loading, progress } = useProgress();

  const url = ts.quality === 'lite' ? URL_LITE : URL_FULL;

  useEffect(() => {
    alive.current = true;
    return () => {
      alive.current = false;
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD' })
      .then((r) => { if (live && !r.ok) setMissing(true); })
      .catch(() => { if (live) setMissing(true); });
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [url]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = wrapRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    const apply = (): void => setPalette(readPalette(el));
    apply();
    const mo = new MutationObserver(apply);
    const opts = { attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['class', 'data-theme'] };
    mo.observe(document.documentElement, opts);
    mo.observe(document.body, opts);
    return () => mo.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const patch = useCallback((p: Partial<ToolState>) => {
    setTs((s) => ({ ...s, ...p }));
    if (p.quality) {
      try { localStorage.setItem(QUALITY_KEY, p.quality); } catch { /* تجاهل */ }
    }
  }, []);

  const commitVis = useCallback((next: Visibility) => {
    setHist((h) => [...h.slice(-29), ts.vis]);
    setTs((s) => ({ ...s, vis: next }));
  }, [ts.vis]);

  const undo = useCallback(() => {
    setHist((h) => {
      const prev = h[h.length - 1];
      if (prev) setTs((s) => ({ ...s, vis: prev }));
      return h.slice(0, -1);
    });
  }, []);

  const toggleGroup = useCallback((id: string) => {
    const g = new Set(ts.vis.groups);
    if (g.has(id)) g.delete(id);
    else g.add(id);
    commitVis({ ...ts.vis, groups: g });
  }, [ts.vis, commitVis]);

  const { onZoomRequest } = props;
  const preset = useCallback(
    (id: PresetId) => {
      commitVis(presetVisibility(id));
      const z: ZoomId = id === 'neck' ? 'neck' : id === 'anterior' ? 'throat' : id === 'posterior' ? 'posterior' : 'whole';
      onZoomRequest?.(z);
    },
    [commitVis, onZoomRequest],
  );

  const selectedId = props.selItems.find((s) => s.tone === 'sel')?.id ?? null;
  const multiSel = props.selItems.filter((s) => s.tone === 'sel').length > 1;
  const selectedMissing = selectedId !== null && !multiSel && !MUSCLE_MESHES[selectedId]?.length;

  // عند اختيار عضلة من خارج المجسّم ننتقل إليها
  useEffect(() => {
    if (picked && selectedId) setPicked(null);
    if (!selectedId || multiSel) return;
    if (fromCanvas.current) {
      fromCanvas.current = false;
      return;
    }
    setFocusReq((f) => ({ id: selectedId, n: (f?.n ?? 0) + 1 }));
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [selectedId]);

  const autoHide = useMemo(() => {
    const s = new Set<string>();
    const wanted = props.selItems.some((i) => i.id === 'platysma') || (props.highlight?.has('platysma') ?? false);
    if (!wanted) s.add('platysma');
    return s;
  }, [props.selItems, props.highlight]);

  const setHover = useCallback((key: string | null, label = '') => {
    setHoverKey(key);
    setHoverLabel(key ? label : '');
  }, []);

  const onPickPart = useCallback((p: Part) => {
    if (p.muscleId) {
      fromCanvas.current = true;
      setPicked(null);
      onPick(p.muscleId);
    } else {
      setPicked({ key: p.key, label: p.label, kind: p.kind });
    }
  }, [onPick]);

  // ---- إجراءات المحدد ----
  const target: { label: string; muscleId: string | null; key: string | null; kind: 'bone' | 'muscle' } | null =
    picked
      ? { label: picked.label, muscleId: null, key: picked.key, kind: picked.kind }
      : selectedId && !multiSel && !selectedMissing
        ? { label: MUSCLE_BY_ID[selectedId]?.en ?? selectedId, muscleId: selectedId, key: null, kind: 'muscle' }
        : null;

  const hideTarget = (): void => {
    if (!target) return;
    if (target.muscleId) commitVis({ ...ts.vis, muscles: new Set(ts.vis.muscles).add(target.muscleId) });
    else if (target.key) commitVis({ ...ts.vis, parts: new Set(ts.vis.parts).add(target.key) });
    setPicked(null);
  };

  const isolateTarget = (): void => {
    if (!target) return;
    if (target.muscleId) {
      commitVis({
        groups: new Set(ALL_CONTEXT_IDS),
        muscles: new Set(ALL_MUSCLE_IDS.filter((id) => id !== target.muscleId)),
        parts: new Set(),
      });
    } else if (target.key) {
      commitVis({
        groups: new Set(ALL_MUSCLE_GROUP_IDS.concat(ALL_CONTEXT_IDS)),
        muscles: new Set(),
        parts: new Set(partsRef.current.filter((p) => p.key !== target.key).map((p) => p.key)),
      });
    }
  };

  const resetAll = (): void => {
    setHist([]);
    setPicked(null);
    setTs((s) => ({
      ...s, vis: DEFAULT_VISIBILITY, peel: 1, boneOpacity: 1, muscleOpacity: 1, section: { ...s.section, on: false, pos: 0 }, autoRotate: false,
    }));
    setView({ id: 'front', n: (view?.n ?? 0) + 1 });
  };

  const shot = (): void => {
    const data = captureRef.current?.();
    if (!data) return;
    const a = document.createElement('a');
    a.href = data;
    a.download = `anatomy-${selectedId ?? 'atlas'}.png`;
    a.click();
  };

  if (missing) {
    return (
      <div className="fa3 fa3-empty" role="alert" dir="rtl">
        <p>ملف النموذج غير موجود. ضعه في <span dir="ltr">public/atlas/</span> ثم أعد تحميل الصفحة.</p>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const quiz = props.hideNames;
  const nameShown = hoverLabel && !quiz ? hoverLabel : '';
  const hiddenCount = ts.vis.muscles.size + ts.vis.parts.size + ts.vis.groups.size - (ts.vis.groups.has('c:chest') ? 1 : 0);

  return (
    <div ref={wrapRef} className="fa3" role="group" aria-label="3D model of the skeleton, facial and neck muscles">
      <Canvas
        flat
        frameloop="demand"
        dpr={[1, 1.75]}
        camera={{ fov: FOV, near: 0.1, far: 80, position: [0, 0, 12] }}
        gl={{ antialias: true, alpha: true, powerPreference: 'high-performance' }}
        onCreated={({ gl }) => {
          const el = gl.domElement;
          const onLost = (e: Event): void => {
            e.preventDefault();
            // يُطلق الحدث أيضاً عند إغلاق المجسّم عمداً؛ لا يُعدّ ذلك فشلاً
            if (alive.current) onFail();
          };
          el.addEventListener('webglcontextlost', onLost);
        }}
      >
        <Suspense fallback={null}>
          <Scene
            {...props}
            url={url}
            palette={palette}
            ts={ts}
            view={view}
            focusReq={focusReq}
            autoHide={autoHide}
            hover={hoverKey}
            pickedKey={picked?.key ?? null}
            setHover={setHover}
            onPickPart={onPickPart}
            partsRef={partsRef}
            captureRef={captureRef}
            bg={palette.bg}
          />
        </Suspense>
      </Canvas>

      {loading && <div className="fa3-loading" role="status">جارٍ تحميل النموذج… {Math.round(progress)}%</div>}

      <div className="fa3-top" dir="rtl">
        <div className="fa3-menu">
          <button type="button" className="fa-btn" aria-expanded={viewMenu} onClick={() => setViewMenu((v) => !v)}>الزاوية ▾</button>
          {viewMenu && (
            <div className="fa3-pop" role="menu">
              {VIEW_LABEL.map(([id, label]) => (
                <button key={id} type="button" role="menuitem" onClick={() => { setView((v) => ({ id, n: (v?.n ?? 0) + 1 })); setViewMenu(false); }}>{label}</button>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
        <button type="button" className="fa-btn" aria-pressed={tools} onClick={() => setTools((t) => !t)}>
          الطبقات والأدوات{hiddenCount > 0 ? ` · ${hiddenCount}` : ''}
        </button>
      </div>

      <Atlas3DTools
        ts={ts}
        patch={patch}
        setVis={commitVis}
        toggleGroup={toggleGroup}
        preset={preset}
        canUndo={hist.length > 0}
        undo={undo}
        resetAll={resetAll}
        shot={shot}
        open={tools}
        onClose={() => setTools(false)}
      />

      <div className="fa3-bottom" dir="rtl">
        {(target || hist.length > 0) && (
          <div className="fa3-actions">
            {target && <span className="fa3-target" dir="ltr">{target.label}</span>}
            {target && <button type="button" className="fa-btn" onClick={hideTarget}>إخفاء</button>}
            {target && <button type="button" className="fa-btn" onClick={isolateTarget}>عزل</button>}
            {hist.length > 0 && <button type="button" className="fa-btn" onClick={undo}>تراجع</button>}
            {(hist.length > 0 || hiddenCount > 0) && (
              <button type="button" className="fa-btn" onClick={() => commitVis({ groups: new Set(), muscles: new Set(), parts: new Set() })}>إظهار الكل</button>
            )}
          </div>
        )}
        <div className="fa3-peel">
          <div className="fa3-peel-head">
            <span>قشّر الطبقات</span>
            <span className="fa3-peel-now">{ts.peel === 1 ? 'كل الطبقات' : `من الطبقة ${DEPTH_LABEL[ts.peel]}`}</span>
          </div>
          <input
            type="range" min={1} max={4} step={1} value={ts.peel} dir="ltr" aria-label="Peel muscle layers"
            onChange={(e) => patch({ peel: Number(e.target.value) as Depth })}
          />
          <div className="fa3-peel-scale" dir="ltr" aria-hidden="true">
            {([1, 2, 3, 4] as const).map((d) => <span key={d}>{DEPTH_LABEL[d]}</span>)}
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      {selectedMissing && <div className="fa3-note" dir="rtl">هذه العضلة غير موجودة في النموذج ثلاثي الأبعاد، راجعها في وضع 2D.</div>}
      <div className="fa3-hover" aria-hidden="true">{nameShown}</div>
      <div className="fa3-credit" dir="ltr">BodyParts3D © DBCLS · Z-Anatomy</div>
    </div>
  );
}

export { SECTION_RANGE };
```
