```ts
// lib/anatomy-quiz.ts
import { MUSCLES, MUSCLE_BY_ID, NECK_MUSCLE_IDS } from './anatomy-data';
import { FACIAL_BRANCHES, branchesOf } from './anatomy-extras';
import { TRIANGLES } from './anatomy-neck-notes';

export type QuestionKind = 'locate' | 'identify' | 'action' | 'attach' | 'branch' | 'nerve' | 'boundary' | 'contents';
export type QuizScope = 'all' | 'face' | 'neck';

export interface Question {
  kind: QuestionKind;
  /** العضلة المعنية (أو المثلث في أسئلة المثلثات: يُخزَّن في ref) */
  id: string;
  options: string[];
  correct: string;
  /** معرّف المثلث لأسئلة boundary/contents */
  ref?: string;
}

export interface RoundOptions {
  count: number;
  scope: QuizScope;
  /** عضلات تُفضَّل (للأخطاء السابقة) */
  only?: readonly string[];
}

// ==================== العصب المغذّي ====================
export interface NerveOption { id: string; en: string; ar: string }

export const NERVE_OPTIONS: readonly NerveOption[] = [
  { id: 'vii', en: 'Facial nerve (CN VII)', ar: 'العصب الوجهي' },
  { id: 'v3', en: 'Mandibular nerve (CN V3)', ar: 'العصب الفكي السفلي' },
  { id: 'xi', en: 'Accessory nerve (CN XI)', ar: 'العصب الإضافي' },
  { id: 'ansa', en: 'Ansa cervicalis (C1 to C3)', ar: 'العروة العنقية' },
  { id: 'c1xii', en: 'C1 fibres carried with the hypoglossal nerve', ar: 'ألياف C1 مع العصب تحت اللسان' },
  { id: 'dorsal', en: 'C3, C4 and the dorsal scapular nerve', ar: 'C3 وC4 والعصب الكتفي الظهري' },
  { id: 'post', en: 'Posterior rami of cervical nerves', ar: 'الفروع الخلفية للأعصاب العنقية' },
  { id: 'ant', en: 'Anterior rami of cervical nerves', ar: 'الفروع الأمامية للأعصاب العنقية' },
];

/** مفتاح العصب الأساسي للعضلة، أو null إن كانت مختلطة/غير واضحة */
export function nerveKeyOf(id: string): string | null {
  const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
  if (!m) return null;
  const n = m.nerve;
  const vii = /\bCN VII\b/.test(n);
  const v3 = /\bCN V3\b/.test(n);
  if (vii && v3) return null;
  if (vii) return 'vii';
  if (v3) return 'v3';
  if (/\bCN XI\b/.test(n)) return 'xi';
  if (/ansa cervicalis/i.test(n)) return 'ansa';
  if (/hypoglossal/i.test(n)) return 'c1xii';
  if (/C1/.test(n) && /anterior ramus of C1 \(/.test(n)) return 'c1xii';
  if (/dorsal scapular/i.test(n)) return 'dorsal';
  if (/posterior rami/i.test(n)) return 'post';
  if (/anterior rami/i.test(n)) return 'ant';
  return null;
}

// ==================== المثلثات ====================
const TRIANGLE_BOUNDARY: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>> = {
  submental: ['digastric'],
  submandibular: ['digastric'],
  carotid: ['omohyoid', 'stylohyoid', 'digastric', 'scm'],
  muscular: ['omohyoid', 'scm'],
  posterior: ['scm', 'trapezius'],
  anterior: ['scm'],
};

// ==================== الأدوات ====================
const AMBIGUOUS_ACTION_GROUPS: readonly (readonly string[])[] = [
  ['lls', 'zmin', 'llsan', 'lao', 'zmaj'],
  ['masseter', 'temporalis'],
  ['corrugator', 'procerus'],
  ['scaleneAnt', 'scaleneMid', 'scalenePost'],
  ['digastric', 'stylohyoid', 'mylohyoid', 'geniohyoid'],
  ['omohyoid', 'sternohyoid', 'thyrohyoid', 'sternothyroid'],
  ['rcAnterior', 'rcLateralis', 'longusCapitis', 'longusColli'],
];

function shuffle<T>(arr: readonly T[]): T[] {
  const a = [...arr];
  for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
    const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
    const t = a[i] as T;
    a[i] = a[j] as T;
    a[j] = t;
  }
  return a;
}

function sameAmbiguityGroup(a: string, b: string): boolean {
  return AMBIGUOUS_ACTION_GROUPS.some((g) => g.includes(a) && g.includes(b));
}

function inScope(id: string, scope: QuizScope): boolean {
  if (scope === 'all') return true;
  return scope === 'neck' ? NECK_MUSCLE_IDS.has(id) : !NECK_MUSCLE_IDS.has(id);
}

function distractors(id: string, n: number, kind: QuestionKind, scope: QuizScope): string[] {
  const target = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
  const base = MUSCLES.filter((m) => m.id !== id && !(kind === 'action' && sameAmbiguityGroup(id, m.id)));
  const scoped = base.filter((m) => inScope(m.id, scope));
  const pool = scoped.length >= n ? scoped : base;
  const same = shuffle(pool.filter((m) => m.region === target?.region));
  const other = shuffle(pool.filter((m) => m.region !== target?.region));
  return [...same, ...other].slice(0, n).map((m) => m.id);
}

function eligibleKinds(id: string): QuestionKind[] {
  const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
  const kinds: QuestionKind[] = ['locate', 'identify', 'action', 'attach'];
  if (m && branchesOf(m).length === 1) kinds.push('branch');
  if (nerveKeyOf(id)) kinds.push('nerve');
  return kinds;
}

function build(id: string, kind: QuestionKind, scope: QuizScope): Question {
  if (kind === 'locate') return { kind, id, options: [], correct: id };
  if (kind === 'branch') {
    const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
    const only = m ? branchesOf(m)[0] : undefined;
    return { kind, id, options: FACIAL_BRANCHES.map((b) => b.id), correct: only ?? 'buccal' };
  }
  if (kind === 'nerve') {
    const key = nerveKeyOf(id) ?? 'vii';
    const others = shuffle(NERVE_OPTIONS.filter((o) => o.id !== key)).slice(0, 3).map((o) => o.id);
    return { kind, id, options: shuffle([key, ...others]), correct: key };
  }
  return { kind, id, options: shuffle([id, ...distractors(id, 3, kind, scope)]), correct: id };
}

function triangleQuestion(): Question | null {
  const withBounds = TRIANGLES.filter((t) => (TRIANGLE_BOUNDARY[t.id]?.length ?? 0) > 0);
  const t = shuffle(withBounds)[0];
  if (!t) return null;
  if (Math.random() < 0.5) {
    const bounds = TRIANGLE_BOUNDARY[t.id] ?? [];
    const correct = shuffle(bounds)[0];
    if (!correct) return null;
    const wrong = shuffle(MUSCLES.filter((m) => !bounds.includes(m.id) && NECK_MUSCLE_IDS.has(m.id)).map((m) => m.id)).slice(0, 3);
    return { kind: 'boundary', id: correct, ref: t.id, options: shuffle([correct, ...wrong]), correct };
  }
  const correct = shuffle(t.contents)[0];
  if (!correct) return null;
  const foreign = TRIANGLES.filter((x) => x.id !== t.id).flatMap((x) => x.contents).filter((c) => !t.contents.includes(c));
  const wrong = shuffle([...new Set(foreign)]).slice(0, 3);
  if (wrong.length < 2) return null;
  return { kind: 'contents', id: t.id, ref: t.id, options: shuffle([correct, ...wrong]), correct };
}

export function makeRound(opts: RoundOptions | number = 10): Question[] {
  const o: RoundOptions = typeof opts === 'number' ? { count: opts, scope: 'all' } : opts;
  const pool = o.only && o.only.length > 0 ? [...o.only] : MUSCLES.map((m) => m.id).filter((id) => inScope(id, o.scope));
  const ids = shuffle(pool).slice(0, o.count);
  const out: Question[] = [];
  let prev: QuestionKind | null = null;
  const allowTri = (o.scope === 'neck' || o.scope === 'all') && !(o.only && o.only.length > 0);

  for (const id of ids) {
    if (allowTri && out.length > 0 && Math.random() < (o.scope === 'neck' ? 0.22 : 0.1)) {
      const tq = triangleQuestion();
      if (tq) {
        out.push(tq);
        prev = tq.kind;
        continue;
      }
    }
    const options = shuffle(eligibleKinds(id));
    const kind = options.find((k) => k !== prev) ?? options[0] ?? 'identify';
    out.push(build(id, kind, o.scope));
    prev = kind;
  }
  return out;
}
```

```ts
// lib/anatomy-relations.ts
/** علاقات العضلات التعليمية: المعادية، المساعدة، نفس العصب. الأزواج المعتمدة فقط. */
import { MUSCLES, MUSCLE_BY_ID } from './anatomy-data';
import { branchesOf, innervationOf } from './anatomy-extras';

export interface Relation {
  id: string;
  kind: 'antagonist' | 'synergist' | 'same-nerve';
}

const ANTAGONISTS: Readonly<Record<string, readonly string[]>> = {
  frontalis: ['procerus', 'corrugator'],
  procerus: ['frontalis'],
  corrugator: ['frontalis'],
  zmaj: ['dao', 'dli'],
  lls: ['dli', 'mentalis'],
  dao: ['zmaj', 'lao'],
  dli: ['zmaj', 'lls'],
  masseter: ['digastric'],
  temporalis: ['digastric'],
  digastric: ['masseter', 'temporalis'],
  sternohyoid: ['mylohyoid', 'geniohyoid', 'stylohyoid'],
  sternothyroid: ['mylohyoid', 'geniohyoid', 'stylohyoid'],
  omohyoid: ['mylohyoid', 'geniohyoid', 'stylohyoid'],
  mylohyoid: ['sternohyoid', 'omohyoid'],
  geniohyoid: ['sternohyoid', 'omohyoid'],
  stylohyoid: ['sternohyoid', 'omohyoid'],
  longusColli: ['spleniusCapitis'],
  longusCapitis: ['spleniusCapitis'],
  spleniusCapitis: ['longusColli', 'longusCapitis'],
};

function antagonistsOf(id: string): string[] {
  return (ANTAGONISTS[id] ?? []).filter((x) => MUSCLE_BY_ID[x]);
}

function synergistsOf(id: string): string[] {
  const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
  if (!m) return [];
  const b = branchesOf(m);
  if (b.length !== 1) return [];
  return MUSCLES.filter((x) => x.id !== id && branchesOf(x).includes(b[0] as never) && x.region === m.region).map((x) => x.id);
}

function sameNerveOf(id: string): string[] {
  const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
  const inn = m ? innervationOf(m) : null;
  if (!m || !inn) return [];
  return MUSCLES.filter((x) => x.id !== id && innervationOf(x) === inn && x.region !== m.region).map((x) => x.id);
}

export function relatedMuscles(id: string, limit = 6): Relation[] {
  const out: Relation[] = [
    ...antagonistsOf(id).slice(0, 3).map((x) => ({ id: x, kind: 'antagonist' as const })),
    ...synergistsOf(id).slice(0, 2).map((x) => ({ id: x, kind: 'synergist' as const })),
    ...sameNerveOf(id).slice(0, 2).map((x) => ({ id: x, kind: 'same-nerve' as const })),
  ];
  const seen = new Set<string>();
  return out.filter((r) => !seen.has(r.id) && (seen.add(r.id), true)).slice(0, limit);
}
```

```ts
// lib/anatomy-srs.ts
/**
 * مراجعة متباعدة مبسّطة (مستوحاة من SM-2).
 * نسيت / صعب (<3): تُعاد بعد 10 دقائق. بعدها: يوم، 3 أيام، 7 أيام، ثم الفاصل × معامل السهولة.
 */
export type Grade = 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5;

export interface SrsCard {
  id: string;
  reps: number;
  ease: number;
  interval: number;
  due: number;
  last: number;
  total: number;
  lapses: number;
}

export interface SrsState {
  cards: Record<string, SrsCard>;
}

const DAY = 86_400_000;
const MIN = 60_000;

export function newCard(id: string, now = Date.now()): SrsCard {
  return { id, reps: 0, ease: 2.5, interval: 0, due: now, last: 0, total: 0, lapses: 0 };
}

export function grade(card: SrsCard, g: Grade, now = Date.now()): SrsCard {
  const c: SrsCard = { ...card, total: card.total + 1, last: now };
  if (g < 3) {
    c.reps = 0;
    c.interval = 0;
    c.due = now + 10 * MIN;
    c.ease = Math.max(1.3, card.ease - 0.2);
    c.lapses = card.lapses + 1;
    return c;
  }
  c.reps = card.reps + 1;
  if (c.reps === 1) {
    c.interval = 1;
  } else if (c.reps === 2) {
    c.interval = 3;
  } else if (c.reps === 3) {
    c.interval = 7;
  } else {
    const factor = g === 5 ? 1.3 : g === 4 ? 1.15 : 1;
    c.interval = Math.max(1, Math.round(card.interval * card.ease * factor));
  }
  c.due = now + c.interval * DAY;
  c.ease = Math.max(1.3, Math.min(3, card.ease + (0.1 - (5 - g) * 0.08)));
  return c;
}

export function isDue(card: SrsCard, now = Date.now()): boolean {
  return card.due <= now;
}
```

## lib/anatomy-surface.ts

```ts
// lib/anatomy-surface.ts
/**
 * سطح تقريبي للرأس والرقبة.
 * مصدر واحد لشكل الرقبة في الرسم 2D ولمجسّم الـ 3D:
 * يحوّل إحداثيات الرسم (x, y) إلى عمق z حتى تستند عضلات الـ 3D إلى نفس إحداثيات الـ SVG.
 */

export const CX = 200;
/** وحدات الرسم لكل وحدة عالم في three.js */
export const UNITS = 100;
/** y في الرسم يقابل Y = 0 في العالم */
export const Y0 = 330;

/** [y, نصف العرض, العمق الأمامي, العمق الخلفي] */
export type SurfaceRow = readonly [number, number, number, number];

export const HEAD_TABLE: readonly SurfaceRow[] = [
  [18, 0, 0, 0],
  [19.6, 23, 14, 12],
  [31, 61, 44, 40],
  [54, 90, 72, 66],
  [86, 109, 94, 82],
  [127, 119, 106, 92],
  [170, 120, 112, 96],
  [247, 117, 106, 92],
  [330, 106, 96, 82],
  [367, 90, 84, 72],
  [389, 72, 70, 62],
  [408, 48, 48, 50],
  [421, 26, 28, 34],
  [427, 9, 12, 14],
  [430, 0, 0, 0],
];

export const NECK_TABLE: readonly SurfaceRow[] = [
  [370, 70, 20, 50],
  [430, 84, 36, 54],
  [490, 96, 46, 58],
  [540, 106, 52, 62],
  [570, 126, 56, 66],
  [596, 166, 64, 74],
  [616, 196, 72, 82],
  [700, 198, 74, 84],
  [780, 198, 74, 84],
];

export function sampleTable(table: readonly SurfaceRow[], y: number): SurfaceRow {
  const first = table[0];
  const last = table[table.length - 1];
  if (!first || !last) return [y, 0, 0, 0];
  if (y <= first[0]) return [y, first[1], first[2], first[3]];
  if (y >= last[0]) return [y, last[1], last[2], last[3]];
  for (let i = 1; i < table.length; i++) {
    const b = table[i];
    const a = table[i - 1];
    if (!a || !b || y > b[0]) continue;
    const t = (y - a[0]) / (b[0] - a[0] || 1);
    return [y, a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * t, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * t, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * t];
  }
  return [y, last[1], last[2], last[3]];
}

const smooth = (t: number): number => t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
const clamp01 = (t: number): number => Math.max(0, Math.min(1, t));

function ellipseZ(w: number, depth: number, x: number): number {
  if (w <= 0.01 || depth <= 0.01) return 0;
  const u = Math.max(-0.97, Math.min(0.97, (x - CX) / w));
  return depth * Math.sqrt(1 - u * u);
}

/** منطقة المزج بين الرأس والرقبة (تحت الذقن) */
const BLEND_FROM = 412;
const BLEND_TO = 440;

/** عمق السطح الأمامي عند النقطة (x, y) بوحدات الرسم */
export function surfaceZ(x: number, y: number): number {
  const h = sampleTable(HEAD_TABLE, y);
  const n = sampleTable(NECK_TABLE, y);
  const zh = ellipseZ(h[1], h[2], x);
  const zn = ellipseZ(n[1], n[2], x);
  if (y <= BLEND_FROM) return zh;
  if (y >= BLEND_TO) return zn;
  const t = smooth(clamp01((y - BLEND_FROM) / (BLEND_TO - BLEND_FROM)));
  return zh * (1 - t) + zn * t;
}

/** إحداثيات العالم (three.js) لنقطة من الرسم رُفعت `lift` وحدة عن السطح */
export function toWorld(x: number, y: number, z: number): [number, number, number] {
  return [(x - CX) / UNITS, (Y0 - y) / UNITS, z / UNITS];
}

export function surfacePoint(x: number, y: number, lift: number): [number, number, number] {
  return toWorld(x, y, surfaceZ(x, y) + lift);
}

// ==================== مخطط الرقبة للرسم 2D ====================
function neckSide(sign: 1 | -1, ys: readonly number[]): [number, number][] {
  return ys.map((y) => [CX + sign * sampleTable(NECK_TABLE, y)[1], y]);
}

function buildNeckOutline(): string {
  const ys: number[] = [];
  for (let y = 380; y <= 700; y += 16) ys.push(y);
  const right = neckSide(1, ys);
  const left = neckSide(-1, ys).reverse();
  const pts = [...right, ...left];
  return (
    pts.map(([x, y], i) => `${i === 0 ? 'M' : 'L'}${Math.round(x * 10) / 10},${y}`).join('') + 'Z'
  );
}

/** مسار الرقبة والكتفين (يُرسم خلف الرأس) */
export const NECK_OUTLINE: string = buildNeckOutline();

```

## lib/anatomy-view.ts

```ts
// lib/anatomy-view.ts
import { MUSCLES, ZOOMS, type Muscle, type ZoomId } from './anatomy-data';

export const W0 = 400;
export const H0 = 540;
export const LABEL_MARGIN = 170;

export type ViewBox = readonly [number, number, number, number];

/** يحسب نسبة العرض إلى الارتفاع للـ SVG بناءً على التقريب والتسميات */
export const canvasRatio = (zoom: ZoomId, labelsOn: boolean): number => {
  if (!labelsOn) return W0 / H0;
  const z = ZOOMS[zoom];
  const w = z.size + 2 * LABEL_MARGIN;
  const h = (z.size * H0) / W0;
  return w / h;
};

export function viewBoxFor(zoom: ZoomId, labelsOn: boolean): ViewBox {
  const z = ZOOMS[zoom];
  const h = (z.size * H0) / W0;
  const w = labelsOn ? z.size + 2 * LABEL_MARGIN : z.size;
  return [z.center[0] - w / 2, z.center[1] - h / 2, w, h];
}

export interface PlacedLabel {
  id: string;
  text: string;
  ax: number;
  ay: number;
  tx: number;
  ty: number;
  anchor: 'start' | 'end';
  sx: number;
  sy: number;
}

export interface LabelLayout {
  fs: number;
  items: PlacedLabel[];
}

interface Raw {
  m: Muscle;
  ax: number;
  ay: number;
  ly: number;
}

export function layoutLabels(
  vb: ViewBox,
  widthPx: number,
  emWidth: (text: string) => number,
): LabelLayout {
  if (!(widthPx > 0)) return { fs: 0, items: [] };

  const s = widthPx / vb[2];
  const fs = 11 / s;
  const lineH = fs * 1.45;
  const lists: [Raw[], Raw[]] = [[], []];

  for (const m of MUSCLES) {
    const ax = m.label.s === 'L' ? W0 - m.label.x : m.label.x;
    const ay = m.label.y;
    if (ax < vb[0] + fs || ax > vb[0] + vb[2] - fs || ay < vb[1] + fs || ay > vb[1] + vb[3] - fs) continue;
    lists[m.label.s === 'L' ? 0 : 1].push({ m, ax, ay, ly: ay });
  }

  const items: PlacedLabel[] = [];

  lists.forEach((list, si) => {
    list.sort((a, b) => a.ay - b.ay);

    for (let i = 1; i < list.length; i++) {
      const cur = list[i];
      const prev = list[i - 1];
      if (cur && prev && cur.ly < prev.ly + lineH) cur.ly = prev.ly + lineH;
    }

    const maxY = vb[1] + vb[3] - fs;
    for (let i = list.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
      const cur = list[i];
      if (!cur) continue;
      const lim = maxY - (list.length - 1 - i) * lineH;
      if (cur.ly > lim) cur.ly = lim;
    }

    for (const it of list) {
      const text = it.m.short ?? it.m.en;
      const x = si === 0 ? vb[0] + fs * 0.5 : vb[0] + vb[2] - fs * 0.5;
      const len = emWidth(text) * fs;
      items.push({
        id: it.m.id,
        text,
        ax: it.ax,
        ay: it.ay,
        tx: x,
        ty: it.ly + fs * 0.35,
        anchor: si === 0 ? 'start' : 'end',
        sx: si === 0 ? x + len + fs * 0.4 : x - len - fs * 0.4,
        sy: it.ly,
      });
    }
  });

  return { fs, items };
}
```

## lib/api-client.ts

```ts
// lib/api-client.ts
import { supabase } from './supabaseClient';

export class ApiError extends Error {
  status: number;
  constructor(message: string, status: number) {
    super(message);
    this.name = 'ApiError';
    this.status = status;
  }
}

export async function postJson<TResponse = unknown, TBody = unknown>(
  url: string,
  body: TBody,
  init?: RequestInit
): Promise<TResponse> {
  const res = await fetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
    ...init,
  });

  let data: unknown = null;
  try {
    data = await res.json();
  } catch {
    /* response wasn't JSON */
  }

  if (!res.ok) {
    const message =
      (data && typeof data === 'object' && 'error' in data && typeof (data as { error: unknown }).error === 'string'
        ? (data as { error: string }).error
        : null) || `فشل الطلب (${res.status})`;
    throw new ApiError(message, res.status);
  }

  return data as TResponse;
}

export async function uploadToStorage(
  bucket: string,
  filePath: string,
  file: File | Blob,
  options?: { upsert?: boolean }
): Promise<string> {
  const { error } = await supabase.storage.from(bucket).upload(filePath, file, options);
  if (error) throw new ApiError(`فشل رفع الملف: ${error.message}`, 500);
  const { data } = supabase.storage.from(bucket).getPublicUrl(filePath);
  return data.publicUrl;
}

export function buildStoragePath(prefix: string, fileName: string): string {
  const safeName = fileName.replace(/[^a-zA-Z0-9.\-_]/g, '_');
  return `${prefix}/${Date.now()}-${safeName}`;
}
```

```ts
// lib/api-server.ts
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';
import { getSupabaseAdmin } from './supabaseAdmin';

export type AdminLevel = 'super' | 'admin';

export function jsonError(message: string, status = 400) {
  return NextResponse.json({ error: message }, { status });
}

export function jsonOk<T extends object>(data: T) {
  return NextResponse.json(data);
}

export function resolveAdminLevel(password: unknown): AdminLevel | null {
  if (typeof password !== 'string' || password === '') return null;

  const superPw = process.env.SUPER_ADMIN_PASSWORD;
  if (superPw && password === superPw) return 'super';

  const adminPw = process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD;
  if (adminPw && password === adminPw) return 'admin';

  return null;
}

export function requireAdminPassword(password: unknown): boolean {
  return resolveAdminLevel(password) !== null;
}

type AdminGuardResult =
  | { ok: true; supabaseAdmin: ReturnType<typeof getSupabaseAdmin>; level: AdminLevel }
  | { ok: false; response: NextResponse };

export function adminGuard(password: unknown): AdminGuardResult {
  const level = resolveAdminLevel(password);
  if (!level) {
    return { ok: false, response: jsonError('كلمة المرور غير صحيحة', 401) };
  }
  return { ok: true, supabaseAdmin: getSupabaseAdmin(), level };
}

export function safeString(value: unknown, max = 5000): string {
  if (typeof value !== 'string') return '';
  return value.trim().slice(0, max);
}

export function safeOptionalString(value: unknown, max = 5000): string | null {
  const s = safeString(value, max);
  return s === '' ? null : s;
}
```

## lib/groups/access.ts

```ts
// lib/groups/access.ts
// ⚠️ للاستخدام على السيرفر فقط

import { supabaseAdmin } from './supabase-admin';
import type { Settings } from '@/lib/types/groups';

export interface AccessToken {
  slug: string;
  label: string | null;
  is_active: boolean;
  study_year: string;
  expires_at: string | null;
}

/**
 * يجيب رابط الوصول المؤقت (slug) إذا كان فعّالاً
 */
export async function getAccessToken(
  slug: string
): Promise<AccessToken | null> {
  const { data } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from('sg_access_tokens')
    .select('*')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!data) return null;
  if (!data.is_active) return null;
  if (data.expires_at && new Date(data.expires_at).getTime() < Date.now())
    return null;

  return data as AccessToken;
}

/**
 * يجيب إعدادات النظام (صف واحد فقط)
 */
export async function getSettings(): Promise<Settings> {
  const { data } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from('sg_settings')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', 1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!data) {
    return {
      id: 1,
      target_size: 10,
      preferred_male: 5,
      preferred_female: 5,
      registration_open: true,
      allow_create: true,
      allow_join: true,
      session_expires_at: null,
      updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    };
  }
  return data as Settings;
}

export function isRegistrationOpen(s: Settings): boolean {
  return s.registration_open === true;
}
```

```ts
// lib/groups/api-response.ts

import { NextResponse } from 'next/server';

export function ok<T>(data: T) {
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: true, data });
}

export function fail(message: string, status = 400) {
  return NextResponse.json({ ok: false, error: message }, { status });
}

export function handleError(err: unknown) {
  const e = err as { message?: string; status?: number };
  const message = e?.message || 'حدث خطأ غير متوقع';
  const status = e?.status || 500;
  return fail(message, status);
}
```

## lib/groups/client.ts

```ts
// lib/groups/client.ts
'use client';

const TOKEN_KEY = 'sg_token';

export function saveToken(token: string): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, token);
}

export function getToken(): string | null {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return null;
  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

export function clearToken(): void {
  if (typeof window === 'undefined') return;
  localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

interface ApiBody {
  ok?: boolean;
  error?: string;
  data?: unknown;
}

export async function groupsFetch<T = unknown>(
  endpoint: string,
  body: Record<string, unknown> = {}
): Promise<T> {
  const token = getToken();
  const res = await fetch(endpoint, {
    method: 'POST',
    headers: {
      'Content-Type': 'application/json',
      ...(token ? { Authorization: `Bearer ${token}` } : {}),
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(body),
  });

  const json: ApiBody = await res.json().catch(() => ({}));

  if (!res.ok) {
    throw new Error(json?.error || `فشل الاتصال (${res.status})`);
  }
  if (json?.ok === false) {
    throw new Error(json?.error || 'حدث خطأ');
  }
  return (json?.data ?? json) as T;
}
```

```ts
// lib/groups/notify.ts

import { supabaseAdmin } from './supabase-admin';

/**
 * إرسال إشعار لطالب واحد (يظهر في مركز الإشعارات في الواجهة)
 */
export async function notify(
  studentId: string,
  type: string,
  title: string,
  body?: string,
  href?: string
): Promise<void> {
  await supabaseAdmin.from('sg_notifications').insert({
    student_id: studentId,
    type,
    title,
    body: body || null,
    href: href || null,
  });
}

/**
 * إرسال إشعار لعدة طلاب دفعة واحدة
 */
export async function notifyMany(
  studentIds: string[],
  type: string,
  title: string,
  body?: string,
  href?: string
): Promise<void> {
  if (studentIds.length === 0) return;
  const rows = studentIds.map((id) => ({
    student_id: id,
    type,
    title,
    body: body || null,
    href: href || null,
  }));
  await supabaseAdmin.from('sg_notifications').insert(rows);
}
```

## lib/groups/session.ts

```ts
// lib/groups/session.ts
// ⚠️ للاستخدام على السيرفر فقط (API routes)

import { randomBytes } from 'node:crypto';
import { supabaseAdmin } from './supabase-admin';
import type { Student } from '@/lib/types/groups';

// بغداد = UTC+3 (بدون توقيت صيفي)
const BAGHDAD_OFFSET_MS = 3 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

/**
 * يرجع "الآن" بتوقيت بغداد (كـ Date نتعامل معه عبر getUTC*)
 */
function getBaghdadNow(): Date {
  return new Date(Date.now() + BAGHDAD_OFFSET_MS);
}

/**
 * يحسب موعد "الأحد القادم 23:59:59 بتوقيت بغداد"
 * - إذا اليوم أحد وقبل 23:59 → نفس اليوم
 * - إذا اليوم أحد وبعد 23:59 → الأحد القادم
 * - أي يوم آخر → الأحد القادم
 */
export function getNextSundayDeadline(): Date {
  const baghdadNow = getBaghdadNow();
  const day = baghdadNow.getUTCDay(); // 0 = الأحد
  const daysUntilSunday = (7 - day) % 7;

  const target = new Date(baghdadNow);
  target.setUTCDate(target.getUTCDate() + daysUntilSunday);
  target.setUTCHours(23, 59, 59, 999);

  if (target.getTime() <= baghdadNow.getTime()) {
    target.setUTCDate(target.getUTCDate() + 7);
  }

  // نرجع للـ UTC الحقيقي
  return new Date(target.getTime() - BAGHDAD_OFFSET_MS);
}

/**
 * تاريخ انتهاء الجلسة:
 * - إذا الأدمن حدد موعداً في sg_settings → نستخدمه
 * - وإلا → الأحد القادم 23:59
 */
export async function getSessionExpiresAt(): Promise<Date> {
  const { data: settings } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from('sg_settings')
    .select('session_expires_at')
    .eq('id', 1)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (settings?.session_expires_at) {
    const d = new Date(settings.session_expires_at);
    if (!isNaN(d.getTime())) return d;
  }
  return getNextSundayDeadline();
}

export function generateToken(): string {
  return randomBytes(24).toString('hex');
}

/**
 * ينشئ جلسة جديدة ويحفظها في DB، ويرجع التوكن
 */
export async function createSession(studentId: string): Promise<string> {
  const token = generateToken();
  const expiresAt = await getSessionExpiresAt();

  const { error } = await supabaseAdmin.from('sg_sessions').insert({
    token,
    student_id: studentId,
    expires_at: expiresAt.toISOString(),
  });

  if (error) throw new Error('فشل إنشاء الجلسة: ' + error.message);
  return token;
}

/**
 * يقرأ التوكن من Authorization header ويجيب الطالب صاحب الجلسة.
 * يرجع null لو ما فيه توكن، أو منتهي، أو غير موجود.
 */
export async function getStudentFromRequest(
  req: Request
): Promise<Student | null> {
  const auth = req.headers.get('authorization') || '';
  const m = auth.match(/^Bearer\s+(.+)$/i);
  if (!m) return null;
  const token = m[1].trim();
  if (!token) return null;

  const { data: session } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from('sg_sessions')
    .select('student_id, expires_at')
    .eq('token', token)
    .maybeSingle();

  if (!session) return null;
  if (new Date(session.expires_at).getTime() < Date.now()) return null;

  const { data: student } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from('sg_students')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', session.student_id)
    .maybeSingle();

  return (student as Student) || null;
}

/**
 * نسخة صارمة: ترمي خطأ 401 إذا ما فيه طالب
 */
export async function requireStudent(req: Request): Promise<Student> {
  const student = await getStudentFromRequest(req);
  if (!student) {
    throw Object.assign(new Error('يجب تسجيل الدخول'), { status: 401 });
  }
  return student;
}
```

## lib/hooks/useDebounced.ts

```ts
'use client';

// lib/hooks/useDebounced.ts
import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';

export function useDebounced<T>(value: T, ms = 200): T {
  const [v, setV] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    const t = setTimeout(() => setV(value), ms);
    return () => clearTimeout(t);
  }, [value, ms]);
  return v;
}

```

## lib/hooks/useFullscreen.ts

```ts
'use client';

// lib/hooks/useFullscreen.ts
/** ملء الشاشة مع دعم webkit (Safari) وكشف الدعم. */
import { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from 'react';

type FsElement = HTMLElement & {
  webkitRequestFullscreen?: () => Promise<void> | void;
};

type FsDocument = Document & {
  webkitFullscreenElement?: Element | null;
  webkitExitFullscreen?: () => Promise<void> | void;
  webkitFullscreenEnabled?: boolean;
};

export function useFullscreen<T extends HTMLElement>() {
  const [el, setEl] = useState<T | null>(null);
  const [isFullscreen, setIsFullscreen] = useState(false);
  const [supported, setSupported] = useState(false);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const d = document as FsDocument;
    setSupported(Boolean(document.fullscreenEnabled || d.webkitFullscreenEnabled));
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (typeof document === 'undefined') return;
    const d = document as FsDocument;
    const onChange = (): void => {
      const cur = document.fullscreenElement ?? d.webkitFullscreenElement ?? null;
      setIsFullscreen(cur !== null && cur === el);
    };
    document.addEventListener('fullscreenchange', onChange);
    document.addEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange', onChange);
    return () => {
      document.removeEventListener('fullscreenchange', onChange);
      document.removeEventListener('webkitfullscreenchange', onChange);
    };
  }, [el]);

  const enter = useCallback(async (): Promise<boolean> => {
    if (!el) return false;
    const target = el as FsElement;
    try {
      if (target.requestFullscreen) await target.requestFullscreen();
      else if (target.webkitRequestFullscreen) await target.webkitRequestFullscreen();
      else return false;
      return true;
    } catch {
      return false;
    }
  }, [el]);

  const exit = useCallback(async (): Promise<void> => {
    const d = document as FsDocument;
    try {
      if (document.exitFullscreen) await document.exitFullscreen();
      else if (d.webkitExitFullscreen) await d.webkitExitFullscreen();
    } catch {
      /* تجاهل */
    }
  }, []);

  const toggle = useCallback((): Promise<boolean | void> => {
    return isFullscreen ? exit() : enter();
  }, [isFullscreen, enter, exit]);

  return { setRef: setEl, isFullscreen, supported, enter, exit, toggle };
}
```

## lib/hooks/useKeyboard.ts

```ts
'use client';

// lib/hooks/useKeyboard.ts
import { useEffect, useRef } from 'react';

export interface Shortcut {
  /** الحرف أو اسم المفتاح: 'k' أو '?' أو 'Escape' أو '1' */
  key: string;
  /** ⌘ أو Ctrl */
  meta?: boolean;
  alt?: boolean;
  /** إن لم يُحدَّد يُتجاهل Shift (مفيد لـ ؟ / ?) */
  shift?: boolean;
  /** يعمل أثناء الكتابة في حقل إدخال */
  allowInInput?: boolean;
  handler: () => void;
  description: string;
}

/** يطابق المفتاح الفعلي أو موضعه على الكيبورد، فيعمل مع التخطيط العربي (الحرف F = ب) */
function matchKey(e: KeyboardEvent, want: string): boolean {
  const w = want.toLowerCase();
  if (e.key.toLowerCase() === w) return true;
  if (/^[a-z]$/.test(w)) return e.code === `Key${w.toUpperCase()}`;
  if (/^[0-9]$/.test(w)) return e.code === `Digit${w}`;
  return false;
}

function match(e: KeyboardEvent, s: Shortcut): boolean {
  if (!matchKey(e, s.key)) return false;
  if (!!s.meta !== (e.metaKey || e.ctrlKey)) return false;
  if (!!s.alt !== e.altKey) return false;
  if (s.shift !== undefined && s.shift !== e.shiftKey) return false;
  return true;
}

function isEditable(el: EventTarget | null): boolean {
  if (!(el instanceof HTMLElement)) return false;
  const tag = el.tagName.toLowerCase();
  return tag === 'input' || tag === 'textarea' || tag === 'select' || el.isContentEditable;
}

export function useKeyboard(shortcuts: readonly Shortcut[], enabled = true): void {
  const ref = useRef(shortcuts);
  ref.current = shortcuts;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!enabled) return;
    const onKey = (e: KeyboardEvent): void => {
      if (e.isComposing) return;
      for (const s of ref.current) {
        if (isEditable(e.target) && !s.allowInInput) continue;
        if (match(e, s)) {
          e.preventDefault();
          s.handler();
          return;
        }
      }
    };
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [enabled]);
}

```

## lib/hooks/useLocalState.ts

```ts
'use client';

// lib/hooks/useLocalState.ts
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { readRaw, subscribeRaw, writeRaw } from '@/lib/storage';

/**
 * حالة محفوظة في localStorage. القراءة بعد التركيب (آمنة مع SSR).
 * الكتابة تتم خارج دالة التحديث حتى لا تتكرر في StrictMode.
 */
export function useLocalState<T>(key: string, initial: T, version = 1): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const initRef = useRef(initial);
  const valueRef = useRef<T>(initial);
  const [value, setValue] = useState<T>(initial);

  useEffect(() => {
    const load = (): void => {
      const v = readRaw(key, initRef.current, version);
      valueRef.current = v;
      setValue(v);
    };
    load();
    return subscribeRaw(key, load);
  }, [key, version]);

  const set = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (p: T) => T)(valueRef.current) : next;
      valueRef.current = resolved;
      setValue(resolved);
      writeRaw(key, resolved, version);
    },
    [key, version],
  );

  return [value, set];
}
```

## lib/storage.ts

```ts
// lib/storage.ts
/** تخزين محلي آمن: يتحمّل الوضع الخاص، امتلاء الحصة، وSSR. يدعم الاشتراك بين التبويبات. */

interface Entry<T> {
  version: number;
  data: T;
}

const PREFIX = 'lawazem:';
const EVENT = 'lawazem:storage';

function ok(): boolean {
  return typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof localStorage !== 'undefined';
}

export function readRaw<T>(key: string, fallback: T, version = 1): T {
  if (!ok()) return fallback;
  try {
    const raw = localStorage.getItem(PREFIX + key);
    if (!raw) return fallback;
    const parsed = JSON.parse(raw) as Entry<T>;
    if (parsed && typeof parsed === 'object' && 'version' in parsed && 'data' in parsed) {
      return parsed.version === version ? parsed.data : fallback;
    }
    return fallback;
  } catch {
    return fallback;
  }
}

export function writeRaw<T>(key: string, value: T, version = 1): void {
  if (!ok()) return;
  try {
    const entry: Entry<T> = { version, data: value };
    localStorage.setItem(PREFIX + key, JSON.stringify(entry));
    window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent(EVENT, { detail: { key } }));
  } catch {
    /* الحصة ممتلئة أو التخزين معطّل */
  }
}

export function subscribeRaw(key: string, cb: () => void): () => void {
  if (!ok()) return () => {};
  const onStorage = (e: StorageEvent): void => {
    if (e.key === PREFIX + key) cb();
  };
  const onLocal = (e: Event): void => {
    if ((e as CustomEvent<{ key: string }>).detail?.key === key) cb();
  };
  window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage);
  window.addEventListener(EVENT, onLocal);
  return () => {
    window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage);
    window.removeEventListener(EVENT, onLocal);
  };
}
```

```ts
// lib/study-sounds.ts
/**
 * أصوات جلسة الدراسة — أربع فئات:
 *  🌧️ أصوات هادئة (loop)

 *  🎙️ أدعية وقصائد (بدون loop)

 *  2. أضف سطراً في CUSTOM_SOUNDS أدناه

// ==================== Aggregate ====================
export const ALL_SOUNDS: readonly AmbientSound[] = [
  ...AMBIENT_SOUNDS,
  ...CUSTOM_SOUNDS,
];

export function soundsByCategory(cat: SoundCategory): AmbientSound[] {
  return ALL_SOUNDS.filter((s) => s.category === cat);
}

export function getAvailableCategories(): SoundCategory[] {
  const order: SoundCategory[] = ['ambient', 'quran', 'recitation', 'other'];
  return order.filter((cat) => soundsByCategory(cat).length > 0);
}

export function findSound(id: string): AmbientSound | null {
  return ALL_SOUNDS.find((s) => s.id === id) ?? null;
}

export const ALERT_SOUND = '/sounds/alert.mp3';
```

## lib/supabaseAdmin.ts

```ts
// lib/supabaseAdmin.ts
import { createClient, type SupabaseClient } from '@supabase/supabase-js';

let cached: SupabaseClient | null = null;

export function getSupabaseAdmin(): SupabaseClient {
  if (cached) return cached;

  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL;
  const key = process.env.SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY;

  if (!url || !key) {
    throw new Error(
      'متغيرات بيئة Supabase Admin ناقصة: تأكد من NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL و SUPABASE_SECRET_KEY'
    );
  }

  cached = createClient(url, key, {
    auth: { persistSession: false, autoRefreshToken: false },
  });
  return cached;
}
```

## lib/telegram.ts

```ts
// lib/telegram.ts

const API_BASE = 'https://api.telegram.org';

// ==================== Types ====================
export interface InlineKeyboardButton {
  text: string;
  callback_data?: string;
  url?: string;
}

export interface InlineKeyboardMarkup {
  inline_keyboard: InlineKeyboardButton[][];
}

import type {
  ReplyKeyboardMarkup,
  ReplyKeyboardRemove,
} from './telegram/types';

export interface SendMessageOptions {
  parse_mode?: 'HTML' | 'MarkdownV2' | 'Markdown';
  disable_web_page_preview?: boolean;
  reply_markup?:
    | InlineKeyboardMarkup
    | ReplyKeyboardMarkup
    | ReplyKeyboardRemove;
}

// ==================== Token ====================
function getToken(): string {
  const token = process.env.TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN;
  if (!token) throw new Error('TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN غير مُعد');
  return token;
}

export function getWebhookSecret(): string | undefined {
  return process.env.TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET;
}

// ==================== Send Message ====================
export async function sendMessage(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  options: SendMessageOptions = {}
): Promise<boolean> {
  const token = getToken();
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/bot${token}/sendMessage`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        chat_id: chatId,
        text,
        parse_mode: options.parse_mode ?? 'HTML',
        disable_web_page_preview: options.disable_web_page_preview ?? true,
        reply_markup: options.reply_markup,
      }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) {
      const body = await res.text();
      console.error('[tg] sendMessage failed:', res.status, body.slice(0, 300));
      return false;
    }
    return true;
  } catch (err) {
    console.error('[tg] sendMessage error:', err);
    return false;
  }
}

// ==================== Edit Message ====================
export async function editMessageText(
  chatId: number,
  messageId: number,
  text: string,
  options: SendMessageOptions = {}
): Promise<boolean> {
  const token = getToken();
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/bot${token}/editMessageText`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        chat_id: chatId,
        message_id: messageId,
        text,
        parse_mode: options.parse_mode ?? 'HTML',
        disable_web_page_preview: options.disable_web_page_preview ?? true,
        reply_markup: options.reply_markup,
      }),
    });
    return res.ok;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// ==================== Answer Callback ====================
export async function answerCallbackQuery(
  callbackQueryId: string,
  text?: string,
  showAlert = false
): Promise<void> {
  const token = getToken();
  try {
    await fetch(`${API_BASE}/bot${token}/answerCallbackQuery`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify({
        callback_query_id: callbackQueryId,
        text,
        show_alert: showAlert,
      }),
    });
  } catch {
    /* تجاهل */
  }
}

// ==================== Set / Delete Webhook ====================
export async function setWebhook(
  webhookUrl: string,
  secretToken?: string
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; description: string }> {
  const token = getToken();
  const payload: Record<string, unknown> = {
    url: webhookUrl,
    allowed_updates: ['message', 'callback_query'],
    drop_pending_updates: true,
  };
  if (secretToken) payload.secret_token = secretToken;

  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/bot${token}/setWebhook`, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
      body: JSON.stringify(payload),
    });
    const data = (await res.json()) as { ok?: boolean; description?: string };
    return {
      ok: !!data.ok,
      description: data.description ?? (data.ok ? 'تم بنجاح' : 'فشل'),
    };
  } catch (err) {
    return {
      ok: false,
      description: err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'خطأ غير معروف',
    };
  }
}

export async function deleteWebhook(): Promise<boolean> {
  const token = getToken();
  try {
    const res = await fetch(`${API_BASE}/bot${token}/deleteWebhook`, {
      method: 'POST',
    });
    return res.ok;
  } catch {
    return false;
  }
}

// ==================== Helpers ====================
export function escapeHtml(s: string): string {
  return s
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;');
}

// ==================== Stage Helpers ====================
export const STAGE_MAP: Record<string, string> = {
  '1': 'المرحلة الأولى',
  '2': 'المرحلة الثانية',
  '3': 'المرحلة الثالثة',
};

export const STAGE_REVERSE: Record<string, string> = {
  'المرحلة الأولى': '1',
  'المرحلة الثانية': '2',
  'المرحلة الثالثة': '3',
};

export function stageLabel(code: string): string {
  return STAGE_MAP[code] ?? code;
}
// ==================== Helper: getAdminChatIds ====================
// (يُستخدم من telegram-admins.ts، لا يحتاج تعديل الملف)

// ==================== Message Helpers ====================
export function bold(text: string): string {
  return `<b>${text}</b>`;
}

export function code(text: string): string {
  return `<code>${text}</code>`;
}

export function italic(text: string): string {
  return `<i>${text}</i>`;
}

export function truncate(text: string, max = 3500): string {
  if (text.length <= max) return text;
  return text.slice(0, max - 1) + '…';
}
```

```ts
// lib/telegram/handlers/admin.ts
import {
  sendMessage,
  editMessageText,
  answerCallbackQuery,
  escapeHtml,
} from '../../telegram';
import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '../../supabaseAdmin';
import {
  listAdmins,
  registerAdmin,
  deactivateAdmin,
  roleLabel,
  type TelegramAdmin,
  type AdminRole,
} from '../../telegram-admins';
import { sendAnnouncement } from '../../telegram-notifications';
import { setSession, clearSession, getSession } from '../sessions';
import {
  pendingItemKeyboard,
  roleKeyboard,
  SUPER_ADMIN_MENU,
  ADMIN_MENU,
} from './menus';
import { ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS } from '../types';
import { countPendingInquiries } from '../inquiries';

// ==================== Admin Help ====================
export async function sendAdminHelp(
  chatId: number,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  const isSuper = admin.role === 'super_admin';
  const lines: string[] = [];

  lines.push(`📖 <b>دليل ${isSuper ? 'المشرف الأعلى' : 'المشرف'}</b>`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`👤 دورك: <b>${roleLabel(admin.role)}</b>`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('👇 استخدم الأزرار الثابتة بالأسفل، أو الأوامر النصية.');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  lines.push('🗺️ <b>الأوامر المتاحة</b>');
  lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('📢 <code>/announce</code> — إنشاء تبليغ بقوالب جاهزة');

  if (isSuper) {
    lines.push('📋 <code>/pending</code> — التبليغات قيد المراجعة');
    lines.push('📜 <code>/history</code> — آخر التبليغات');
    lines.push('📊 <code>/stats</code> — إحصائيات البوت');
    lines.push('📮 <code>/inquiries</code> — الاستفسارات');
    lines.push('👥 <code>/admins</code> — قائمة المشرفين');
    lines.push('➕ <code>/add_admin</code> — إضافة مشرف');
    lines.push('➖ <code>/remove_admin</code> — حذف مشرف');
  } else {
    lines.push('📋 <code>/pending</code> — عرض المعلقة (بدون موافقة)');
  }

  lines.push('❌ <code>/cancel</code> — إلغاء أي عملية');
  lines.push('📖 <code>/admin_help</code> — هذا الدليل');

  await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'), {
    reply_markup: isSuper ? SUPER_ADMIN_MENU : ADMIN_MENU,
  });
}

// ==================== Pending List ====================
export async function handlePendingList(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const { data } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .select('*')
    .eq('status', 'pending')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(15);

  const items = (data ?? []) as Array<{
    id: string;
    title: string;
    body: string;
    stage: string | null;
    created_by: string;
  }>;

  if (items.length === 0) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ لا توجد تبليغات بانتظار المراجعة.');
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(chatId, `📋 <b>${items.length}</b> تبليغ بانتظار المراجعة:`);

  for (const a of items) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    lines.push(`📢 <b>${escapeHtml(a.title)}</b>`);
    lines.push(
      `🎯 ${
        a.stage ? escapeHtml(a.stage) : 'كل المراحل'
      } • 👤 ${escapeHtml(a.created_by)}`,
    );
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(escapeHtml(a.body));
    await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'), {
      reply_markup: pendingItemKeyboard(a.id),
    });
  }
}

// ==================== Approve ====================
export async function handleApprove(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    from: { id: number };
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  id: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  if (admin.role !== 'super_admin') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, '❌ غير مصرح — تحتاج صلاحية مشرف أعلى');
    return;
  }

  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { data: existing } = await supabase
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .select('status')
    .eq('id', id)
    .maybeSingle<{ status: string }>();

  if (!existing) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'التبليغ غير موجود');
    return;
  }
  if (existing.status !== 'pending') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'تمت معالجة هذا التبليغ مسبقاً');
    return;
  }

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, '⏳ جاري الإرسال...');

  await supabase
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .update({
      status: 'approved',
      reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      reviewed_by: 'super_admin',
    })
    .eq('id', id);

  let result: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof sendAnnouncement>>;
  try {
    result = await sendAnnouncement(id);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'خطأ غير معروف';
    await supabase
      .from('telegram_announcements')
      .update({ status: 'failed', sent_error: msg })
      .eq('id', id);
    await sendMessage(chatId, `❌ فشل الإرسال: ${escapeHtml(msg)}`);
    return;
  }

  if (result.error) {
    await supabase
      .from('telegram_announcements')
      .update({
        status: 'failed',
        sent_error: result.error,
        sent_count: result.sent,
      })
      .eq('id', id);
    await sendMessage(chatId, `❌ فشل الإرسال: ${escapeHtml(result.error)}`);
    return;
  }

  await supabase
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .update({
      status: 'sent',
      sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      sent_count: result.sent,
      sent_error: result.failed > 0 ? `فشل ${result.failed}` : null,
    })
    .eq('id', id);

  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, '✅ تم الإرسال', {
      reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [] },
    });
  }

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `✅ <b>تم الإرسال</b>\n\n📤 نجح: ${result.sent}\n❌ فشل: ${result.failed}`,
  );
}

// ==================== Reject ====================
export async function handleRejectStart(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  id: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  if (admin.role !== 'super_admin') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, '❌ غير مصرح');
    return;
  }

  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  await setSession(chatId, 'reject', 'awaiting_reason', {
    announcement_id: id,
  });

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    '📝 اكتب <b>سبب الرفض</b> (أو أرسل <code>-</code> بدون سبب) — أو /cancel للإلغاء:',
  );
}

export async function handleRejectText(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  if (admin.role !== 'super_admin') {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'reject') {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const id = session.flow_data.announcement_id as string | undefined;
  if (!id) {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const trimmed = text.trim();
  const note = trimmed === '-' || trimmed === '' ? null : trimmed.slice(0, 500);

  const { error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .update({
      status: 'rejected',
      reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      reviewed_by: 'super_admin',
      reviewed_note: note,
    })
    .eq('id', id)
    .eq('status', 'pending');

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (error) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ فشل الرفض. حاول مرة ثانية.');
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ تم رفض التبليغ.');
}

// ==================== Delete ====================
export async function handleDeleteAnnouncement(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  id: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  if (admin.role !== 'super_admin') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, '❌ غير مصرح');
    return;
  }

  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  await getSupabaseAdmin().from('telegram_announcements').delete().eq('id', id);
  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'تم الحذف');
  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, '🗑 تم حذف التبليغ.', {
      reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [] },
    });
  } else {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '🗑 تم حذف التبليغ.');
  }
}

// ==================== History ====================
export async function handleHistory(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const { data } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .select('id, title, status, sent_count, sent_at, created_at, reviewed_note')
    .in('status', ['sent', 'rejected', 'failed'])
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(10);

  const items = (data ?? []) as Array<{
    id: string;
    title: string;
    status: string;
    sent_count: number;
    sent_at: string | null;
    created_at: string;
    reviewed_note: string | null;
  }>;

  if (items.length === 0) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, 'لا يوجد سجل بعد.');
    return;
  }

  const lines: string[] = ['📜 <b>آخر التبليغات</b>', ''];
  for (const a of items) {
    const emoji =
      a.status === 'sent' ? '✅' : a.status === 'rejected' ? '❌' : '⚠️';
    lines.push(`${emoji} <b>${escapeHtml(a.title)}</b>`);
    if (a.status === 'sent') lines.push(`  أُرسل لـ ${a.sent_count} مشترك`);
    if (a.status === 'rejected' && a.reviewed_note)
      lines.push(`  ${escapeHtml(a.reviewed_note)}`);
    lines.push('');
  }
  await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'));
}

// ==================== Stats ====================
export async function handleStats(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const supabaseAdmin = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const [
    subsCount,
    pendingAnnCount,
    sentAnnCount,
    pendingInqCount,
    adminsCount,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    supabaseAdmin
      .from('telegram_subscribers')
      .select('chat_id', { count: 'exact', head: true }),
    supabaseAdmin
      .from('telegram_announcements')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('status', 'pending'),
    supabaseAdmin
      .from('telegram_announcements')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('status', 'sent'),
    countPendingInquiries(),
    supabaseAdmin
      .from('telegram_admins')
      .select('chat_id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('is_active', true),
  ]);

  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push('📊 <b>إحصائيات البوت</b>');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`👥 المشتركون: <b>${subsCount.count ?? 0}</b>`);
  lines.push(`👤 المشرفون النشطون: <b>${adminsCount.count ?? 0}</b>`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`📋 تبليغات منتظرة: <b>${pendingAnnCount.count ?? 0}</b>`);
  lines.push(`📤 تبليغات أُرسلت: <b>${sentAnnCount.count ?? 0}</b>`);
  lines.push(`📮 استفسارات منتظرة: <b>${pendingInqCount}</b>`);

  await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'));
}

export async function handleAddAdminStart(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  await setSession(chatId, 'add_admin', 'awaiting_chat_id', {});

    chatId,
    '👤 <b>إضافة مشرف جديد</b>\n\nأرسل <b>Chat ID</b> أو <b>@username</b> للمشرف:\n' +
      '<i>يجب أن يبدأ محادثة مع البوت أول مرة.</i>',

export async function handleAddAdminChatId(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const clean = text.trim().replace(/^@/, '');
  let targetId: number | null = null;

  if (/^-?\d+$/.test(clean)) {
    targetId = Number(clean);
  } else {
    const { data } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
      .from('telegram_subscribers')
      .select('chat_id')
      .ilike('username', clean)
      .maybeSingle<{ chat_id: number }>();
    if (data) targetId = data.chat_id;
  }

  if (!targetId) {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      '❌ ما لقيت هذا المستخدم. تأكد من الـChat ID أو أن اليوزر بدأ محادثة مع البوت.',
    );
    return;
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'add_admin', 'awaiting_role', {
    target_chat_id: targetId,
  });

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `👤 تم اختيار: <code>${targetId}</code>\n\nاختر الدور:`,
    { reply_markup: roleKeyboard() },
  );
}

export async function handleAddAdminRole(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  role: AdminRole,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'add_admin') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'انتهت الجلسة');
    return;
  }

  const targetId = session.flow_data.target_chat_id as number | undefined;
  if (!targetId) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'لا يوجد هدف');
    return;
  }

  const { data: sub } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_subscribers')
    .select('first_name, username')
    .eq('chat_id', targetId)
    .maybeSingle<{ first_name: string | null; username: string | null }>();

  const result = await registerAdmin({
    chatId: targetId,
    username: sub?.username ?? null,
    firstName: sub?.first_name ?? `Admin ${targetId}`,
    role,
    addedBy: chatId,
  });

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (!result.ok) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, `فشل: ${result.error ?? ''}`, true);
    return;
  }

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'تمت الإضافة');

  const confirm = `✅ تم إضافة <code>${targetId}</code> بدور <b>${roleLabel(
    role,
  )}</b>.`;
  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, confirm);
  } else {
    await sendMessage(chatId, confirm);
  }

  try {
    await sendMessage(
      targetId,
      `🎉 <b>تم تفعيلك في بوت لوازم</b>\n\nالدور: <b>${roleLabel(role)}</b>\n\n` +
        (role === 'super_admin'
          ? 'يمكنك الموافقة على التبليغات وإرسالها عبر /pending.'
          : role === 'admin'
            ? 'يمكنك إنشاء تبليغات عبر /announce، وسيراجعها المشرف الأعلى.'
            : 'يمكنك إنشاء تبليغات عبر /announce.') +
        '\n\n📖 اكتب /admin_help للمزيد',
      { reply_markup: role === 'super_admin' ? SUPER_ADMIN_MENU : ADMIN_MENU },
    );
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

// ==================== Remove Admin ====================
export async function handleRemoveAdmin(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const parts = text.split(/\s+/).slice(1);
  if (parts.length === 0 || !/^-?\d+$/.test(parts[0])) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ الصيغة: <code>/remove_admin CHAT_ID</code>');
    return;
  }
  const targetId = Number(parts[0]);

  if (targetId === chatId) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ ما تكدر تحذف نفسك.');
    return;
  }

  const result = await deactivateAdmin(targetId);
  if (!result.ok) {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      `❌ فشل الحذف: ${escapeHtml(result.error ?? '')}`,
    );
    return;
  }
  await sendMessage(chatId, `✅ تم حذف <code>${targetId}</code>.`);
}

// ==================== Quick Add Admin ====================
export async function quickAddAdmin(
  chatId: number,
  targetId: number,
  role: AdminRole,
): Promise<void> {
  const { data: sub } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_subscribers')
    .select('first_name, username')
    .eq('chat_id', targetId)
    .maybeSingle<{ first_name: string | null; username: string | null }>();

  const result = await registerAdmin({
    chatId: targetId,
    username: sub?.username ?? null,
    firstName: sub?.first_name ?? `Admin ${targetId}`,
    role,
    addedBy: chatId,
  });

  if (!result.ok) {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      `❌ فشل الإضافة: ${escapeHtml(result.error ?? '')}`,
    );
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `✅ تم إضافة <code>${targetId}</code> بدور <b>${roleLabel(role)}</b>.`,
  );

  try {
    await sendMessage(
      targetId,
      `🎉 <b>تم تفعيلك في بوت لوازم</b>\n\nالدور: <b>${roleLabel(role)}</b>\n\n📖 اكتب /admin_help للمزيد`,
      { reply_markup: role === 'super_admin' ? SUPER_ADMIN_MENU : ADMIN_MENU },
    );
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

// ==================== Menu Button Router ====================
export async function handleAdminMenuButton(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const isSuper = admin.role === 'super_admin';

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.newAnnounce) {
    const { handleAnnounceStart } = await import('./announce');
    await handleAnnounceStart(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.pending) {
    await handlePendingList(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.inquiries && isSuper) {
    const { handleInquiriesList } = await import('./inquiries');
    await handleInquiriesList(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.admins && isSuper) {
    await handleListAdmins(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.stats && isSuper) {
    await handleStats(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.help) {
    await sendAdminHelp(chatId, admin);
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}
```

```ts
// lib/telegram/handlers/announce.ts
import {
  sendMessage,
  editMessageText,
  answerCallbackQuery,
  escapeHtml,
  STAGE_MAP,
} from '../../telegram';
import {
  setSession,
  clearSession,
  getSession,
  emptyAnnouncementDraft,
  type AnnouncementDraft,
} from '../sessions';
import {
  templatePickerKeyboard,
  draftPreviewKeyboard,
  stageListKeyboard,
  backToDraftKeyboard,
} from './menus';
import { getTemplate } from '../templates';
import { notifySuperAdminsNewAnnouncementPending } from '../notify-admins';
import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '../../supabaseAdmin';
import type { TelegramAdmin } from '../../telegram-admins';

// ==================== Preview Builder ====================
function buildPreview(draft: AnnouncementDraft): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push('📢 <b>معاينة التبليغ</b>');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(
    `🎯 المرحلة: <b>${
      draft.stage ? escapeHtml(draft.stage) : 'كل المراحل'
    }</b>`,
  );

  if (draft.templateId) {
    const tpl = getTemplate(draft.templateId);
    if (tpl) lines.push(`🏷️ القالب: ${tpl.emoji} ${escapeHtml(tpl.label)}`);
  }
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  if (draft.title) {
    lines.push(`<b>${escapeHtml(draft.title)}</b>`);
  } else {
    lines.push('<i>(لا يوجد عنوان)</i>');
  }
  lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  lines.push('');
  if (draft.body) {
    lines.push(escapeHtml(draft.body));
  } else {
    lines.push('<i>(لا يوجد نص)</i>');
  }
  if (draft.link_url) {
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(`🔗 ${escapeHtml(draft.link_label || draft.link_url)}`);
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

export async function handleTemplatePick(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    from: { id: number };
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  templateId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId || !messageId) return;

  const tpl = getTemplate(templateId);
  if (!tpl) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'قالب غير معروف');
    return;
  }

  const draft: AnnouncementDraft = {
    ...emptyAnnouncementDraft(),
    templateId: tpl.id,
    title: tpl.title,
    body: tpl.body,
    link_label: tpl.linkLabel ?? null,
  };

  await setSession(chatId, 'announce', 'draft', { draft });
  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, `تم اختيار ${tpl.label}`);

  await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, buildPreview(draft), {
    reply_markup: draftPreviewKeyboard(),
  });
}

// ==================== Stage Picked ====================
export async function handleStagePick(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  code: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'announce') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'انتهت الجلسة');
    return;
  }

  const draft = { ...(session.flow_data.draft as AnnouncementDraft) };

  if (code === 'all') {
    draft.stage = null;
  } else {
    const stage = STAGE_MAP[code];
    if (!stage) {
      await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'مرحلة غير معروفة');
      return;
    }
    draft.stage = stage;
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'announce', 'draft', { draft });

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, draft.stage ?? 'كل المراحل');

  const text = buildPreview(draft);
  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, text, {
      reply_markup: draftPreviewKeyboard(),
    });
  } else {
    await sendMessage(chatId, text, { reply_markup: draftPreviewKeyboard() });
  }
}

// ==================== Text Input Router ====================
export async function handleAnnounceTextInput(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  step: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'announce') {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const draft = { ...(session.flow_data.draft as AnnouncementDraft) };
  const trimmed = text.trim();

  if (step === 'edit_title') {
    if (trimmed.length < 3 || trimmed.length > 200) {
      await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ العنوان يجب أن يكون بين 3 و 200 حرف.');
      return;
    }
    draft.title = trimmed;
  } else if (step === 'edit_body') {
    if (trimmed.length < 5 || trimmed.length > 2000) {
      await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ النص يجب أن يكون بين 5 و 2000 حرف.');
      return;
    }
    draft.body = trimmed;
  } else if (step === 'edit_link_url') {
    if (trimmed === '-') {
      draft.link_url = null;
      draft.link_label = null;
    } else {
      try {
        const u = new URL(trimmed);
        if (u.protocol !== 'http:' && u.protocol !== 'https:') throw new Error();
      } catch {
        await sendMessage(
          chatId,
          '❌ رابط غير صالح. يجب أن يبدأ بـ https://',
        );
        return;
      }
      draft.link_url = trimmed;
    }
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'announce', 'draft', { draft });
  await sendMessage(chatId, buildPreview(draft), {
    reply_markup: draftPreviewKeyboard(),
  });
}

// ==================== Submit ====================
export async function handleAnnounceSubmit(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'announce') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'انتهت الجلسة');
    return;
  }

  const draft = session.flow_data.draft as AnnouncementDraft;
  if (!draft.title || !draft.body) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'العنوان والنص مطلوبان', true);
    return;
  }

  const supabaseAdmin = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .insert({
      title: draft.title,
      body: draft.body,
      stage: draft.stage,
      link_url: draft.link_url,
      link_label: draft.link_label,
      created_by: admin.first_name,
      status: 'pending',
    })
    .select('id')
    .single<{ id: string }>();

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (error || !data) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'فشل الحفظ', true);
    await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ فشل إنشاء التبليغ. حاول مرة ثانية.');
    return;
  }

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'تم الإرسال للمراجعة');

  const text = `✅ <b>تم إرسال التبليغ للمراجعة</b>\n\nرقم: <code>${data.id.slice(
    0,
    8,
  )}</code>\n\n${
    admin.role === 'super_admin'
      ? 'يمكنك الموافقة الآن من /pending.'
      : 'سيتم إعلامك عند الموافقة أو الرفض.'
  }`;

  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, text);
  } else {
    await sendMessage(chatId, text);
  }

  // إشعار السوبر أدمن (fire-and-forget)
  void notifySuperAdminsNewAnnouncementPending({
    id: data.id,
    title: draft.title,
    body: draft.body,
    stage: draft.stage,
    created_by: admin.first_name,
  });
}

// ==================== Cancel ====================
export async function handleAnnounceCancel(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  await clearSession(chatId);
  await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ تم الإلغاء.');
}
```

```ts
// lib/telegram/handlers/inquiries.ts
import {
  sendMessage,
  answerCallbackQuery,
  escapeHtml,
} from '../../telegram';
import { getSubscriber } from '../subscribers';
import {
  createInquiry,
  listPendingInquiries,
  countPendingInquiries,
  getInquiry,
  answerInquiry,
  closeInquiry,
  formatInquiryForAdmin,
} from '../inquiries';
import { setSession, clearSession, getSession } from '../sessions';
import { notifySuperAdminsNewInquiry } from '../notify-admins';
import { inquiryActionsKeyboard, STUDENT_MENU } from './menus';

// ==================== Student: Start ====================
export async function handleInquiryStart(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);
  if (!sub || !sub.stage) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, 'يجب أن تكمل التسجيل أولاً.\nاكتب /start');
    return;
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'inquiry', 'awaiting_question', {});
  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `📮 <b>استفسار جديد</b>\n\n✍️ اكتب سؤالك أو استفسارك في رسالة واحدة، وسيصل للإدارة مباشرة.`,
    {
      reply_markup: {
        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '❌ إلغاء', callback_data: 'inq_cancel' }]],
      },
    },
  );
}

// ==================== Student: Submit ====================
export async function handleInquiryText(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);

  const result = await createInquiry({
    chatId,
    studentName: sub?.first_name ?? null,
    stage: sub?.stage ?? null,
    question: text,
  });

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (!result.ok) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, `❌ فشل الإرسال: ${result.error}`, {
      reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
    });
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `✅ <b>وصلنا استفسارك</b>\n\nسيتم الرد عليك في أقرب وقت. شكراً لك 🌟`,
    { reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU },
  );

  // إشعار السوبر أدمن (fire-and-forget)
  void notifySuperAdminsNewInquiry(result.inquiry);
}

// ==================== Admin: List Pending ====================
export async function handleInquiriesList(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const pending = await listPendingInquiries(10);

  if (pending.length === 0) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ لا توجد استفسارات بانتظار الرد.');
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `📮 <b>${pending.length}</b> استفسار بانتظار الرد:`,
  );

  for (const inq of pending) {
    const text = formatInquiryForAdmin(inq, escapeHtml);
    await sendMessage(chatId, text, {
      reply_markup: inquiryActionsKeyboard(inq.id),
    });
  }
}

// ==================== Admin: Start Reply ====================
export async function handleInquiryReplyStart(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  inquiryId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const inq = await getInquiry(inquiryId);
  if (!inq || inq.status !== 'pending') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'الاستفسار غير موجود أو تمت معالجته');
    return;
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'inquiry', 'awaiting_reply', {
    inquiry_id: inquiryId,
  });

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `💬 <b>الرد على استفسار</b>\n\n👤 ${escapeHtml(
      inq.student_name ?? 'غير معروف',
    )}\n\n❓ ${escapeHtml(inq.question)}\n\n✍️ اكتب ردك الآن:`,
    {
      reply_markup: {
        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '❌ إلغاء', callback_data: 'inq_cancel' }]],
      },
    },
  );
}

// ==================== Admin: Submit Reply ====================
export async function handleInquiryReplyText(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  adminChatId: number,
): Promise<void> {
  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'inquiry') {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const inquiryId = session.flow_data.inquiry_id as string | undefined;
  if (!inquiryId) {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      '❌ لم أجد الاستفسار، حاول مرة ثانية من القائمة.',
    );
    return;
  }

  const result = await answerInquiry({
    id: inquiryId,
    reply: text,
    adminChatId,
  });

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (!result.ok || !result.inquiry) {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      `❌ فشل الحفظ: ${result.error ?? 'غير معروف'}`,
    );
    return;
  }

  const inq = result.inquiry;

  // إرسال الرد للطالب
  const studentLines: string[] = [];
  studentLines.push('📬 <b>ردّ الإدارة على استفسارك</b>');
  studentLines.push('');
  studentLines.push('❓ <b>سؤالك:</b>');
  studentLines.push(escapeHtml(inq.question));
  studentLines.push('');
  studentLines.push('💬 <b>الرد:</b>');
  studentLines.push(escapeHtml(text));

  try {
    await sendMessage(inq.chat_id, studentLines.join('\n'), {
      reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
    });
  } catch {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      '⚠️ تم الحفظ لكن تعذّر إرسال الرد للطالب.',
    );
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ تم إرسال الرد للطالب.');
}

// ==================== Admin: Close ====================
export async function handleInquiryClose(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  inquiryId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const result = await closeInquiry(inquiryId);
  await answerCallbackQuery(
    cb.id,
    result.ok ? 'تم الإغلاق' : result.error ?? 'فشل',
  );

  if (result.ok && result.inquiry) {
    // إشعار الطالب بأن استفساره تم الاطلاع عليه
    try {
      await sendMessage(
        result.inquiry.chat_id,
        `📭 تم الاطلاع على استفسارك وإغلاقه. إن كان لديك سؤال آخر، أرسل استفساراً جديداً.`,
        { reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU },
      );
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }

    await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ تم إغلاق الاستفسار.');
  }
}

// ==================== Cancel ====================
export async function handleInquiryCancel(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  await clearSession(chatId);
  await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ تم الإلغاء.', {
    reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
  });
}

// ==================== Count ====================
export async function getPendingInquiriesCount(): Promise<number> {
  return countPendingInquiries();
}
```

```ts
// lib/telegram/handlers/menus.ts
import type {
  ReplyKeyboardMarkup,
  ReplyKeyboardRemove,
} from '../types';
import { ANNOUNCEMENT_TEMPLATES } from '../templates';
import { STAGES } from '../../constants';
import type { InlineKeyboardMarkup } from '../../telegram';

// ==================== Reply Keyboards ====================
export { STUDENT_MENU_TEXTS, ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS } from '../types';

    [{ text: '📚 الملازم' }, { text: '🔍 القاموس' }],

    [{ text: '⚙️ الإعدادات' }, { text: '❓ مساعدة' }],

    [{ text: '📊 الإحصائيات' }, { text: '📖 دليل المشرف' }],
    [{ text: '📚 الملازم' }, { text: '⚙️ الإعدادات' }],
  ],
  resize_keyboard: true,
  is_persistent: true,
};

export const ADMIN_MENU: ReplyKeyboardMarkup = {
  keyboard: [
    [{ text: '📢 تبليغ جديد' }],
    [{ text: '📚 الملازم' }, { text: '⚙️ الإعدادات' }],
    [{ text: '📖 دليل المشرف' }],
  ],
  resize_keyboard: true,
  is_persistent: true,
};

export function removeReplyKeyboard(): ReplyKeyboardRemove {
  return { remove_keyboard: true };
}

// ==================== Announcement Templates Picker ====================
export function templatePickerKeyboard(): InlineKeyboardMarkup {
  const rows: { text: string; callback_data: string }[][] = [];
  const templates = ANNOUNCEMENT_TEMPLATES;

  for (let i = 0; i < templates.length; i += 2) {
    const row = [
      {
        text: `${templates[i].emoji} ${templates[i].label}`,
        callback_data: `tpl_pick:${templates[i].id}`,
      },
    ];
    if (templates[i + 1]) {
      row.push({
        text: `${templates[i + 1].emoji} ${templates[i + 1].label}`,
        callback_data: `tpl_pick:${templates[i + 1].id}`,
      });
    }
    rows.push(row);
  }

  rows.push([{ text: '❌ إلغاء', callback_data: 'ann_cancel' }]);
  return { inline_keyboard: rows };
}

// ==================== Draft Preview Actions ====================
export function draftPreviewKeyboard(): InlineKeyboardMarkup {
  return {
    inline_keyboard: [
      [
        { text: '✏️ تعديل العنوان', callback_data: 'ann_edit_title' },
        { text: '✏️ تعديل النص', callback_data: 'ann_edit_body' },
      ],
      [
        { text: '🎯 اختيار المرحلة', callback_data: 'ann_choose_stage' },
        { text: '🔗 إضافة رابط', callback_data: 'ann_add_link' },
      ],
      [{ text: '✅ إرسال للمراجعة', callback_data: 'ann_submit' }],
      [{ text: '❌ إلغاء', callback_data: 'ann_cancel' }],
    ],
  };
}

// ==================== Stage Picker ====================
export function stageListKeyboard(): InlineKeyboardMarkup {
  const rows: { text: string; callback_data: string }[][] = STAGES.map(
    (s, i) => [{ text: s, callback_data: `ann_stage:${i + 1}` }],
  );
  rows.push([{ text: '🌐 كل المراحل', callback_data: 'ann_stage:all' }]);
  rows.push([{ text: '↩️ رجوع', callback_data: 'ann_back_to_draft' }]);
  return { inline_keyboard: rows };
}

// ==================== Announcement Actions ====================
export function announceApprovalKeyboard(id: string): InlineKeyboardMarkup {
  return {
```
