## components\Reveal.tsx

```tsx
// components/Reveal.tsx
'use client';

import {
  useEffect,
  useRef,
  type CSSProperties,
  type ElementType,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';

type RevealTag = 'div' | 'li' | 'section' | 'article';

interface RevealProps {
  children: ReactNode;
  as?: RevealTag;
  /** تأخير الظهور بالمللي ثانية (للـ stagger) */
  delay?: number;
  /** مقدار الإزاحة الرأسية للأسفل قبل الظهور */
  y?: number;
  className?: string;
  style?: CSSProperties;
}

export function Reveal({
  children,
  as: Tag = 'div',
  delay = 0,
  y = 12,
  className = '',
  style,
}: RevealProps) {
  const ref = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const Component: ElementType = Tag;

  useEffect(() => {
    const el = ref.current;
    if (!el) return;

    // احترم تفضيل تقليل الحركة — أظهر مباشرة
    if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
      el.dataset.revealed = 'true';
      return;
    }

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      ([entry]) => {
        if (entry.isIntersecting) {
          el.dataset.revealed = 'true';
          observer.disconnect();
        }
      },
      {
        threshold: 0.08,
        rootMargin: '0px 0px -40px 0px',
      },
    );

    observer.observe(el);
    return () => observer.disconnect();
  }, []);

  const combinedStyle = {
    ...style,
    '--reveal-delay': `${delay}ms`,
    '--reveal-y': `${y}px`,
  } as CSSProperties;

  // ✅ الحل: نستخدم callback ref بدل ref object
  // لأن Component قد يكون div / li / section / article
  // وTypeScript لا يستطيع توحيد أنواع الـrefs لهذه الحالات.
  // الـcallback ref يعمل مع جميع الاحتمالات (contravariance).
  const setRef = (el: HTMLElement | null) => {
    ref.current = el;
  };

  return (
    <Component
      ref={setRef}
      className={`reveal-scroll ${className}`.trim()}
      style={combinedStyle}
    >
      {children}
    </Component>
  );
}
```

## components\ThemeProvider.tsx

```tsx
// components/ThemeProvider.tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';

type Theme = 'light' | 'dark';

interface ThemeContextValue {
  theme: Theme;
  toggleTheme: () => void;
  setTheme: (theme: Theme) => void;
}

const ThemeContext = createContext<ThemeContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

export function ThemeProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [theme, setThemeState] = useState<Theme>('light');

  // ===== تحميل الثيم المحفوظ أو المفضّل =====
  // ===== تحميل الثيم المحفوظ — الوضع النهاري افتراضياً =====
useEffect(() => {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem('theme') as Theme | null;
    const initial: Theme = saved ?? 'light';
    setThemeState(initial);
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', initial === 'dark');
  } catch {
    /* في حال فشل localStorage */
  }
}, []);

  // ===== تغيير الثيم =====
  const setTheme = useCallback((next: Theme) => {
    setThemeState(next);
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('theme', next);
    } catch {
      /* تجاهل */
    }
    document.documentElement.classList.toggle('dark', next === 'dark');
  }, []);

  const toggleTheme = useCallback(() => {
    setTheme(theme === 'light' ? 'dark' : 'light');
  }, [theme, setTheme]);

  return (
    <ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme, toggleTheme, setTheme }}>
      {children}
    </ThemeContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useTheme(): ThemeContextValue {
  const ctx = useContext(ThemeContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useTheme must be used within ThemeProvider');
  return ctx;
}
```

```tsx
}

// ==================== Rank Badge ====================
function RankBadge({ rank }: { rank: number }) {
  const styles =
    rank === 1
      ? 'bg-gold text-on-gold shadow-sm'
      : rank === 2
        ? 'bg-ink/15 text-ink dark:bg-white/15'
        : rank === 3
          ? 'bg-gold/15 text-gold-ink dark:bg-gold/25'
          : 'bg-ink/5 text-ink-muted dark:bg-white/5';

  return (
    <span
      className={`flex h-8 w-8 flex-shrink-0 items-center justify-center rounded-field font-mono text-sm font-bold ${styles}`}
    >
      {rank}
    </span>
  );
}

// ==================== Component ====================
export function TrendingNotes({ stage }: Props) {
  const { addView } = useRecentViews();
  const [items, setItems] = useState<TopNote[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState('');

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;

    async function load() {
      setLoading(true);
      setError('');
      try {
        const data = await postJson<{ items: TopNote[] }>('/api/views', {
          action: 'top',
          stage,
        });
        if (cancelled) return;
        setItems(data.items ?? []);
      } catch (err) {
        if (cancelled) return;
        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'فشل التحميل');
      } finally {
        if (!cancelled) setLoading(false);
      }
    }
    load();
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, [stage]);

  function handleClick(item: TopNote) {
    addView({
      id: item.id,
      title: item.title,
      subject_name: item.subject_name,
      file_path: item.file_path,
    });
  }

  // Skeleton
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="card-editorial p-4">
        <div className="mb-3 flex items-center gap-2">
          <div className="h-7 w-7 skeleton-shimmer rounded-field" />
          <div className="h-5 w-32 skeleton-shimmer rounded" />
        </div>
        <div className="space-y-2">
          {[0, 1, 2].map((i) => (
            <div key={i} className="h-14 skeleton-shimmer rounded-field" />
          ))}
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  // Error — silent
  if (error) return null;

  // Empty — silent
  if (items.length === 0) return null;

  return (
    <div className="card-editorial p-4">
      {/* Header */}
      <div className="mb-2 flex items-center justify-between gap-2 px-1 pt-1">
        <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
          <span className="flex h-7 w-7 items-center justify-center rounded-field bg-gold/15 text-gold-ink">
            <IconFire className="h-4 w-4" />
          </span>
          <h2 className="text-base font-bold text-ink">الأكثر إقبالاً</h2>
        </div>
        <span className="hidden items-center gap-1 rounded-chip bg-teal/10 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-teal sm:inline-flex">
          <IconTrending className="h-3 w-3" />
          مباشر
        </span>
      </div>

      {/* List */}
      <div className="space-y-1">
        {items.map((item, idx) => (
          <a
            key={item.id}
            href={item.file_path}
            target="_blank"
            rel="noopener noreferrer"
            onClick={() => handleClick(item)}
            className="group flex items-center gap-3 rounded-field border border-transparent p-2.5 transition-all duration-200 hover:border-teal/20 hover:bg-paper hover:shadow-sm dark:hover:bg-paper-soft"
          >
            <RankBadge rank={idx + 1} />

            <div className="min-w-0 flex-1">
              <p className="truncate text-sm font-bold text-ink transition-colors group-hover:text-teal">
                {item.title}
              </p>
              <div className="mt-0.5 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5 text-[11px] text-ink-muted">
                <span className="truncate font-bold text-teal">
                  {item.subject_name}
                </span>
                {item.professor_name && (
                  <>
                    <span className="text-ink/30">·</span>
                    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-0.5 truncate">
                      <IconDoctor className="h-3 w-3" />
                      د. {item.professor_name}
                    </span>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </div>

            <div className="flex flex-shrink-0 items-center gap-2">
              <span className="rounded-chip bg-gold/15 px-2 py-0.5 text-[10px] font-bold text-gold-ink">
                {item.week_views}
              </span>
              <span className="hidden text-ink/20 transition-colors group-hover:text-teal sm:inline">
                <IconTelegram className="h-3.5 w-3.5" />
              </span>
            </div>
          </a>
        ))}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
  );
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// components/anatomy/ExpressionPreview.tsx
import { memo, useEffect, useId, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { computeFace, scalePose, type Pose } from '@/lib/anatomy-pose';

const CYCLE = 3400;
const ease = (x: number): number => (x < 0.5 ? 2 * x * x : 1 - Math.pow(-2 * x + 2, 2) / 2);

function kAt(t: number): number {
  const c = t % CYCLE;
  if (c < 800) return ease(c / 800);
  if (c < 1900) return 1;
  if (c < 2600) return 1 - ease((c - 1900) / 700);
  return 0;
}

function phaseForK(k: number): number {
  const x = k < 0.5 ? Math.sqrt(k / 2) : 1 - Math.sqrt((1 - k) / 2);
  return x * 800;
}

interface Props {
  pose: Pose;
  poseKey: string;
  onK?: (k: number) => void;
}

function ExpressionPreview({ pose, poseKey, onK }: Props) {
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, '');
  const clipL = `${uid}-cl`;
  const clipR = `${uid}-cr`;

  const [playing, setPlaying] = useState(true);
  const [k, setK] = useState(0);
  const kRef = useRef(0);
  const lastKey = useRef(poseKey);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) {
        setPlaying(false);
        kRef.current = 1;
        setK(1);
      }
    } catch {
      /* تجاهل */
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!playing) return;
    const resume = lastKey.current === poseKey;
    lastKey.current = poseKey;
    const start = performance.now() - (resume ? phaseForK(kRef.current) : 0);
    let raf = 0;
    const frame = (now: number) => {
      const next = kAt(now - start);
      if (Math.abs(next - kRef.current) > 0.002) {
        kRef.current = next;
        setK(next);
      }
      raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    };
    raf = requestAnimationFrame(frame);
    return () => cancelAnimationFrame(raf);
  }, [playing, poseKey]);

  useEffect(() => {
    onK?.(k);
  }, [k, onK]);

  const f = useMemo(() => computeFace(scalePose(pose, k)), [pose, k]);
  const contracted = k > 0.5;

  return (
    <div className="fa-plate fa-preview">
      <svg viewBox="0 0 220 270" aria-hidden="true" style={{ direction: 'ltr' }}>
        <defs>
          <clipPath id={clipL}><path d={f.eyeL} /></clipPath>
          <clipPath id={clipR}><path d={f.eyeR} /></clipPath>
        </defs>

        <path d="M84,206 L82,270" className="fa-pl" />
        <path d="M136,206 L138,270" className="fa-pl" />
        <ellipse cx="36" cy="112" rx="5" ry="14" className="fa-pl" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-skin)' }} />
        <ellipse cx="184" cy="112" rx="5" ry="14" className="fa-pl" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-skin)' }} />
        <path d={f.head} className="fa-pl" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-skin)' }} />

        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.neck }}>
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M92,214 L86,262" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M100,218 L96,262" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M128,214 L134,262" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M120,218 L124,262" />
        </g>
        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.forehead }}>
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M70,44 Q110,40 150,44" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M66,54 Q110,50 154,54" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M66,64 Q110,60 154,64" />
        </g>
        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.glabella }}>
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M104,78 L104.5,92" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M116,78 L115.5,92" />
        </g>
        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.nose }}>
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M101,95 L119,95" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M102,101 L118,101" />
        </g>
        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.squint }}>
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M158,92 L170,86" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M160,98 L173,98" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M158,104 L170,110" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M62,92 L50,86" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M60,98 L47,98" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M62,104 L50,110" />
        </g>
        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.temple }}>
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M52,66 Q47,84 52,104" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M168,66 Q173,84 168,104" />
        </g>
        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.clench }}>
          <path className="fa-pw" style={{ strokeWidth: 2 }} d="M62,156 Q56,174 66,192" />
          <path className="fa-pw" style={{ strokeWidth: 2 }} d="M158,156 Q164,174 154,192" />
        </g>
        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.cheek }}>
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M150,148 Q158,166 148,186" />
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M70,148 Q62,166 72,186" />
        </g>
        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.chin }}>
          <path className="fa-pw" d="M96,198 Q110,193 124,198" />
          <circle cx="102" cy="206" r="1" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-ink)' }} />
          <circle cx="110" cy="209" r="1" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-ink)' }} />
          <circle cx="118" cy="206" r="1" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-ink)' }} />
          <circle cx="106" cy="213" r="1" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-ink)' }} />
          <circle cx="114" cy="213" r="1" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-ink)' }} />
        </g>

        <path d={f.nlfR} className="fa-pw" style={{ opacity: f.nlfOpacity }} />
        <path d={f.nlfL} className="fa-pw" style={{ opacity: f.nlfOpacity }} />
        <path d={f.marR} className="fa-pw" style={{ opacity: f.marOpacity }} />
        <path d={f.marL} className="fa-pw" style={{ opacity: f.marOpacity }} />
        <g style={{ opacity: f.op.purse }}>
          {f.purse.map((d, i) => (
            <path key={i} d={d} className="fa-pw" />
          ))}
        </g>

        <path className="fa-pl" style={{ strokeOpacity: 0.35 }} d="M104,100 Q101,128 98,146" />
        <path className="fa-pl" style={{ strokeOpacity: 0.35 }} d="M116,100 Q119,128 122,146" />
        <path d={f.noseWingL} className="fa-pl" />
        <path d={f.noseWingR} className="fa-pl" />
        <path d={f.noseBase} className="fa-pl" />
        <ellipse cx={f.nostril.lx} cy={f.nostril.y} rx={f.nostril.rad} ry="1.8" fill="var(--fa-ink)" opacity=".55" />
        <ellipse cx={f.nostril.rx} cy={f.nostril.y} rx={f.nostril.rad} ry="1.8" fill="var(--fa-ink)" opacity=".55" />

        <path d={f.eyeL} className="fa-pl" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-eye)' }} />
        <path d={f.eyeR} className="fa-pl" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-eye)' }} />
        <circle cx="80" cy="98" r="5.6" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-iris)', opacity: f.irisOpacity }} clipPath={`url(#${clipL})`} />
        <circle cx="140" cy="98" r="5.6" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-iris)', opacity: f.irisOpacity }} clipPath={`url(#${clipR})`} />
        <circle cx="80" cy="98" r="2.4" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-ink)', opacity: f.irisOpacity }} clipPath={`url(#${clipL})`} />
        <circle cx="140" cy="98" r="2.4" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-ink)', opacity: f.irisOpacity }} clipPath={`url(#${clipR})`} />

        <path d={f.browL} className="fa-pl" style={{ strokeWidth: 3.2 }} />
        <path d={f.browR} className="fa-pl" style={{ strokeWidth: 3.2 }} />
        <path d={f.mouth} className="fa-pl" style={{ fill: 'var(--fa-lip)' }} />
      </svg>

      <button
        type="button"
        className="fa-play"
        aria-label={playing ? 'إيقاف الحركة' : 'تشغيل الحركة'}
        onClick={() => setPlaying((p) => !p)}
      >
        {playing ? (
          <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true">
            <rect x="2" y="1.5" width="2.8" height="9" fill="currentColor" />
            <rect x="7.2" y="1.5" width="2.8" height="9" fill="currentColor" />
          </svg>
        ) : (
          <svg width="12" height="12" viewBox="0 0 12 12" aria-hidden="true">
            <path d="M3 1.5 L10 6 L3 10.5 Z" fill="currentColor" />
          </svg>
        )}
      </button>

      <div className="fa-pstate">{contracted ? 'منقبضة' : 'مسترخية'}</div>

      <input
        type="range"
        min={0}
        max={100}
        value={Math.round(k * 100)}
        aria-label="درجة الانقباض"
        className="fa-range"
        onChange={(e) => {
          const v = Number(e.target.value) / 100;
          setPlaying(false);
          kRef.current = v;
          setK(v);
        }}
      />
    </div>
  );
}

export default memo(ExpressionPreview);
```

## components\anatomy\face-atlas.css

```css
/* components/anatomy/face-atlas.css */

.fa-plate {
  --fa-bg: #ECEFF0; --fa-surface: #F7F9F9; --fa-ink: #14232B; --fa-muted: #55666E; --fa-line: #CAD3D7;
  --fa-fascia: #EADFD5; --fa-skin: #E9C4B0; --fa-lip: #D98A84; --fa-brow: #4A3228;
  --fa-eye: #F6F5F2; --fa-iris: #4F6A74; --fa-mouth: #6E2A2D;
  --fa-muscle: #C4574F; --fa-muscle-hover: #D8746B; --fa-muscle-edge: #8B2E2A;
  --fa-fibre: #7E2824; --fa-fibre-hi: #EBA096;
  --fa-sel: #F5B83D; --fa-sel-edge: #14232B; --fa-sel-fibre: #9C6410;
  --fa-ok: #4FB47F; --fa-bad: #E0634A;
  color: var(--fa-ink);
}

/* ---------- التخطيط ---------- */
.fa-layout {
  display: grid;
  gap: 12px;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
  grid-template-areas: "card" "stage";
}

/* سطح المكتب: البطاقة على اليمين وتكون Sticky */
@media (min-width: 880px) {
  .fa-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 380px;
    grid-template-areas: "stage card";
    align-items: start;
  }
}

.fa-card { grid-area: card; min-width: 0; z-index: 10; }
.fa-stage { grid-area: stage; min-width: 0; }

/* تثبيت البطاقة فقط على الشاشات الكبيرة */
@media (min-width: 880px) {
  .fa-card.is-sticky { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--nav-h, 0px) + 8px); }
  .fa-card.is-quiz { position: sticky; top: calc(var(--nav-h, 0px) + 12px); }
}

.fa-card-main {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 112px;
  gap: 12px;
  align-items: start;
}
@media (min-width: 880px) { .fa-card-main { grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr) 128px; } }

.fa-scroll { display: flex; gap: 6px; overflow-x: auto; padding-bottom: 4px; scrollbar-width: thin; }
.fa-scroll > * { flex: none; }

/* ---------- لوحة الرسم ---------- */
.fa-figure {
  --R: .7407;
  position: relative;
  background: var(--fa-surface);
  border: 1px solid var(--fa-line);
  border-radius: 14px;
  padding: 8px;
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
}
.fa-figure svg {
  display: block;
  width: 100%;
  height: auto;
  aspect-ratio: var(--R);
  /* يضمن ألا يتجاوز الرسم 68% من ارتفاع الشاشة على الشاشات الكبيرة */
  max-width: calc(68vh * var(--R));
  touch-action: manipulation;
  direction: ltr;
}

/* ---------- العناصر الرسومية ---------- */
.fa-base-fascia { fill: var(--fa-fascia); stroke: var(--fa-line); stroke-width: 1.2; }
.fa-base-skin { fill: var(--fa-skin); stroke: var(--fa-muscle-edge); stroke-opacity: .5; stroke-width: .8; }

.fa-m { cursor: pointer; transition: opacity .2s; }
.fa-mo { fill: var(--fa-muscle); stroke: var(--fa-muscle-edge); stroke-width: .9; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.fa-fa { fill: none; stroke: var(--fa-fibre); stroke-opacity: .5; stroke-width: .7; stroke-linecap: round; }
.fa-fb { fill: none; stroke: var(--fa-fibre-hi); stroke-opacity: .55; stroke-width: .7; stroke-linecap: round; }
.fa-m:hover .fa-mo { fill: var(--fa-muscle-hover); }
.fa-m:focus-visible { outline: none; }
.fa-m:focus-visible .fa-mo { stroke: var(--fa-ink); stroke-width: 2; }
.fa-m.is-dim { opacity: .16; }
.fa-m.is-dim:hover { opacity: .55; }
.fa-m.is-hi .fa-mo { stroke: var(--fa-ink); stroke-width: 1.3; }

.fa-sel { pointer-events: none; cursor: default; }
.fa-sel .fa-mo { fill: var(--fa-sel); fill-opacity: calc(.78 + .22 * var(--k, 1)); stroke: var(--fa-sel-edge); stroke-width: 1.5; }
.fa-sel .fa-fa { stroke: var(--fa-sel-fibre); stroke-opacity: .7; }
.fa-sel .fa-fb { stroke: #fff; stroke-opacity: .55; }
.fa-sel-ok .fa-mo { fill: var(--fa-ok); fill-opacity: .92; }
.fa-sel-bad .fa-mo { fill: var(--fa-bad); fill-opacity: .92; }
.fa-sel-ok .fa-fa, .fa-sel-bad .fa-fa { stroke: #0d2b1c; stroke-opacity: .55; }

.fa-decor { pointer-events: none; }
.fa-thin { fill: none; stroke: var(--fa-ink); stroke-opacity: .4; stroke-width: 1.1; }

.fa-halo { fill: none; stroke: var(--fa-surface); stroke-width: 4.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.fa-arrow { fill: none; stroke: var(--fa-ink); stroke-width: 2.2; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-dasharray: 5 4; animation: fa-flow .9s linear infinite; }
.fa-ahead { fill: var(--fa-ink); stroke: var(--fa-surface); stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linejoin: round; }
@keyframes fa-flow { to { stroke-dashoffset: -9; } }

.fa-lab { font-family: inherit; fill: var(--fa-ink); paint-order: stroke; stroke: var(--fa-surface); stroke-linejoin: round; cursor: pointer; }
.fa-lab.is-sel { font-weight: 700; }
.fa-leader { stroke: var(--fa-ink); stroke-opacity: .55; pointer-events: none; fill: none; }
.fa-ldot { fill: var(--fa-ink); pointer-events: none; }

.fa-tip {
  position: absolute; pointer-events: none; z-index: 3;
  background: #14232B; color: #F7F9F9; font-size: 12px; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 6px;
  white-space: nowrap; transform: translate(-50%, -140%); direction: ltr;
}
.fa-tip[hidden] { display: none; }

/* ---------- معاينة التعبير ---------- */
.fa-preview { position: relative; border-radius: 10px; }
.fa-preview > svg { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; background: var(--fa-bg); border-radius: 8px; }
.fa-pl { fill: none; stroke: var(--fa-ink); stroke-width: 1.6; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
.fa-pw { fill: none; stroke: var(--fa-ink); stroke-width: 1.2; stroke-linecap: round; }
.fa-pstate { font-size: 11px; color: var(--fa-muted); text-align: center; margin-top: 2px; }
.fa-play {
  position: absolute; inset-inline-start: 4px; top: 4px; width: 26px; height: 26px; border-radius: 50%;
  border: 1px solid var(--fa-line); background: var(--fa-surface); color: var(--fa-ink);
  display: grid; place-items: center; cursor: pointer; padding: 0;
}
.fa-play:focus-visible, .fa-range:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--fa-sel); outline-offset: 2px; }
.fa-range { width: 100%; margin: 4px 0 0; accent-color: var(--fa-muscle); cursor: pointer; }

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .fa-arrow { animation: none; }
  .fa-m { transition: none; }
}
```

```tsx
'use client';

// components/anatomy/FaceAtlas.tsx
import { memo, useCallback, useEffect, useId, useLayoutEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { CSSProperties, KeyboardEvent, MouseEvent, PointerEvent } from 'react';
import './face-atlas.css';

import { MUSCLES, MUSCLE_GROUPS, MUSCLE_BY_ID, ZOOMS, type ZoomId } from '@/lib/anatomy-data';
import { GEOMETRY } from '@/lib/anatomy-geometry';
import { canvasRatio, layoutLabels, viewBoxFor, type ViewBox } from '@/lib/anatomy-view';
import { combinePoses, type Pose } from '@/lib/anatomy-pose';
import { ACTION_AR, EXPRESSIONS, PEARLS_AR } from '@/lib/anatomy-ar';
import {
  EXAM_TIPS,
  FACIAL_BRANCHES,
  MUSCLES_BY_BRANCH,
  BRANCH_MNEMONIC,
  branchesOf,
  innervationOf,
  pharyngealArchOf,
  type FacialBranch,
} from '@/lib/anatomy-extras';
import { makeRound } from '@/lib/anatomy-quiz';

import ExpressionPreview from './ExpressionPreview';
import QuizPanel, { type QuizState } from './QuizPanel';
import AtlasExtras from './AtlasExtras';
import { badge, btnGhost, chip, chipSmall } from './ui-classes';

// ==================== ثوابت ====================
type Mode = 'explore' | 'quiz';
type DetailTab = 'anatomy' | 'nerve' | 'clinical';
type BranchFilter = FacialBranch | 'v3' | null;
type Tone = 'sel' | 'ok' | 'bad';
interface SelItem { id: string; tone: Tone }

const useIsoLayoutEffect = typeof window === 'undefined' ? useEffect : useLayoutEffect;
const MIRROR = 'translate(400 0) scale(-1 1)';
const BEST_KEY = 'anatomy-face-quiz-best';
const DEFAULT_ID = 'zmaj';
const ROUND_SIZE = 10;
const V3_IDS: readonly string[] = MUSCLES.filter((m) => innervationOf(m) === 'V3').map((m) => m.id);

const TAB_LABEL: Record<DetailTab, string> = {
  anatomy: 'Anatomy',
  nerve: 'Nerve',
  clinical: 'Clinical',
};

// ==================== طبقات الرسم الثابتة ====================
const FaceBase = memo(function FaceBase() {

      <path d="M138,380 L134,540 L266,540 L262,380 Z" className="fa-base-fascia" />
      {[76, 324].map((cx) => (

          <path d={cx < 200 ? 'M80,196 Q70,212 80,230' : 'M320,196 Q330,212 320,230'} className="fa-thin" />
        </g>
      ))}
      <path
        d="M200,18 C120,18 80,70 80,150 C80,220 84,280 94,330 C104,372 138,412 200,430 C262,412 296,372 306,330 C316,280 320,220 320,150 C320,70 280,18 200,18 Z"
        className="fa-base-fascia"
      />
      <path
        d="M200,236 C190,252 182,278 180,296 C179,312 190,326 200,326 C210,326 221,312 220,296 C218,278 210,252 200,236 Z"
        className="fa-base-skin"
      />
    </g>
  );
});

const FaceDecor = memo(function FaceDecor({ clipId }: { clipId: string }) {
  const side = (mirror: boolean) => (
    <g key={mirror ? 'l' : 'r'} transform={mirror ? MIRROR : undefined}>
      <path d="M207,172 C222,154 262,146 296,166 C264,156 226,162 207,172 Z" fill="var(--fa-brow)" stroke="var(--fa-brow)" strokeWidth={1.2} strokeLinejoin="round" />
      <path d="M226,201 Q248,187 270,201 Q248,214 226,201 Z" fill="var(--fa-eye)" />
      <circle cx={248} cy={201} r={8.2} fill="var(--fa-iris)" clipPath={`url(#${clipId})`} />
      <circle cx={248} cy={201} r={3.4} fill="var(--fa-ink)" clipPath={`url(#${clipId})`} />

      <path d="M226,201 Q248,214 270,201" fill="none" stroke="var(--fa-ink)" strokeOpacity={0.5} strokeWidth={0.9} />

      <path d="M163,348 C176,351 190,351 200,351 C210,351 224,351 237,348 C230,362 216,368 200,368 C184,368 170,362 163,348 Z" fill="var(--fa-lip)" stroke="var(--fa-mouth)" strokeWidth={0.8} strokeLinejoin="round" />

});

// ==================== طبقة العضلات ====================
const MusclesLayer = memo(function MusclesLayer({
  highlight,
  hideNames,
}: {
  highlight: ReadonlySet<string> | null;
  hideNames: boolean;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      {MUSCLES.flatMap((m) => {
        const geo = GEOMETRY[m.id];
        if (!geo) return [];
        const cls =
          highlight === null ? 'fa-m' : highlight.has(m.id) ? 'fa-m is-hi' : 'fa-m is-dim';
        return (m.paired ? [0, 1] : [0]).map((s) => (
          <g
            key={`${m.id}-${s}`}
            className={cls}
            data-id={m.id}
            transform={s ? MIRROR : undefined}
            {...(s === 0
              ? { role: 'button', tabIndex: 0, 'aria-label': hideNames ? 'Muscle' : m.en }
              : { 'aria-hidden': true })}
          >
            <path d={geo.d} className="fa-mo" fillRule={geo.evenodd ? 'evenodd' : undefined} />
            <path d={geo.dark} className="fa-fa" />
            <path d={geo.light} className="fa-fb" />
          </g>
        ));
      })}
    </>
  );
});

function SelLayer({ items }: { items: readonly SelItem[] }) {
  return (
    <>
      {items.flatMap(({ id, tone }) => {
        const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
        const geo = GEOMETRY[id];
        if (!m || !geo) return [];
        return (m.paired ? [0, 1] : [0]).map((s) => (
          <g
            key={`${id}-${s}-${tone}`}
            className={tone === 'sel' ? 'fa-m fa-sel' : `fa-m fa-sel fa-sel-${tone}`}
            transform={s ? MIRROR : undefined}
          >
            <path d={geo.d} className="fa-mo" fillRule={geo.evenodd ? 'evenodd' : undefined} />
            <path d={geo.dark} className="fa-fa" />
            <path d={geo.light} className="fa-fb" />
          </g>
        ));
      })}
    </>
  );
}

function Arrow({ a, mirror }: { a: readonly [number, number, number, number]; mirror: boolean }) {
  const [x1, y1, x2, y2] = a;
  const ang = Math.atan2(y2 - y1, x2 - x1);
  const s = 8;
  const ex = x2 - 2.5 * Math.cos(ang);
  const ey = y2 - 2.5 * Math.sin(ang);
  const h1x = x2 - s * Math.cos(ang - 0.45);
  const h1y = y2 - s * Math.sin(ang - 0.45);
  const h2x = x2 - s * Math.cos(ang + 0.45);
  const h2y = y2 - s * Math.sin(ang + 0.45);
  const line = `M${x1},${y1} L${ex.toFixed(1)},${ey.toFixed(1)}`;
  return (
    <g transform={mirror ? MIRROR : undefined}>
      <path d={line} className="fa-halo" />
      <path d={line} className="fa-arrow" />
      <path d={`M${x2},${y2} L${h1x.toFixed(1)},${h1y.toFixed(1)} L${h2x.toFixed(1)},${h2y.toFixed(1)} Z`} className="fa-ahead" />
    </g>
  );
}

function ArrowsLayer({ ids }: { ids: readonly string[] }) {
  return (
    <>
      {ids.flatMap((id) => {
        const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
        if (!m) return [];
        return m.arrows.flatMap((a, i) => {
          const out = [<Arrow key={`${id}-${i}-0`} a={a} mirror={false} />];
          if (m.paired) out.push(<Arrow key={`${id}-${i}-1`} a={a} mirror />);
          return out;
        });
      })}
    </>
  );
}

// ==================== المكوّن الرئيسي ====================
export default function FaceAtlas() {
  const uid = useId().replace(/:/g, '');
  const clipId = `${uid}-eye`;

  // ----- الحالة -----
  const [mode, setMode] = useState<Mode>('explore');
  const [selectedId, setSelectedId] = useState<string | null>(DEFAULT_ID);
  const [expressionId, setExpressionId] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [branch, setBranch] = useState<BranchFilter>(null);
  const [zoom, setZoom] = useState<ZoomId>('whole');
  const [labelsOn, setLabelsOn] = useState(false);
  const [vb, setVb] = useState<ViewBox>(() => viewBoxFor('whole', false));
  const [svgW, setSvgW] = useState(0);
  const [emW, setEmW] = useState<Record<string, number>>({});
  const [query, setQuery] = useState('');
  const [detailsOpen, setDetailsOpen] = useState(false);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<DetailTab>('anatomy');
  const [quiz, setQuiz] = useState<QuizState | null>(null);
  const [best, setBest] = useState(0);
  const [copied, setCopied] = useState(false);

  // ----- مراجع -----
  const svgRef = useRef<SVGSVGElement>(null);
  const figRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const tipRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const cardRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const measureRef = useRef<SVGTextElement>(null);
  const vbRef = useRef<ViewBox>(vb);
  const labelsOnRef = useRef(false);
  const animRef = useRef(0);
  const reducedRef = useRef(false);
  const interacted = useRef(false);
  const bestRef = useRef(0);

  // ==================== الكاميرا ====================
  const animateTo = useCallback((to: ViewBox, instant = false) => {
    cancelAnimationFrame(animRef.current);
    const from = vbRef.current;
    if (instant || reducedRef.current) {
      vbRef.current = to;
      setVb(to);
      return;
    }
    const t0 = performance.now();
    const step = (t: number) => {
      const k = Math.min(1, (t - t0) / 450);
      const e = 1 - Math.pow(1 - k, 3);
      const mix = (i: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3): number => from[i] + (to[i] - from[i]) * e;
      const next: ViewBox = [mix(0), mix(1), mix(2), mix(3)];
      vbRef.current = next;
      setVb(next);
      if (k < 1) animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
    };
    animRef.current = requestAnimationFrame(step);
  }, []);

  const changeZoom = useCallback(
    (z: ZoomId, instant = false) => {
      setZoom(z);
      animateTo(viewBoxFor(z, labelsOnRef.current), instant);
    },
    [animateTo],
  );

  const toggleLabels = useCallback(() => {
    const next = !labelsOnRef.current;
    labelsOnRef.current = next;
    setLabelsOn(next);
    animateTo(viewBoxFor(zoom, next), true);
  }, [animateTo, zoom]);

  useEffect(() => () => cancelAnimationFrame(animRef.current), []);

  // ==================== بدء التشغيل ====================
  useIsoLayoutEffect(() => {
    try {
      reducedRef.current = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
    } catch {
      /* تجاهل */
    }

    let wantLabels = false;
    try {
      // إخفاء التسميات افتراضياً على الجوال (أقل من 1024px)
      wantLabels = window.matchMedia('(min-width: 1024px)').matches;
    } catch {
      /* تجاهل */
    }

    let startZoom: ZoomId = 'whole';
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const mid = p.get('m');
      const xid = p.get('x');
      if (xid && EXPRESSIONS.some((e) => e.id === xid)) {
        setExpressionId(xid);
        setSelectedId(null);
      } else if (mid && MUSCLE_BY_ID[mid]) {
        setSelectedId(mid);
        startZoom = MUSCLE_BY_ID[mid].zoom;
      }
    } catch {
      /* تجاهل */
    }

    labelsOnRef.current = wantLabels;
    setLabelsOn(wantLabels);
    setZoom(startZoom);
    const v = viewBoxFor(startZoom, wantLabels);
    vbRef.current = v;
    setVb(v);
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      const n = Number(localStorage.getItem(BEST_KEY));
      if (Number.isFinite(n) && n > 0) {
        bestRef.current = n;
        setBest(n);
      }
    } catch {
      /* تجاهل */
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!interacted.current || mode !== 'explore') return;
    try {
      const p = new URLSearchParams();
      if (expressionId) p.set('x', expressionId);
      else if (selectedId) p.set('m', selectedId);
      const qs = p.toString();
      window.history.replaceState(null, '', qs ? `?${qs}` : window.location.pathname);
    } catch {
      /* تجاهل */
    }
  }, [selectedId, expressionId, mode]);

  // ==================== القياسات ====================
  useEffect(() => {
    const el = svgRef.current;
    if (!el) return;
    setSvgW(el.getBoundingClientRect().width);
    if (typeof ResizeObserver === 'undefined') return;
    const ro = new ResizeObserver((entries) => {
      const w = entries[0]?.contentRect.width;
      if (w) setSvgW(w);
    });
    ro.observe(el);
    return () => ro.disconnect();
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    let cancelled = false;
    const run = () => {
      const t = measureRef.current;
      if (!t || cancelled || typeof t.getComputedTextLength !== 'function') return;
      const next: Record<string, number> = {};
      for (const m of MUSCLES) {
        const text = m.short ?? m.en;
        t.textContent = text;
        const len = t.getComputedTextLength();
        if (len > 0) next[text] = len / 100;
      }
      t.textContent = '';
      if (Object.keys(next).length) setEmW(next);
    };
    run();
    try {
      void document.fonts?.ready.then(run);
    } catch {
      /* تجاهل */
    }
    return () => {
      cancelled = true;
    };
  }, []);

  // ==================== التحديد ====================
  const scrollToFigure = useCallback(() => {
    const fig = figRef.current;
    const card = cardRef.current;
    if (!fig) return;
    const navH = parseFloat(getComputedStyle(document.documentElement).getPropertyValue('--nav-h')) || 0;
    let stuck = 0;
    if (card && getComputedStyle(card).position === 'sticky' && window.matchMedia('(max-width: 879px)').matches) {
      stuck = card.offsetHeight;
    }
    const top = window.scrollY + fig.getBoundingClientRect().top - navH - stuck - 12;
    window.scrollTo({ top: Math.max(0, top), behavior: reducedRef.current ? 'auto' : 'smooth' });
  }, []);

  const selectMuscle = useCallback(
    (id: string, opts?: { zoom?: boolean; scroll?: boolean }) => {
      const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
      if (!m) return;
      interacted.current = true;
      setSelectedId(id);
      setExpressionId(null);
      if (opts?.zoom) changeZoom(m.zoom);
      if (opts?.scroll) scrollToFigure();
    },
    [changeZoom, scrollToFigure],
  );

  const selectExpression = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      interacted.current = true;
      if (expressionId === id) {
        setExpressionId(null);
        setSelectedId((prev) => prev ?? DEFAULT_ID);
        return;
      }
      setExpressionId(id);
      setSelectedId(null);
      setBranch(null);
      changeZoom('whole');
    },
    [changeZoom, expressionId],
  );

  const toggleBranch = useCallback((b: Exclude<BranchFilter, null>) => {
    setBranch((prev) => (prev === b ? null : b));
    setExpressionId(null);
    setSelectedId((prev) => prev ?? DEFAULT_ID);
  }, []);

  // ==================== الاختبار ====================
  const startQuiz = useCallback(() => {
    setQuiz({
      questions: makeRound(ROUND_SIZE),
      index: 0,
      picked: null,
      score: 0,
      streak: 0,
      bestStreak: 0,
      missed: [],
      done: false,
    });
    setMode('quiz');
  }, []);

  const exitQuiz = useCallback(() => {
    setMode('explore');
    setQuiz(null);
    changeZoom('whole');
  }, [changeZoom]);

  const answerQuiz = useCallback((choice: string) => {
    setQuiz((prev) => {
      if (!prev || prev.picked !== null || prev.done) return prev;
      const q = prev.questions[prev.index];
      if (!q) return prev;
      const ok = choice === q.correct;
      const streak = ok ? prev.streak + 1 : 0;
      return {
        ...prev,
        picked: choice,
        score: prev.score + (ok ? 1 : 0),
        streak,
        bestStreak: Math.max(prev.bestStreak, streak),
        missed: ok || prev.missed.includes(q.id) ? prev.missed : [...prev.missed, q.id],
      };
    });
  }, []);

  const nextQuiz = useCallback(() => {
    setQuiz((prev) => {
      if (!prev || prev.picked === null) return prev;
      const next = prev.index + 1;
      if (next >= prev.questions.length) return { ...prev, done: true };
      return { ...prev, index: next, picked: null };
    });
  }, []);

  const reviewFromQuiz = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      setMode('explore');
      setQuiz(null);
      selectMuscle(id, { zoom: true, scroll: true });
    },
    [selectMuscle],
  );

  const currentQ = mode === 'quiz' && quiz && !quiz.done ? (quiz.questions[quiz.index] ?? null) : null;

  useEffect(() => {
    if (mode !== 'quiz') return;
    const m = currentQ ? MUSCLE_BY_ID[currentQ.id] : undefined;
    if (m && currentQ && (currentQ.kind === 'locate' || currentQ.kind === 'identify' || currentQ.kind === 'branch')) {
      changeZoom(m.zoom);
    } else {
      changeZoom('whole');
    }
  }, [mode, currentQ, changeZoom]);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!quiz?.done) return;
    const b = Math.max(bestRef.current, quiz.score);
    if (b !== bestRef.current) {
      bestRef.current = b;
      setBest(b);
      try {
        localStorage.setItem(BEST_KEY, String(b));
      } catch {
        /* تجاهل */
      }
    }
  }, [quiz?.done, quiz?.score]);

  const handlePick = useCallback(
    (id: string) => {
      if (mode === 'quiz') {
        if (currentQ?.kind === 'locate' && quiz?.picked === null) answerQuiz(id);
        return;
      }
      selectMuscle(id);
    },
    [mode, currentQ, quiz?.picked, answerQuiz, selectMuscle],
  );

  // ==================== مشتقات العرض ====================
  const selected = selectedId ? (MUSCLE_BY_ID[selectedId] ?? null) : null;
  const expression = expressionId ? (EXPRESSIONS.find((e) => e.id === expressionId) ?? null) : null;

  const highlight = useMemo<ReadonlySet<string> | null>(() => {
    if (mode === 'quiz') return null;
    if (expression) return new Set(expression.muscles.map((x) => x.id));
    if (branch === 'v3') return new Set(V3_IDS);
    if (branch) return new Set(MUSCLES_BY_BRANCH[branch]);
    return null;
  }, [mode, expression, branch]);

  const pose = useMemo<Pose>(() => {
    if (expression) {
      return combinePoses(
        expression.muscles.map((x) => ({ pose: MUSCLE_BY_ID[x.id]?.pose ?? {}, w: x.w ?? 1 })),
        expression.extra,
      );
    }
    return selected?.pose ?? {};
  }, [expression, selected]);
  const poseKey = expression ? `x:${expression.id}` : `m:${selectedId ?? ''}`;

  const selItems = useMemo<SelItem[]>(() => {
    if (mode === 'explore') {
      if (expression) return expression.muscles.map((x) => ({ id: x.id, tone: 'sel' as const }));
      return selectedId ? [{ id: selectedId, tone: 'sel' as const }] : [];
    }
    if (!currentQ || !quiz) return [];
    const picked = quiz.picked;
    const items: SelItem[] = [];
    if (currentQ.kind === 'identify' || currentQ.kind === 'branch') {
      items.push({ id: currentQ.id, tone: picked !== null ? 'ok' : 'sel' });
    } else if (currentQ.kind === 'locate') {
      if (picked !== null) {
        if (picked !== '__skip' && picked !== currentQ.id && MUSCLE_BY_ID[picked]) items.push({ id: picked, tone: 'bad' });
        items.push({ id: currentQ.id, tone: 'ok' });
      }
    } else if (picked !== null) {
      items.push({ id: currentQ.id, tone: 'ok' });
    }
    return items;
  }, [mode, expression, selectedId, currentQ, quiz]);

  const arrowIds = useMemo<string[]>(() => {
    if (mode === 'explore') return expression ? expression.muscles.map((x) => x.id) : selectedId ? [selectedId] : [];
    if (!currentQ || !quiz || quiz.picked === null) return [];
    return [currentQ.id];
  }, [mode, expression, selectedId, currentQ, quiz]);

  const showLabels = labelsOn && mode === 'explore';
  const layout = useMemo(
    () => (showLabels ? layoutLabels(vb, svgW, (t) => emW[t] ?? t.length * 0.55) : { fs: 0, items: [] }),
    [showLabels, vb, svgW, emW],
  );

  const onK = useCallback((k: number) => {
    svgRef.current?.style.setProperty('--k', k.toFixed(3));
  }, []);

  // ==================== أحداث الرسم ====================
  const idFromEvent = (e: { target: EventTarget }): string | null => {
    const t = (e.target as Element).closest?.('[data-id]');
    return t?.getAttribute('data-id') ?? null;
  };

  const onLayerClick = (e: MouseEvent<SVGGElement>) => {
    const id = idFromEvent(e);
    if (id) handlePick(id);
  };

  const onLayerKey = (e: KeyboardEvent<SVGGElement>) => {
    if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ') return;
    const id = idFromEvent(e);
    if (id) {
      e.preventDefault();
      handlePick(id);
    }
  };

  const onLayerMove = (e: PointerEvent<SVGGElement>) => {
    const tip = tipRef.current;
    const fig = figRef.current;
    if (!tip || !fig || e.pointerType !== 'mouse' || mode === 'quiz') return;
    const id = idFromEvent(e);
    if (!id) {
      tip.hidden = true;
      return;
    }
    const r = fig.getBoundingClientRect();
    tip.textContent = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id]?.en ?? '';
    tip.style.left = `${e.clientX - r.left}px`;
    tip.style.top = `${e.clientY - r.top}px`;
    tip.hidden = false;
  };

  const hideTip = () => {
    if (tipRef.current) tipRef.current.hidden = true;
  };

  const share = async () => {
    const qs = expressionId ? `x=${expressionId}` : selectedId ? `m=${selectedId}` : '';
    const url = `${window.location.origin}${window.location.pathname}${qs ? `?${qs}` : ''}`;
    try {
      if (navigator.share) {
        await navigator.share({ title: 'Facial Muscles — Lawazem', url });
      } else {
        await navigator.clipboard.writeText(url);
        setCopied(true);
        window.setTimeout(() => setCopied(false), 1800);
      }
    } catch {
      /* المستخدم ألغى المشاركة */
    }
  };

  // ==================== الفهرس ====================
  const q = query.trim().toLowerCase();
  const groups = useMemo(
    () =>
      MUSCLE_GROUPS.map((g) => ({
        g,
        ids: g.ids.filter((id) => {
          if (!q) return true;
          const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[id];
          if (!m) return false;
          return [m.en, m.short, m.region, ACTION_AR[id], id].join(' ').toLowerCase().includes(q);
        }),
      })).filter((x) => x.ids.length > 0),
    [q],
  );

  // ==================== العرض ====================
  const statusText = expression
    ? `${expression.en} — ${expression.ar}`
    : selected
      ? selected.en
      : '';

  const inn = selected ? innervationOf(selected) : null;
  const arch = selected ? pharyngealArchOf(selected) : null;
  const selBranches = selected ? branchesOf(selected) : [];
  
  // حساب النسبة هنا لتتوافق مع حالة التسميات
  const dynamicR = canvasRatio(zoom, labelsOn);
  const cardClass = `fa-card rounded-card border border-line bg-paper-soft p-3 shadow-sm sm:p-3.5 ${mode === 'quiz' ? 'is-quiz' : 'is-sticky'}`;

  return (
    <div>
      {/* ---- شريط الأعلى ---- */}
      <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex gap-1.5" role="group" aria-label="Atlas mode">
          <button type="button" className={chip} aria-pressed={mode === 'explore'} onClick={() => (mode === 'quiz' ? exitQuiz() : undefined)}>
            استكشاف
          </button>
          <button type="button" className={chip} aria-pressed={mode === 'quiz'} onClick={() => (mode === 'explore' ? startQuiz() : undefined)}>
            اختبر نفسك
          </button>
        </div>
        {mode === 'explore' && (
          <button type="button" className={btnGhost} onClick={share}>
            {copied ? 'تم نسخ الرابط ✓' : 'مشاركة العضلة'}
          </button>
        )}
      </div>

      <p className="sr-only" role="status" aria-live="polite">{mode === 'explore' ? statusText : ''}</p>

      <div className="fa-layout mt-3">
        {/* ================= البطاقة ================= */}
        <section ref={cardRef} className={cardClass} aria-label={mode === 'quiz' ? 'Quiz' : 'Muscle info'}>
          {mode === 'quiz' && quiz ? (
            <QuizPanel
              state={quiz}
              best={best}
              onAnswer={answerQuiz}
              onNext={nextQuiz}
              onRestart={startQuiz}
              onExit={exitQuiz}
              onReview={reviewFromQuiz}
            />
          ) : (
            <>
              <div className="fa-card-main">
                <div className="min-w-0">
                  <p className="text-[11.5px] font-bold tracking-wide text-ink-muted">
                    {expression ? 'Expression' : selected?.region}
                  </p>

                  {expression ? (
                    <>
                      <h2 dir="ltr" className="mt-0.5 text-start font-display text-2xl font-bold leading-tight text-ink">
                        {expression.en}
                      </h2>
                      <p className="mt-0.5 text-sm font-semibold text-ink-muted">{expression.ar}</p>
                      {expression.noteEn ? (
                        <>
                          <p dir="ltr" className="mt-1.5 text-start text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-soft">{expression.noteEn}</p>
                          <p className="mt-1 text-[12.5px] leading-relaxed text-ink-muted">{expression.note}</p>
                        </>
                      ) : (
                        <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-soft">{expression.note}</p>
                      )}
                      <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                        {expression.muscles.map((x) => (
                          <button key={x.id} type="button" dir="ltr" className={chipSmall} aria-pressed={false} onClick={() => selectMuscle(x.id, { zoom: true })}>
                            {MUSCLE_BY_ID[x.id]?.short ?? MUSCLE_BY_ID[x.id]?.en}
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>
                    </>
                  ) : (
                    selected && (
                      <>
                        <h2 dir="ltr" className="mt-0.5 text-start font-display text-2xl font-bold leading-tight text-ink">
                          {selected.en}
                        </h2>
                        <p dir="ltr" className="mt-1.5 text-start text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink">{selected.actEn}</p>
                        <p className="mt-1.5 text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink-muted">{ACTION_AR[selected.id]}</p>
                        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5" dir="ltr">
                          {inn === 'VII' && <span className={badge}>CN VII</span>}
                          {inn === 'V3' && <span className={badge}>CN V3</span>}
                          {arch && <span className={badge}>Arch {arch}</span>}
                          {selBranches.map((b) => (
                            <span key={b} className={badge}>{FACIAL_BRANCHES.find((x) => x.id === b)?.en}</span>
                          ))}
                        </div>
                      </>
                    )
                  )}
                </div>

                <ExpressionPreview pose={pose} poseKey={poseKey} onK={onK} />
              </div>

              {selected && !expression && (
                <div className="mt-2 border-t border-line pt-2">
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    aria-expanded={detailsOpen}
                    onClick={() => setDetailsOpen((o) => !o)}
                    className="text-sm font-semibold text-ink-soft hover:text-teal focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-teal"
                  >
                    {detailsOpen ? '− ' : '+ '}
                    <span dir="ltr">Origin, Insertion, Nerve & Clinical</span>
                  </button>

                  {detailsOpen && (
                    <div className="mt-2">
                      <div role="group" aria-label="Muscle details" className="flex gap-1.5">
                        {(Object.keys(TAB_LABEL) as DetailTab[]).map((t) => (
                          <button key={t} type="button" aria-pressed={tab === t} className={chipSmall} onClick={() => setTab(t)}>
                            <bdi dir="ltr">{TAB_LABEL[t]}</bdi>
                          </button>
                        ))}
                      </div>

                      <div className="mt-2 max-h-[34vh] overflow-auto text-[13px] leading-snug">
                        {tab === 'anatomy' && (
                          <dl dir="ltr" className="text-left">
                            <dt className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-ink-muted">Origin</dt>
                            <dd className="text-ink-soft">{selected.origin}</dd>
                            <dt className="mt-2 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-ink-muted">Insertion</dt>
                            <dd className="text-ink-soft">{selected.insertion}</dd>
                          </dl>
                        )}

                        {tab === 'nerve' && (
                          <div>
                            <p dir="ltr" className="text-left text-ink-soft">{selected.nerve}</p>
                            {arch && (
                              <p className="mt-2 text-ink-soft">
                                {arch === 2
                                  ? 'من القوس البلعومي الثاني → عضلات التعبير تُغذّيها العصب الوجهي (VII).'
                                  : 'من القوس البلعومي الأول → عضلات المضغ يغذّيها العصب مثلث التوائم (V3).'}
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}

                        {tab === 'clinical' && (
                          <div>
                            <p dir="ltr" className="text-left text-ink-soft">{selected.clin}</p>
                            {PEARLS_AR[selected.id] && (
                              <p className="mt-2 rounded-field border border-gold/30 bg-gold-tint p-2 text-ink">{PEARLS_AR[selected.id]}</p>
                            )}
                            {EXAM_TIPS[selected.id] && (
                              <p className="mt-2 text-ink-soft">
                                <span className="font-bold text-ink">How to examine: </span>
                                <bdi dir="ltr">{EXAM_TIPS[selected.id]?.en}</bdi>
                                <span className="mt-0.5 block text-[12px] text-ink-muted">{EXAM_TIPS[selected.id]?.ar}</span>
                              </p>
                            )}
                          </div>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  )}
                </div>
              )}
            </>
          )}
        </section>

        {/* ================= المسرح ================= */}
        <section className="fa-stage">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-1.5" role="toolbar" aria-label="Zoom">
            {(Object.keys(ZOOMS) as ZoomId[]).map((k) => (
              <button key={k} type="button" className={chip} aria-pressed={zoom === k} onClick={() => changeZoom(k)}>
                {ZOOMS[k].labelAr}
              </button>
            ))}
            {mode === 'explore' && (
              <>
                <span className="mx-0.5 hidden w-px self-stretch bg-line md:block" aria-hidden="true" />
                <button type="button" className={`${chip} hidden md:inline-flex`} aria-pressed={labelsOn} onClick={toggleLabels}>
                  Labels
                </button>
              </>
            )}
          </div>

          {mode === 'explore' && (
            <div className="mt-2 grid gap-1.5">
              <div className="fa-scroll" role="group" aria-label="Filter by nerve">
                <span className="self-center pe-1 text-xs font-bold text-ink-muted">Nerve</span>
                <button type="button" className={chipSmall} aria-pressed={branch === null && !expression} onClick={() => { setBranch(null); setExpressionId(null); setSelectedId((p) => p ?? DEFAULT_ID); }}>
                  All
                </button>
                {FACIAL_BRANCHES.map((b) => (
                  <button key={b.id} type="button" dir="ltr" className={chipSmall} aria-pressed={branch === b.id} onClick={() => toggleBranch(b.id)}>
                    {b.en}
                  </button>
                ))}
                <button type="button" className={chipSmall} aria-pressed={branch === 'v3'} onClick={() => toggleBranch('v3')}>
                  V3 · Mastication
                </button>
              </div>

              <div className="fa-scroll" role="group" aria-label="Expressions">
                <span className="self-center pe-1 text-xs font-bold text-ink-muted">Expressions</span>
                {EXPRESSIONS.map((x) => (
                  <button key={x.id} type="button" className={chipSmall} aria-pressed={expressionId === x.id} onClick={() => selectExpression(x.id)}>
                    <span dir="ltr">{x.en}</span> <span className="text-ink-muted">· {x.ar}</span>
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>

              {branch && branch !== 'v3' && (
                <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">
                  <bdi dir="ltr" className="font-mono">{BRANCH_MNEMONIC}</bdi> — Muscles highlighted receive this branch.
                </p>
              )}
              {branch === 'v3' && (
                <p className="text-xs text-ink-muted">Muscles of mastication shown: masseter, temporalis.</p>
              )}
            </div>
          )}

          <div ref={figRef} className="fa-plate fa-figure mt-2" style={{ '--R': dynamicR.toFixed(4) } as CSSProperties}>
            <svg
              ref={svgRef}
              viewBox={vb.map((n) => n.toFixed(2)).join(' ')}
              role="group"
              aria-label="Anatomical drawing of the facial muscles"
            >
              <defs>
                <clipPath id={clipId} clipPathUnits="userSpaceOnUse">
                  <path d="M226,201 Q248,187 270,201 Q248,214 226,201 Z" />
                </clipPath>
              </defs>

              <FaceBase />

              <g onClick={onLayerClick} onKeyDown={onLayerKey} onPointerMove={onLayerMove} onPointerLeave={hideTip}>
                <MusclesLayer highlight={highlight} hideNames={mode === 'quiz'} />
              </g>

              <g>
                <SelLayer items={selItems} />
              </g>

              <g className="fa-decor">
                <FaceDecor clipId={clipId} />
              </g>

              <g className="fa-decor">
                <ArrowsLayer ids={arrowIds} />
              </g>

              {showLabels && layout.fs > 0 && (
                <g>
                  {layout.items.map((it) => (
                    <g key={it.id}>
                      <text
                        x={it.tx}
                        y={it.ty}
                        fontSize={layout.fs}
                        textAnchor={it.anchor}
                        strokeWidth={layout.fs * 0.3}
                        className={selectedId === it.id && !expression ? 'fa-lab is-sel' : 'fa-lab'}
                        onClick={() => handlePick(it.id)}
                      >
                        {it.text}
                      </text>
                      <line x1={it.sx} y1={it.sy} x2={it.ax} y2={it.ay} className="fa-leader" strokeWidth={layout.fs * 0.07} />
                      <circle cx={it.ax} cy={it.ay} r={layout.fs * 0.2} className="fa-ldot" />
                    </g>
                  ))}
                </g>
              )}

              <text ref={measureRef} className="fa-lab" fontSize={100} x={0} y={0} visibility="hidden" aria-hidden="true" />
            </svg>

            <div ref={tipRef} className="fa-tip" hidden />
          </div>

          <p className="mt-2 text-xs leading-relaxed text-ink-muted">
            Simplified study illustration. Arrows show the direction of pull on contraction.
          </p>
        </section>
      </div>

      {/* ================= الفهرس ================= */}
      {mode === 'explore' && (
        <section aria-label="Muscle list" className="mt-8">
          <div className="flex flex-wrap items-end justify-between gap-3 border-b border-line pb-2">
            <h2 className="font-display text-lg font-bold text-ink">Muscle Index</h2>
            <label className="block w-full sm:w-auto">
              <span className="sr-only">Search for a muscle</span>
              <input
                type="search"
                value={query}
                onChange={(e) => setQuery(e.target.value)}
                placeholder="Search: smile, nasal, jaw..."
                dir="ltr"
                className="w-full rounded-field border border-line bg-paper-soft px-3 py-1.5 text-sm text-ink placeholder:text-ink-muted focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-teal sm:w-56"
              />
            </label>
          </div>

          {groups.length === 0 && <p className="mt-4 text-sm text-ink-muted">No matching results.</p>}

          {groups.map(({ g, ids }) => (
            <div key={g.labelEn}>
              <h3 className="mb-1.5 mt-4 text-[11.5px] font-bold tracking-wide text-ink-muted">
                <bdi dir="ltr">{g.labelEn}</bdi> · {g.label}
              </h3>
              <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
                {ids.map((id) => (
                  <button
                    key={id}
                    type="button"
                    dir="ltr"
                    className={chip}
                    aria-pressed={!expression && selectedId === id}
                    onClick={() => selectMuscle(id, { zoom: true, scroll: true })}
                  >
                    {MUSCLE_BY_ID[id]?.en}
                  </button>
                ))}
              </div>
            </div>
          ))}
        </section>
      )}

      {mode === 'explore' && <AtlasExtras onSelect={(id) => selectMuscle(id, { zoom: true, scroll: true })} />}
    </div>
  );
}
```

## components\anatomy\QuizPanel.tsx

```tsx
'use client';

// components/anatomy/QuizPanel.tsx
import { MUSCLE_BY_ID } from '@/lib/anatomy-data';
import { ACTION_AR } from '@/lib/anatomy-ar';
import { FACIAL_BRANCHES } from '@/lib/anatomy-extras';
import type { Question } from '@/lib/anatomy-quiz';
import { badge, btnGhost, btnPrimary } from './ui-classes';

export interface QuizState {
  questions: Question[];
  index: number;
  picked: string | null;
  score: number;
  streak: number;
  bestStreak: number;
  missed: string[];
  done: boolean;
}

interface Props {
  state: QuizState;
  best: number;
  onAnswer: (choice: string) => void;
  onNext: () => void;
  onRestart: () => void;
  onExit: () => void;
  onReview: (id: string) => void;
}

const PROMPT: Record<Question['kind'], string> = {
  locate: 'اضغط على هذه العضلة في الرسم',
  identify: 'ما اسم العضلة المظلَّلة في الرسم؟',
  action: 'أي عضلة تقوم بهذه الوظيفة؟',
  attach: 'أي عضلة لها هذا المنشأ والمرتكز؟',
  branch: 'ما فرع العصب الوجهي الذي يغذّي هذه العضلة؟',
};

const optionBase =
  'w-full rounded-field border px-3 py-2 text-start text-sm transition-colors focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-teal disabled:cursor-default motion-reduce:transition-none';

function optionTone(answered: boolean, isCorrect: boolean, isPicked: boolean): string {
  if (!answered) return 'border-line bg-paper-soft text-ink hover:border-teal/50';
  if (isCorrect) return 'border-teal bg-teal-soft text-ink';
  if (isPicked) return 'border-coral bg-coral-soft text-ink';
  return 'border-line bg-paper-soft text-ink-muted opacity-60';
}

export default function QuizPanel({ state, best, onAnswer, onNext, onRestart, onExit, onReview }: Props) {
  const total = state.questions.length;

  if (state.done) {
    const pct = Math.round((state.score / total) * 100);
    const verdict =
      pct === 100 ? 'ممتاز! علامة كاملة.' : pct >= 80 ? 'مستواك قوي، راجع الأخطاء وتنتهي.' : pct >= 50 ? 'جيد، يحتاج مراجعة بسيطة.' : 'لا بأس، ابدأ بالاستكشاف ثم أعد المحاولة.';
    return (
      <div>
        <p className="text-xs font-bold tracking-wide text-ink-muted">انتهت الجولة</p>
        <p className="mt-1 font-display text-3xl font-bold text-ink">
          {state.score}
          <span className="text-lg text-ink-muted"> / {total}</span>
        </p>
        <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-ink-soft">{verdict}</p>
        <div className="mt-2 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
          <span className={badge}>أفضل نتيجة: {Math.max(best, state.score)}/{total}</span>
          <span className={badge}>أطول سلسلة: {state.bestStreak}</span>
        </div>

        {state.missed.length > 0 && (
          <div className="mt-3">
            <p className="text-xs font-bold text-ink-muted">للمراجعة (اضغط لفتحها في الأطلس):</p>
            <div className="mt-1.5 flex flex-wrap gap-1.5">
              {state.missed.map((id) => (
                <button
                  key={id}
                  type="button"
                  dir="ltr"
                  onClick={() => onReview(id)}
                  className="rounded-chip border border-coral/40 bg-coral-soft px-2.5 py-1 text-xs text-ink hover:border-coral focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-teal"
                >
                  {MUSCLE_BY_ID[id]?.en ?? id}
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4 flex flex-wrap gap-2">
          <button type="button" className={btnPrimary} onClick={onRestart}>جولة جديدة</button>
          <button type="button" className={btnGhost} onClick={onExit}>رجوع للأطلس</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    );
  }

  const q = state.questions[state.index];
  if (!q) return null;
  const m = MUSCLE_BY_ID[q.id];
  const answered = state.picked !== null;
  const correct = answered && state.picked === q.correct;

  return (
    <div>
      <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <p className="text-xs font-bold tracking-wide text-ink-muted">
          سؤال <span className="font-mono">{state.index + 1}</span> من <span className="font-mono">{total}</span>
        </p>
        <div className="flex items-center gap-1.5">
          <span className={badge}>النتيجة {state.score}</span>
          {state.streak >= 2 && <span className={badge}>🔥 {state.streak}</span>}
          <button type="button" onClick={onExit} className="text-xs font-semibold text-ink-muted underline-offset-2 hover:text-teal hover:underline focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-teal">
            خروج
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-2 h-1 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-line" aria-hidden="true">
        <div className="h-full bg-teal transition-all duration-300 motion-reduce:transition-none" style={{ width: `${((state.index + (answered ? 1 : 0)) / total) * 100}%` }} />
      </div>

      <h3 className="mt-3 text-sm font-bold text-ink">{PROMPT[q.kind]}</h3>

      {(q.kind === 'locate' || q.kind === 'branch') && m && (
        <p dir="ltr" className="mt-1 text-start font-display text-xl font-bold text-ink">{m.en}</p>
      )}
      {q.kind === 'action' && m && (
        <p dir="ltr" className="mt-1 rounded-field border border-line bg-paper px-3 py-2 text-start text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-soft">{m.actEn}</p>
      )}
      {q.kind === 'attach' && m && (
        <dl dir="ltr" className="mt-1 rounded-field border border-line bg-paper px-3 py-2 text-start text-[13px] leading-snug text-ink-soft">
          <dt className="text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-ink-muted">Origin</dt>
          <dd>{m.origin}</dd>
          <dt className="mt-1 text-[11px] font-bold uppercase tracking-wide text-ink-muted">Insertion</dt>
          <dd>{m.insertion}</dd>
        </dl>
      )}

      {q.kind === 'locate' && !answered && (
        <button type="button" className={`${btnGhost} mt-3 w-full`} onClick={() => onAnswer('__skip')}>
          لا أعرف
        </button>
      )}

      {q.kind !== 'locate' && (
        <ul className="mt-3 grid gap-2">
          {q.options.map((opt) => {
            const label =
              q.kind === 'branch'
                ? FACIAL_BRANCHES.find((b) => b.id === opt)
                : null;
            const text = label ? label.en : (MUSCLE_BY_ID[opt]?.en ?? opt);
            return (
              <li key={opt}>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  dir="ltr"
                  disabled={answered}
                  onClick={() => onAnswer(opt)}
                  className={`${optionBase} ${optionTone(answered, opt === q.correct, opt === state.picked)}`}
                >
                  {text}
                  {label && <span dir="rtl" className="ms-2 text-xs text-ink-muted">({label.ar})</span>}
                </button>
              </li>
            );
          })}
        </ul>
      )}

      {answered && m && (
        <div className="mt-3 rounded-field border border-line bg-paper p-3" role="status">
          <p className={`text-sm font-bold ${correct ? 'text-teal' : 'text-coral-ink'}`}>
            {correct ? 'إجابة صحيحة ✓' : 'ليست صحيحة'}
          </p>
          <p dir="ltr" className="mt-1 text-start text-sm font-bold text-ink">{m.en}</p>
          <p dir="ltr" className="mt-0.5 text-start text-[13px] leading-relaxed text-ink">{m.actEn}</p>
          <p className="mt-0.5 text-[12px] leading-relaxed text-ink-muted">{ACTION_AR[m.id]}</p>
          <p dir="ltr" className="mt-1 text-start text-xs text-ink-muted">{m.nerve}</p>
        </div>
      )}

      {answered && (
        <button type="button" className={`${btnPrimary} mt-3 w-full`} onClick={onNext} autoFocus>
          {state.index + 1 >= total ? 'عرض النتيجة' : 'السؤال التالي'}
        </button>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// components/ui/Button.tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, type ButtonHTMLAttributes, type ReactNode } from 'react';

type Variant = 'primary' | 'secondary' | 'outline' | 'ghost' | 'danger' | 'gold';
type Size = 'xs' | 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

interface ButtonProps extends ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> {
  variant?: Variant;
  size?: Size;
  loading?: boolean;
  icon?: ReactNode;
  iconAfter?: ReactNode;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
}

// ==================== Variants ====================
const VARIANTS: Record<Variant, string> = {
  primary:
    'bg-teal text-on-teal ' +
    'hover:bg-teal-hover active:bg-teal-active ' +
    'shadow-xs hover:shadow-sm',

  secondary:
    'bg-paper-soft text-ink border border-line-strong ' +
    'hover:border-teal/40 hover:bg-paper-deep ' +
    'active:bg-paper-deep',

  outline:
    'bg-transparent text-teal border-2 border-teal/25 ' +
    'hover:border-teal/60 hover:bg-teal-tint ' +
    'active:bg-teal-soft',

  ghost:
    'bg-transparent text-ink-soft ' +
    'hover:bg-ink/5 hover:text-ink ' +
    'active:bg-ink/10',

  danger:
    'bg-transparent text-coral-ink border border-coral/25 ' +
    'hover:bg-coral-soft hover:border-coral/40 ' +
    'active:bg-coral-soft',

  // text-on-gold: نص داكن في الوضعين (text-ink يصير فاتحاً في الداكن)
  gold:
    'bg-gold text-on-gold ' +
    'hover:bg-gold-light active:brightness-95 ' +
    'shadow-xs hover:shadow-sm',
};

// ==================== Sizes ====================
// md = 44px (حد اللمس الأدنى). xs/sm للواجهات الكثيفة فقط.
const SIZES: Record<Size, string> = {
  xs: 'h-7 px-2.5 text-xs gap-1 rounded-field',
  sm: 'h-9 px-3.5 text-sm gap-1.5 rounded-field',
  md: 'h-11 px-5 text-sm gap-2 rounded-field',
  lg: 'h-13 px-7 text-base gap-2.5 rounded-field',
};

// حالة التعطيل بتوكنات النظام (لا opacity). لا تُطبَّق أثناء loading
// حتى يبقى الزر بلونه مع المؤشر الدوّار.
const DISABLED =
  'disabled:pointer-events-none disabled:border-transparent disabled:bg-disabled ' +
  'disabled:text-disabled-ink disabled:shadow-none disabled:active:scale-100';

// ==================== Spinner ====================
function Spinner() {
  return (
    <svg
      className="h-4 w-4 flex-shrink-0 animate-spin"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      fill="none"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <circle cx="12" cy="12" r="10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" opacity="0.25" />
      <path d="M22 12a10 10 0 0 1-10 10" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth="3" strokeLinecap="round" />
    </svg>
  );
}

// ==================== Component ====================
export const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(function Button(
  {
    variant = 'primary',
    size = 'md',
    loading,
    icon,
    iconAfter,
    fullWidth,
    disabled,
    children,
    className = '',
    ...rest
  },
  ref
) {
  return (
    <button
      ref={ref}
      disabled={disabled || loading}
      aria-busy={loading || undefined}
      className={[
        // base — بدون tracking: letter-spacing السالب يقطع اتصال الحروف العربية
        'inline-flex select-none items-center justify-center font-semibold',
        'transition-[background-color,border-color,color,box-shadow,transform] duration-200 ease-[var(--ease-editorial)]',
        'active:scale-[0.98]',
        VARIANTS[variant],
        SIZES[size],
        loading ? 'pointer-events-none cursor-progress' : DISABLED,
        fullWidth ? 'w-full' : '',
        className,
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(' ')}
      {...rest}
    >
      {loading ? (
        <Spinner />
      ) : icon ? (
        <span className="flex-shrink-0">{icon}</span>
      ) : null}

      {children && <span className="truncate">{children}</span>}

      {iconAfter && !loading && <span className="flex-shrink-0">{iconAfter}</span>}
    </button>
  );
});
```

```tsx
// components/ui/Card.tsx
import {
  type ElementType,
  type ReactNode,
  type HTMLAttributes,
  type KeyboardEvent,
} from 'react';

type Variant = 'default' | 'featured' | 'flat';
type Padding = 'sm' | 'md' | 'lg';

interface CardProps extends HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> {
  as?: 'div' | 'article' | 'section' | 'li';
  variant?: Variant;
  padding?: Padding;
  hoverable?: boolean;
  children: ReactNode;
}

const PADDING: Record<Padding, string> = {
  sm: 'p-4',
  md: 'p-5 sm:p-6',
  lg: 'p-6 sm:p-8',
};

const VARIANT: Record<Variant, string> = {
  // العادية — سطح فاتح، حد خفيف
  default: 'bg-paper-soft border border-line shadow-xs',

  // المميزة — مسطّحة: حد ذهبي عند بداية السطر (يمين في RTL) بدل التدرّج
  featured:
    'bg-paper-soft border border-teal/20 border-s-[3px] border-s-gold shadow-sm',

  // بدون خلفية — للقوائم داخل بطاقة موجودة
  flat: 'bg-transparent border border-transparent',
};

export function Card({
  as: Tag = 'div',
  variant = 'default',
  padding = 'md',
  hoverable = false,
  children,
  className = '',
  onKeyDown,
  ...rest
}: CardProps) {
  const Component: ElementType = Tag;

  // بطاقة قابلة للنقر: تصير قابلة للوصول بالكيبورد (Tab + Enter/Space)
  const clickable = typeof rest.onClick === 'function';

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
    onKeyDown?.(e);
    if (
      clickable &&
      e.target === e.currentTarget &&
      (e.key === 'Enter' || e.key === ' ')
    ) {
      e.preventDefault();
      (e.currentTarget as HTMLElement).click();
    }
  };

  const finalClassName = [
    'rounded-card',
    VARIANT[variant],
    PADDING[padding],
    hoverable ? 'card-editorial-hover' : 'transition-colors duration-300',
    clickable ? 'cursor-pointer' : '',
    className,
  ]
    .filter(Boolean)
    .join(' ');

  return (
    <Component
      tabIndex={clickable ? 0 : undefined}
      role={clickable ? 'button' : undefined}
      onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
      className={finalClassName}
      {...rest}
    >
      {children}
    </Component>
  );
}

// ==================== Card.Header ====================
export function CardHeader({
  children,
  className = '',
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <div className={`mb-3 flex items-start justify-between gap-3 ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </div>
  );
}

// ==================== Card.Title ====================
export function CardTitle({
  children,
  className = '',
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <h3 className={`text-base font-bold leading-snug text-ink sm:text-lg ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </h3>
  );
}

// ==================== Card.Description ====================
export function CardDescription({
  children,
  className = '',
}: {
  children: ReactNode;
  className?: string;
}) {
  return (
    <p className={`text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink-soft ${className}`}>
      {children}
    </p>
  );
}
```

```tsx
// components/ui/ConfirmDialog.tsx
'use client';

import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useEffect,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { Button } from './Button';

interface ConfirmOptions {
  title?: string;
  confirmLabel?: string;
  cancelLabel?: string;
  variant?: 'primary' | 'danger';
}

interface State extends ConfirmOptions {
  message: string;
  resolve: (v: boolean) => void;
}

interface ConfirmContextValue {
  confirm: (message: string, options?: ConfirmOptions) => Promise<boolean>;
}

const ConfirmContext = createContext<ConfirmContextValue | null>(null);

export function ConfirmProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [state, setState] = useState<State | null>(null);

  const confirm = useCallback(
    (message: string, options?: ConfirmOptions) =>
      new Promise<boolean>((resolve) => setState({ message, ...options, resolve })),
    []
  );

  const close = useCallback((result: boolean) => {
    setState((current) => {
      if (!current) return null;
      current.resolve(result);
      return null;
    });
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    if (!state) return;
    function onKey(e: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (e.key === 'Escape') close(false);
    }
    window.addEventListener('keydown', onKey);
    return () => window.removeEventListener('keydown', onKey);
  }, [state, close]);

  return (
    <ConfirmContext.Provider value={{ confirm }}>
      {children}
      {state && (
        <div
          className="fixed inset-0 z-[70] flex items-center justify-center bg-ink/50 p-4 backdrop-blur-sm animate-fade-in"
          role="dialog"
          aria-modal="true"
          onClick={() => close(false)}
        >
          <div
            className="w-full max-w-sm rounded-3xl border border-line bg-paper p-6 shadow-[0_24px_60px_rgba(26,33,31,0.30)] animate-scale-in"
            onClick={(e) => e.stopPropagation()}
          >
            <div className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-2xl bg-red-50 text-red-600">
              <svg className="h-6 w-6" fill="none" viewBox="0 0 24 24" stroke="currentColor" strokeWidth={2}>
                <path strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" d="M12 9v2m0 4h.01m-6.938 4h13.856c1.54 0 2.502-1.667 1.732-3L13.732 4c-.77-1.333-2.694-1.333-3.464 0L3.34 16c-.77 1.333.192 3 1.732 3z" />
              </svg>
            </div>
            {state.title && <h3 className="mt-4 text-lg font-extrabold text-ink">{state.title}</h3>}
            <p className="mt-2 text-sm leading-relaxed text-ink/70">{state.message}</p>
            <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-2">
              <Button variant="secondary" size="sm" onClick={() => close(false)}>
                {state.cancelLabel ?? 'إلغاء'}
              </Button>
              <Button variant={state.variant ?? 'danger'} size="sm" onClick={() => close(true)}>
                {state.confirmLabel ?? 'تأكيد'}
              </Button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
    </ConfirmContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useConfirm() {
  const ctx = useContext(ConfirmContext);
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useConfirm must be used inside <ConfirmProvider>');
  return ctx.confirm;
}
```
