## lib\telegram\inquiries.ts

```ts
// lib/telegram/inquiries.ts
import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '../supabaseAdmin';

// ==================== Types ====================
export interface Inquiry {
  id: string;
  chat_id: number;
  student_name: string | null;
  stage: string | null;
  question: string;
  status: 'pending' | 'answered' | 'closed';
  admin_reply: string | null;
  replied_by: number | null;
  replied_at: string | null;
  created_at: string;
}

// ==================== Create ====================
export async function createInquiry(args: {
  chatId: number;
  studentName: string | null;
  stage: string | null;
  question: string;
}): Promise<{ ok: true; inquiry: Inquiry } | { ok: false; error: string }> {
  const question = args.question.trim().slice(0, 1500);
  if (!question) return { ok: false, error: 'السؤال فارغ' };

  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_inquiries')
    .insert({
      chat_id: args.chatId,
      student_name: args.studentName,
      stage: args.stage,
      question,
    })
    .select('*')
    .single<Inquiry>();

  if (error || !data) {
    console.error('[inquiries] create error:', error?.message);
    return { ok: false, error: error?.message ?? 'فشل الحفظ' };
  }

  return { ok: true, inquiry: data };
}

// ==================== Read ====================
export async function listPendingInquiries(
  limit = 10,
): Promise<Inquiry[]> {
  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_inquiries')
    .select('*')
    .eq('status', 'pending')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(limit);

  if (error) {
    console.error('[inquiries] list pending error:', error.message);
    return [];
  }
  return (data ?? []) as Inquiry[];
}

export async function countPendingInquiries(): Promise<number> {
  const { count, error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_inquiries')
    .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
    .eq('status', 'pending');
  if (error) return 0;
  return count ?? 0;
}

export async function getInquiry(id: string): Promise<Inquiry | null> {
  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_inquiries')
    .select('*')
    .eq('id', id)
    .maybeSingle<Inquiry>();
  if (error || !data) return null;
  return data;
}

// ==================== Answer ====================
export async function answerInquiry(args: {
  id: string;
  reply: string;
  adminChatId: number;
}): Promise<{ ok: boolean; inquiry?: Inquiry; error?: string }> {
  const reply = args.reply.trim().slice(0, 1500);
  if (!reply) return { ok: false, error: 'الرد فارغ' };

  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_inquiries')
    .update({
      status: 'answered',
      admin_reply: reply,
      replied_by: args.adminChatId,
      replied_at: new Date().toISOString(),
    })
    .eq('id', args.id)
    .eq('status', 'pending')
    .select('*')
    .maybeSingle<Inquiry>();

  if (error) {
    console.error('[inquiries] answer error:', error.message);
    return { ok: false, error: error.message };
  }
  if (!data) return { ok: false, error: 'الاستفسار غير موجود أو تمت معالجته' };
  return { ok: true, inquiry: data };
}

// ==================== Close without reply ====================
export async function closeInquiry(
  id: string,
): Promise<{ ok: boolean; inquiry?: Inquiry; error?: string }> {
  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_inquiries')
    .update({ status: 'closed' })
    .eq('id', id)
    .eq('status', 'pending')
    .select('*')
    .maybeSingle<Inquiry>();

  if (error) return { ok: false, error: error.message };
  if (!data) return { ok: false, error: 'الاستفسار غير موجود' };
  return { ok: true, inquiry: data };
}

// ==================== Format ====================
export function formatInquiryForAdmin(
  inq: Inquiry,
  escapeHtml: (s: string) => string,
): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push('📮 <b>استفسار جديد</b>');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`👤 ${escapeHtml(inq.student_name ?? 'غير معروف')}`);
  if (inq.stage) lines.push(`📌 ${escapeHtml(inq.stage)}`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('❓ <b>السؤال:</b>');
  lines.push(escapeHtml(inq.question));
  return lines.join('\n');
}

```ts
// lib/telegram/notify-admins.ts
import {
  sendMessage,
  escapeHtml,
  type InlineKeyboardMarkup,
} from '../telegram';
import { listSuperAdmins } from '../telegram-admins';
import type { Subscriber } from './types';
import { groupLabel, groupEmoji } from './subscribers';
import type { Inquiry } from './inquiries';

// ==================== New Inquiry ====================
export async function notifySuperAdminsNewInquiry(
  inq: Inquiry,
): Promise<void> {
  const supers = await listSuperAdmins();
  if (supers.length === 0) return;

  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push('📮 <b>استفسار جديد</b>');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`👤 ${escapeHtml(inq.student_name ?? 'غير معروف')}`);
  if (inq.stage) lines.push(`📌 ${escapeHtml(inq.stage)}`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('❓ <b>السؤال:</b>');
  lines.push(escapeHtml(inq.question));

  const kb: InlineKeyboardMarkup = {
    inline_keyboard: [
      [
        { text: '💬 رد', callback_data: `inq_reply:${inq.id}` },
        { text: '✅ إغلاق بدون رد', callback_data: `inq_close:${inq.id}` },
      ],
    ],
  };

  const text = lines.join('\n');
  for (const s of supers) {
    try {
      await sendMessage(s.chat_id, text, { reply_markup: kb });
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }
}

// ==================== New Subscriber ====================
export async function notifySuperAdminsNewSubscriber(
  sub: Subscriber,
): Promise<void> {
  const supers = await listSuperAdmins();
  if (supers.length === 0) return;

  const subjectCount = sub.subjects.length;
  const groupLine = sub.group_name
    ? `${groupEmoji(sub.group_name)} <b>${groupLabel(sub.group_name)}</b>`
    : '—';

  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push('🎉 <b>مشترك جديد</b>');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(
    `👤 ${escapeHtml(sub.first_name ?? 'غير معروف')}${
      sub.username ? ` (@${escapeHtml(sub.username)})` : ''
    }`,
  );
  lines.push(`📌 ${escapeHtml(sub.stage ?? '—')}`);
  lines.push(`👥 ${groupLine}`);
  lines.push(`📚 ${subjectCount > 0 ? `${subjectCount} مادة` : 'كل المواد'}`);

  const text = lines.join('\n');
  for (const s of supers) {
    try {
      await sendMessage(s.chat_id, text);
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }
}

// ==================== New Pending Announcement ====================
export async function notifySuperAdminsNewAnnouncementPending(info: {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  body: string;
  stage: string | null;
  created_by: string;
}): Promise<void> {
  const supers = await listSuperAdmins();
  if (supers.length === 0) return;

  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push('📢 <b>تبليغ جديد بانتظار المراجعة</b>');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`👤 من: ${escapeHtml(info.created_by)}`);
  lines.push(`🎯 ${info.stage ? escapeHtml(info.stage) : 'كل المراحل'}`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`<b>${escapeHtml(info.title)}</b>`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(escapeHtml(info.body));

  const kb: InlineKeyboardMarkup = {
    inline_keyboard: [
      [
        { text: '✅ موافقة وإرسال', callback_data: `ann_approve:${info.id}` },
        { text: '❌ رفض', callback_data: `ann_reject:${info.id}` },
      ],
      [{ text: '🗑 حذف', callback_data: `ann_delete:${info.id}` }],
    ],
  };

  const text = lines.join('\n');
  for (const s of supers) {
    try {
      await sendMessage(s.chat_id, text, { reply_markup: kb });
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }
  }
}

## lib\telegram\sessions.ts

```ts
// lib/telegram/sessions.ts
import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '../supabaseAdmin';

// ==================== Types ====================
export type SessionFlowType =
  | 'idle'
  | 'announce'
  | 'add_admin'
  | 'reject'
  | 'inquiry';

export interface AnnouncementDraft {
  templateId: string | null;
  title: string | null;
  body: string | null;
  stage: string | null;
  link_url: string | null;
  link_label: string | null;
}

export interface Session {
  chat_id: number;
  flow_type: SessionFlowType;
  flow_step: string | null;
  flow_data: Record<string, unknown>;
  updated_at: string;
}

// ==================== Helpers ====================
const SESSION_TTL_MS = 60 * 60 * 1000; // ساعة واحدة

function isFresh(updatedAt: string): boolean {
  const t = Date.parse(updatedAt);
  if (Number.isNaN(t)) return false;
  return Date.now() - t < SESSION_TTL_MS;
}

// ==================== Read ====================
export async function getSession(
  chatId: number,
): Promise<Session | null> {
  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_sessions')
    .select('*')
    .eq('chat_id', chatId)
    .maybeSingle<Session>();

  if (error || !data) return null;
  if (!isFresh(data.updated_at)) {
    // جلسة قديمة — نظّفها
    void clearSession(chatId);
    return null;
  }
  return data;
}

// ==================== Write ====================
export async function setSession(
  chatId: number,
  flowType: SessionFlowType,
  flowStep: string | null,
  flowData: Record<string, unknown> = {},
): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_sessions')
    .upsert(
      {
        chat_id: chatId,
        flow_type: flowType,
        flow_step: flowStep,
        flow_data: flowData,
        updated_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      },
      { onConflict: 'chat_id' },
    );

  if (error) {
    console.error('[sessions] setSession error:', error.message);
  }
}

export async function clearSession(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_sessions')
    .delete()
    .eq('chat_id', chatId);
  if (error) {
    console.error('[sessions] clearSession error:', error.message);
  }
}

// ==================== Cleanup ====================
/**
 * احذف كل الجلسات القديمة (أكثر من ساعة بدون تحديث).
 * تُستدعى من الويب هوك sporadically.
 */
export async function cleanupStaleSessions(): Promise<void> {
  const cutoff = new Date(Date.now() - SESSION_TTL_MS).toISOString();
  const { error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_sessions')
    .delete()
    .lt('updated_at', cutoff);
  if (error) {
    console.error('[sessions] cleanup error:', error.message);
  }
}

// ==================== Typed getters ====================
export async function getAnnouncementDraft(
  chatId: number,
): Promise<AnnouncementDraft | null> {
  const s = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!s || s.flow_type !== 'announce') return null;
  const draft = s.flow_data.draft as AnnouncementDraft | undefined;
  return draft ?? null;
}

export function emptyAnnouncementDraft(): AnnouncementDraft {
  return {
    templateId: null,
    title: null,
    body: null,
    stage: null,
    link_url: null,
    link_label: null,
  };
}

```ts
// lib/telegram/subscribers.ts
import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '../supabaseAdmin';
import type { Subscriber, OnboardingStep } from './types';

// ==================== Read ====================
export async function getSubscriber(
  chatId: number,
): Promise<Subscriber | null> {
  const { data, error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_subscribers')
    .select('*')
    .eq('chat_id', chatId)
    .maybeSingle<Subscriber>();

  if (error) {
    console.error('[subs] get error:', error.message);
    return null;
  }
  return data ?? null;
}

// ==================== Upsert ====================
export async function upsertSubscriber(
  user: { id: number; first_name?: string; username?: string },
  patch: Partial<Subscriber>,
): Promise<void> {
  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const existing = await getSubscriber(user.id);

  if (existing) {
    const { error } = await supabase
      .from('telegram_subscribers')
      .update({ ...patch, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
      .eq('chat_id', user.id);
    if (error) console.error('[subs] update error:', error.message);
  } else {
    const { error } = await supabase.from('telegram_subscribers').insert({
      chat_id: user.id,
      first_name: user.first_name ?? null,
      username: user.username ?? null,
      ...patch,
    });
    if (error) console.error('[subs] insert error:', error.message);
  }
}

// ==================== Onboarding helpers ====================
export function isFullyOnboarded(sub: Subscriber | null): boolean {
  if (!sub) return false;
  return (
    sub.stage !== null &&
    sub.group_name !== null &&
    sub.onboarding_step === 'idle'
  );
}

export async function setOnboardingStep(
  chatId: number,
  step: OnboardingStep,
): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_subscribers')
    .update({ onboarding_step: step, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() })
    .eq('chat_id', chatId);
  if (error) console.error('[subs] setOnboardingStep error:', error.message);
}

// ==================== Delete (unsubscribe) ====================
export async function deleteSubscriber(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const { error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_subscribers')
    .delete()
    .eq('chat_id', chatId);
  if (error) console.error('[subs] delete error:', error.message);
}

// ==================== Stats ====================
export async function countSubscribers(): Promise<number> {
  const { count, error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_subscribers')
    .select('chat_id', { count: 'exact', head: true });
  if (error) return 0;
  return count ?? 0;
}

// ==================== Group label helpers ====================
export function groupLabel(g: 'A' | 'B'): string {
  return g === 'A' ? 'كروب A' : 'كروب B';
}

export function groupEmoji(g: 'A' | 'B'): string {
  return g === 'A' ? '🔵' : '🟡';
}

// ==================== Helpers ====================
export function getTemplate(id: string): AnnouncementTemplate | null {
  return ANNOUNCEMENT_TEMPLATES.find((t) => t.id === id) ?? null;
}

/**
 * يُرجع معاينة قصيرة من نص القالب (أول 60 حرف)
 */
export function previewOf(body: string): string {
  const firstLine = body.split('\n')[0] ?? '';
  return firstLine.length > 60 ? firstLine.slice(0, 57) + '…' : firstLine;
}

// lib/telegram/types.ts
/**

// ==================== Telegram Update ====================
export interface TelegramUser {
  id: number;
  first_name?: string;
  username?: string;
}

export interface TelegramChat {
  id: number;
  type: string;
}

export interface TelegramMessage {
  message_id: number;
  from?: TelegramUser;
  chat: TelegramChat;
  text?: string;
}

export interface TelegramCallbackQuery {
  id: string;
  from: TelegramUser;
  message?: {
    message_id: number;
    chat: TelegramChat;
  };
  data?: string;
}

export interface TelegramUpdate {
  update_id: number;
  message?: TelegramMessage;
  callback_query?: TelegramCallbackQuery;
}

// ==================== Reply Keyboard ====================

  text: string;

}

  input_field_placeholder?: string;
  remove_keyboard?: never;
}

  | 'choosing_stage'

  );
}

// lib/telegram/handlers/admin.ts
import {
  sendMessage,
  editMessageText,
  answerCallbackQuery,
  escapeHtml,
} from '../../telegram';
import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '../../supabaseAdmin';
import {
  listAdmins,
  registerAdmin,
  deactivateAdmin,
  roleLabel,
  type TelegramAdmin,
  type AdminRole,
} from '../../telegram-admins';
import { sendAnnouncement } from '../../telegram-notifications';
import { setSession, clearSession, getSession } from '../sessions';
import {
  pendingItemKeyboard,
  roleKeyboard,
  SUPER_ADMIN_MENU,
  ADMIN_MENU,
} from './menus';
import { ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS } from '../types';
import { countPendingInquiries } from '../inquiries';

// ==================== Admin Help ====================
export async function sendAdminHelp(
  chatId: number,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  const isSuper = admin.role === 'super_admin';
  const lines: string[] = [];

  lines.push(`📖 <b>دليل ${isSuper ? 'المشرف الأعلى' : 'المشرف'}</b>`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`👤 دورك: <b>${roleLabel(admin.role)}</b>`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('👇 استخدم الأزرار الثابتة بالأسفل، أو الأوامر النصية.');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  lines.push('🗺️ <b>الأوامر المتاحة</b>');
  lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('📢 <code>/announce</code> — إنشاء تبليغ بقوالب جاهزة');

  if (isSuper) {
    lines.push('📋 <code>/pending</code> — التبليغات قيد المراجعة');
    lines.push('📜 <code>/history</code> — آخر التبليغات');
    lines.push('📊 <code>/stats</code> — إحصائيات البوت');
    lines.push('📮 <code>/inquiries</code> — الاستفسارات');
    lines.push('👥 <code>/admins</code> — قائمة المشرفين');
    lines.push('➕ <code>/add_admin</code> — إضافة مشرف');
    lines.push('➖ <code>/remove_admin</code> — حذف مشرف');
  } else {
    lines.push('📋 <code>/pending</code> — عرض المعلقة (بدون موافقة)');
  }

  lines.push('❌ <code>/cancel</code> — إلغاء أي عملية');
  lines.push('📖 <code>/admin_help</code> — هذا الدليل');

  await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'), {
    reply_markup: isSuper ? SUPER_ADMIN_MENU : ADMIN_MENU,
  });
}

// ==================== Pending List ====================
export async function handlePendingList(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const { data } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .select('*')
    .eq('status', 'pending')
    .order('created_at', { ascending: true })
    .limit(15);

  const items = (data ?? []) as Array<{
    id: string;
    title: string;
    body: string;
    stage: string | null;
    created_by: string;
  }>;

  if (items.length === 0) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ لا توجد تبليغات بانتظار المراجعة.');
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(chatId, `📋 <b>${items.length}</b> تبليغ بانتظار المراجعة:`);

  for (const a of items) {
    const lines: string[] = [];
    lines.push(`📢 <b>${escapeHtml(a.title)}</b>`);
    lines.push(
      `🎯 ${
        a.stage ? escapeHtml(a.stage) : 'كل المراحل'
      } • 👤 ${escapeHtml(a.created_by)}`,
    );
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(escapeHtml(a.body));
    await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'), {
      reply_markup: pendingItemKeyboard(a.id),
    });
  }
}

// ==================== Approve ====================
export async function handleApprove(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    from: { id: number };
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  id: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  if (admin.role !== 'super_admin') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, '❌ غير مصرح — تحتاج صلاحية مشرف أعلى');
    return;
  }

  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const supabase = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { data: existing } = await supabase
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .select('status')
    .eq('id', id)
    .maybeSingle<{ status: string }>();

  if (!existing) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'التبليغ غير موجود');
    return;
  }
  if (existing.status !== 'pending') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'تمت معالجة هذا التبليغ مسبقاً');
    return;
  }

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, '⏳ جاري الإرسال...');

  await supabase
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .update({
      status: 'approved',
      reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      reviewed_by: 'super_admin',
    })
    .eq('id', id);

  let result: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof sendAnnouncement>>;
  try {
    result = await sendAnnouncement(id);
  } catch (err) {
    const msg = err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'خطأ غير معروف';
    await supabase
      .from('telegram_announcements')
      .update({ status: 'failed', sent_error: msg })
      .eq('id', id);
    await sendMessage(chatId, `❌ فشل الإرسال: ${escapeHtml(msg)}`);
    return;
  }

  if (result.error) {
    await supabase
      .from('telegram_announcements')
      .update({
        status: 'failed',
        sent_error: result.error,
        sent_count: result.sent,
      })
      .eq('id', id);
    await sendMessage(chatId, `❌ فشل الإرسال: ${escapeHtml(result.error)}`);
    return;
  }

  await supabase
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .update({
      status: 'sent',
      sent_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      sent_count: result.sent,
      sent_error: result.failed > 0 ? `فشل ${result.failed}` : null,
    })
    .eq('id', id);

  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, '✅ تم الإرسال', {
      reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [] },
    });
  }

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `✅ <b>تم الإرسال</b>\n\n📤 نجح: ${result.sent}\n❌ فشل: ${result.failed}`,
  );
}

// ==================== Reject ====================
export async function handleRejectStart(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  id: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  if (admin.role !== 'super_admin') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, '❌ غير مصرح');
    return;
  }

  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  await setSession(chatId, 'reject', 'awaiting_reason', {
    announcement_id: id,
  });

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    '📝 اكتب <b>سبب الرفض</b> (أو أرسل <code>-</code> بدون سبب) — أو /cancel للإلغاء:',
  );
}

export async function handleRejectText(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  if (admin.role !== 'super_admin') {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'reject') {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const id = session.flow_data.announcement_id as string | undefined;
  if (!id) {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const trimmed = text.trim();
  const note = trimmed === '-' || trimmed === '' ? null : trimmed.slice(0, 500);

  const { error } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .update({
      status: 'rejected',
      reviewed_at: new Date().toISOString(),
      reviewed_by: 'super_admin',
      reviewed_note: note,
    })
    .eq('id', id)
    .eq('status', 'pending');

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (error) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ فشل الرفض. حاول مرة ثانية.');
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ تم رفض التبليغ.');
}

// ==================== Delete ====================
export async function handleDeleteAnnouncement(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  id: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  if (admin.role !== 'super_admin') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, '❌ غير مصرح');
    return;
  }

  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  await getSupabaseAdmin().from('telegram_announcements').delete().eq('id', id);
  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'تم الحذف');
  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, '🗑 تم حذف التبليغ.', {
      reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [] },
    });
  } else {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '🗑 تم حذف التبليغ.');
  }
}

// ==================== History ====================
export async function handleHistory(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const { data } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .select('id, title, status, sent_count, sent_at, created_at, reviewed_note')
    .in('status', ['sent', 'rejected', 'failed'])
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })
    .limit(10);

  const items = (data ?? []) as Array<{
    id: string;
    title: string;
    status: string;
    sent_count: number;
    sent_at: string | null;
    created_at: string;
    reviewed_note: string | null;
  }>;

  if (items.length === 0) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, 'لا يوجد سجل بعد.');
    return;
  }

  const lines: string[] = ['📜 <b>آخر التبليغات</b>', ''];
  for (const a of items) {
    const emoji =
      a.status === 'sent' ? '✅' : a.status === 'rejected' ? '❌' : '⚠️';
    lines.push(`${emoji} <b>${escapeHtml(a.title)}</b>`);
    if (a.status === 'sent') lines.push(`  أُرسل لـ ${a.sent_count} مشترك`);
    if (a.status === 'rejected' && a.reviewed_note)
      lines.push(`  ${escapeHtml(a.reviewed_note)}`);
    lines.push('');
  }
  await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'));
}

// ==================== Stats ====================
export async function handleStats(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const supabaseAdmin = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const [
    subsCount,
    pendingAnnCount,
    sentAnnCount,
    pendingInqCount,
    adminsCount,
  ] = await Promise.all([
    supabaseAdmin
      .from('telegram_subscribers')
      .select('chat_id', { count: 'exact', head: true }),
    supabaseAdmin
      .from('telegram_announcements')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('status', 'pending'),
    supabaseAdmin
      .from('telegram_announcements')
      .select('id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('status', 'sent'),
    countPendingInquiries(),
    supabaseAdmin
      .from('telegram_admins')
      .select('chat_id', { count: 'exact', head: true })
      .eq('is_active', true),
  ]);

  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push('📊 <b>إحصائيات البوت</b>');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`👥 المشتركون: <b>${subsCount.count ?? 0}</b>`);
  lines.push(`👤 المشرفون النشطون: <b>${adminsCount.count ?? 0}</b>`);
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`📋 تبليغات منتظرة: <b>${pendingAnnCount.count ?? 0}</b>`);
  lines.push(`📤 تبليغات أُرسلت: <b>${sentAnnCount.count ?? 0}</b>`);
  lines.push(`📮 استفسارات منتظرة: <b>${pendingInqCount}</b>`);

  await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'));
}

// ==================== List Admins ====================
export async function handleListAdmins(chatId: number): Promise<void> {

// ==================== Add Admin ====================
export async function handleAddAdminStart(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  await setSession(chatId, 'add_admin', 'awaiting_chat_id', {});
  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    '👤 <b>إضافة مشرف جديد</b>\n\nأرسل <b>Chat ID</b> أو <b>@username</b> للمشرف:\n' +
      '<i>يجب أن يبدأ محادثة مع البوت أول مرة.</i>',
    {
      reply_markup: {
        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '❌ إلغاء', callback_data: 'admin_cancel' }]],
      },
    },
  );
}

export async function handleAddAdminChatId(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const clean = text.trim().replace(/^@/, '');
  let targetId: number | null = null;

  if (/^-?\d+$/.test(clean)) {
    targetId = Number(clean);
  } else {
    const { data } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
      .from('telegram_subscribers')
      .select('chat_id')
      .ilike('username', clean)
      .maybeSingle<{ chat_id: number }>();
    if (data) targetId = data.chat_id;
  }

  if (!targetId) {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      '❌ ما لقيت هذا المستخدم. تأكد من الـChat ID أو أن اليوزر بدأ محادثة مع البوت.',
    );
    return;
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'add_admin', 'awaiting_role', {
    target_chat_id: targetId,
  });

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `👤 تم اختيار: <code>${targetId}</code>\n\nاختر الدور:`,
    { reply_markup: roleKeyboard() },
  );
}

export async function handleAddAdminRole(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  role: AdminRole,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'add_admin') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'انتهت الجلسة');
    return;
  }

  const targetId = session.flow_data.target_chat_id as number | undefined;
  if (!targetId) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'لا يوجد هدف');
    return;
  }

  const { data: sub } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_subscribers')
    .select('first_name, username')
    .eq('chat_id', targetId)
    .maybeSingle<{ first_name: string | null; username: string | null }>();

  const result = await registerAdmin({
    chatId: targetId,
    username: sub?.username ?? null,
    firstName: sub?.first_name ?? `Admin ${targetId}`,
    role,
    addedBy: chatId,
  });

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (!result.ok) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, `فشل: ${result.error ?? ''}`, true);
    return;
  }

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'تمت الإضافة');

  const confirm = `✅ تم إضافة <code>${targetId}</code> بدور <b>${roleLabel(
    role,
  )}</b>.`;
  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, confirm);
  } else {
    await sendMessage(chatId, confirm);
  }

  try {
    await sendMessage(
      targetId,
      `🎉 <b>تم تفعيلك في بوت لوازم</b>\n\nالدور: <b>${roleLabel(role)}</b>\n\n` +
        (role === 'super_admin'
          ? 'يمكنك الموافقة على التبليغات وإرسالها عبر /pending.'
          : role === 'admin'
            ? 'يمكنك إنشاء تبليغات عبر /announce، وسيراجعها المشرف الأعلى.'
            : 'يمكنك إنشاء تبليغات عبر /announce.') +
        '\n\n📖 اكتب /admin_help للمزيد',
      { reply_markup: role === 'super_admin' ? SUPER_ADMIN_MENU : ADMIN_MENU },
    );
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

// ==================== Remove Admin ====================
export async function handleRemoveAdmin(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const parts = text.split(/\s+/).slice(1);
  if (parts.length === 0 || !/^-?\d+$/.test(parts[0])) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ الصيغة: <code>/remove_admin CHAT_ID</code>');
    return;
  }
  const targetId = Number(parts[0]);

  if (targetId === chatId) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ ما تكدر تحذف نفسك.');
    return;
  }

  const result = await deactivateAdmin(targetId);
  if (!result.ok) {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      `❌ فشل الحذف: ${escapeHtml(result.error ?? '')}`,
    );
    return;
  }
  await sendMessage(chatId, `✅ تم حذف <code>${targetId}</code>.`);
}

// ==================== Quick Add Admin ====================
export async function quickAddAdmin(
  chatId: number,
  targetId: number,
  role: AdminRole,
): Promise<void> {
  const { data: sub } = await getSupabaseAdmin()
    .from('telegram_subscribers')
    .select('first_name, username')
    .eq('chat_id', targetId)
    .maybeSingle<{ first_name: string | null; username: string | null }>();

  const result = await registerAdmin({
    chatId: targetId,
    username: sub?.username ?? null,
    firstName: sub?.first_name ?? `Admin ${targetId}`,
    role,
    addedBy: chatId,
  });

  if (!result.ok) {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      `❌ فشل الإضافة: ${escapeHtml(result.error ?? '')}`,
    );
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `✅ تم إضافة <code>${targetId}</code> بدور <b>${roleLabel(role)}</b>.`,
  );

  try {
    await sendMessage(
      targetId,
      `🎉 <b>تم تفعيلك في بوت لوازم</b>\n\nالدور: <b>${roleLabel(role)}</b>\n\n📖 اكتب /admin_help للمزيد`,
      { reply_markup: role === 'super_admin' ? SUPER_ADMIN_MENU : ADMIN_MENU },
    );
  } catch {
    /* ignore */
  }
}

// ==================== Menu Button Router ====================
export async function handleAdminMenuButton(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<boolean> {
  const isSuper = admin.role === 'super_admin';

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.newAnnounce) {
    const { handleAnnounceStart } = await import('./announce');
    await handleAnnounceStart(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.pending) {
    await handlePendingList(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.inquiries && isSuper) {
    const { handleInquiriesList } = await import('./inquiries');
    await handleInquiriesList(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.admins && isSuper) {
    await handleListAdmins(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.stats && isSuper) {
    await handleStats(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === ADMIN_MENU_TEXTS.help) {
    await sendAdminHelp(chatId, admin);
    return true;
  }

  return false;
}

// lib/telegram/handlers/announce.ts
import {
  sendMessage,
  editMessageText,
  answerCallbackQuery,
  escapeHtml,
  STAGE_MAP,
} from '../../telegram';
import {
  setSession,
  clearSession,
  getSession,
  emptyAnnouncementDraft,
  type AnnouncementDraft,
} from '../sessions';
import {
  templatePickerKeyboard,
  draftPreviewKeyboard,
  stageListKeyboard,
  backToDraftKeyboard,
} from './menus';
import { getTemplate } from '../templates';
import { notifySuperAdminsNewAnnouncementPending } from '../notify-admins';
import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '../../supabaseAdmin';
import type { TelegramAdmin } from '../../telegram-admins';

// ==================== Preview Builder ====================
function buildPreview(draft: AnnouncementDraft): string {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push('📢 <b>معاينة التبليغ</b>');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(
    `🎯 المرحلة: <b>${
      draft.stage ? escapeHtml(draft.stage) : 'كل المراحل'
    }</b>`,
  );

  if (draft.templateId) {
    const tpl = getTemplate(draft.templateId);
    if (tpl) lines.push(`🏷️ القالب: ${tpl.emoji} ${escapeHtml(tpl.label)}`);
  }
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  if (draft.title) {
    lines.push(`<b>${escapeHtml(draft.title)}</b>`);
  } else {
    lines.push('<i>(لا يوجد عنوان)</i>');
  }
  lines.push('━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━');
  lines.push('');
  if (draft.body) {
    lines.push(escapeHtml(draft.body));
  } else {
    lines.push('<i>(لا يوجد نص)</i>');
  }
  if (draft.link_url) {
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(`🔗 ${escapeHtml(draft.link_label || draft.link_url)}`);
  }
  return lines.join('\n');
}

// ==================== Start ====================
export async function handleAnnounceStart(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  await clearSession(chatId);
  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `📢 <b>تبليغ جديد</b>\n\nاختر قالباً جاهزاً (يمكنك تعديله لاحقاً):`,
    { reply_markup: templatePickerKeyboard() },
  );
}

// ==================== Pick Template ====================
export async function handleTemplatePick(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    from: { id: number };
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  templateId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId || !messageId) return;

  const tpl = getTemplate(templateId);
  if (!tpl) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'قالب غير معروف');
    return;
  }

  const draft: AnnouncementDraft = {
    ...emptyAnnouncementDraft(),
    templateId: tpl.id,
    title: tpl.title,
    body: tpl.body,
    link_label: tpl.linkLabel ?? null,
  };

  await setSession(chatId, 'announce', 'draft', { draft });
  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, `تم اختيار ${tpl.label}`);

  await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, buildPreview(draft), {
    reply_markup: draftPreviewKeyboard(),
  });
}

// ==================== Edit Title ====================
export async function handleEditTitleStart(cb: {
  id: string;

  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'announce') {

    return;
  }

  const draft = session.flow_data.draft as AnnouncementDraft;
  await setSession(chatId, 'announce', 'edit_title', { draft });

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `✏️ <b>تعديل العنوان</b>\n\nالعنوان الحالي:\n<code>${escapeHtml(
      draft.title ?? '',
    )}</code>\n\nأرسل العنوان الجديد:`,
    { reply_markup: backToDraftKeyboard() },

}

    { reply_markup: backToDraftKeyboard() },
  );

// ==================== Choose Stage ====================
export async function handleChooseStageStart(cb: {
  id: string;
  message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
}): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'announce') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'انتهت الجلسة');
    return;
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'announce', 'choose_stage', session.flow_data);
  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
  await sendMessage(chatId, '🎯 اختر المرحلة:', {
    reply_markup: stageListKeyboard(),
  });
}

// ==================== Stage Picked ====================
export async function handleStagePick(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  code: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'announce') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'انتهت الجلسة');
    return;
  }

  const draft = { ...(session.flow_data.draft as AnnouncementDraft) };

  if (code === 'all') {
    draft.stage = null;
  } else {
    const stage = STAGE_MAP[code];
    if (!stage) {
      await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'مرحلة غير معروفة');
      return;
    }
    draft.stage = stage;
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'announce', 'draft', { draft });

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, draft.stage ?? 'كل المراحل');

  const text = buildPreview(draft);
  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, text, {
      reply_markup: draftPreviewKeyboard(),
    });
  } else {
    await sendMessage(chatId, text, { reply_markup: draftPreviewKeyboard() });
  }
}

export async function handleBackToDraft(cb: {
  id: string;
  message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
}): Promise<void> {

  if (!chatId) return;

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'announce') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'انتهت الجلسة');
    return;
  }

  const draft = session.flow_data.draft as AnnouncementDraft;
  await setSession(chatId, 'announce', 'draft', { draft });

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
  await sendMessage(chatId, buildPreview(draft), {
    reply_markup: draftPreviewKeyboard(),
  });
}

// ==================== Text Input Router ====================
export async function handleAnnounceTextInput(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  step: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'announce') {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const draft = { ...(session.flow_data.draft as AnnouncementDraft) };
  const trimmed = text.trim();

  if (step === 'edit_title') {
    if (trimmed.length < 3 || trimmed.length > 200) {
      await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ العنوان يجب أن يكون بين 3 و 200 حرف.');
      return;
    }
    draft.title = trimmed;
  } else if (step === 'edit_body') {
    if (trimmed.length < 5 || trimmed.length > 2000) {
      await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ النص يجب أن يكون بين 5 و 2000 حرف.');
      return;
    }
    draft.body = trimmed;
  } else if (step === 'edit_link_url') {
    if (trimmed === '-') {
      draft.link_url = null;
      draft.link_label = null;
    } else {
      try {
        const u = new URL(trimmed);
        if (u.protocol !== 'http:' && u.protocol !== 'https:') throw new Error();
      } catch {
        await sendMessage(
          chatId,
          '❌ رابط غير صالح. يجب أن يبدأ بـ https://',
        );
        return;
      }
      draft.link_url = trimmed;
    }
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'announce', 'draft', { draft });
  await sendMessage(chatId, buildPreview(draft), {
    reply_markup: draftPreviewKeyboard(),
  });
}

// ==================== Submit ====================
export async function handleAnnounceSubmit(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  admin: TelegramAdmin,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  const messageId = cb.message?.message_id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'announce') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'انتهت الجلسة');
    return;
  }

  const draft = session.flow_data.draft as AnnouncementDraft;
  if (!draft.title || !draft.body) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'العنوان والنص مطلوبان', true);
    return;
  }

  const supabaseAdmin = getSupabaseAdmin();
  const { data, error } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from('telegram_announcements')
    .insert({
      title: draft.title,
      body: draft.body,
      stage: draft.stage,
      link_url: draft.link_url,
      link_label: draft.link_label,
      created_by: admin.first_name,
      status: 'pending',
    })
    .select('id')
    .single<{ id: string }>();

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (error || !data) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'فشل الحفظ', true);
    await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ فشل إنشاء التبليغ. حاول مرة ثانية.');
    return;
  }

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'تم الإرسال للمراجعة');

  const text = `✅ <b>تم إرسال التبليغ للمراجعة</b>\n\nرقم: <code>${data.id.slice(
    0,
    8,
  )}</code>\n\n${
    admin.role === 'super_admin'
      ? 'يمكنك الموافقة الآن من /pending.'
      : 'سيتم إعلامك عند الموافقة أو الرفض.'
  }`;

  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, text);
  } else {
    await sendMessage(chatId, text);
  }

  // إشعار السوبر أدمن (fire-and-forget)
  void notifySuperAdminsNewAnnouncementPending({
    id: data.id,
    title: draft.title,
    body: draft.body,
    stage: draft.stage,
    created_by: admin.first_name,
  });
}

// ==================== Cancel ====================
export async function handleAnnounceCancel(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  await clearSession(chatId);
  await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ تم الإلغاء.');
}

## lib\telegram\handlers\inquiries.ts

```ts
// lib/telegram/handlers/inquiries.ts
import {
  sendMessage,
  answerCallbackQuery,
  escapeHtml,
} from '../../telegram';
import { getSubscriber } from '../subscribers';
import {
  createInquiry,
  listPendingInquiries,
  countPendingInquiries,
  getInquiry,
  answerInquiry,
  closeInquiry,
  formatInquiryForAdmin,
} from '../inquiries';
import { setSession, clearSession, getSession } from '../sessions';
import { notifySuperAdminsNewInquiry } from '../notify-admins';
import { inquiryActionsKeyboard, STUDENT_MENU } from './menus';

// ==================== Student: Start ====================
export async function handleInquiryStart(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);
  if (!sub || !sub.stage) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, 'يجب أن تكمل التسجيل أولاً.\nاكتب /start');
    return;
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'inquiry', 'awaiting_question', {});
  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `📮 <b>استفسار جديد</b>\n\n✍️ اكتب سؤالك أو استفسارك في رسالة واحدة، وسيصل للإدارة مباشرة.`,
    {
      reply_markup: {
        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '❌ إلغاء', callback_data: 'inq_cancel' }]],
      },
    },
  );
}

// ==================== Student: Submit ====================
export async function handleInquiryText(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);

  const result = await createInquiry({
    chatId,
    studentName: sub?.first_name ?? null,
    stage: sub?.stage ?? null,
    question: text,
  });

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (!result.ok) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, `❌ فشل الإرسال: ${result.error}`, {
      reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
    });
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `✅ <b>وصلنا استفسارك</b>\n\nسيتم الرد عليك في أقرب وقت. شكراً لك 🌟`,
    { reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU },
  );

  // إشعار السوبر أدمن (fire-and-forget)
  void notifySuperAdminsNewInquiry(result.inquiry);
}

// ==================== Admin: List Pending ====================
export async function handleInquiriesList(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const pending = await listPendingInquiries(10);

  if (pending.length === 0) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ لا توجد استفسارات بانتظار الرد.');
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `📮 <b>${pending.length}</b> استفسار بانتظار الرد:`,
  );

  for (const inq of pending) {
    const text = formatInquiryForAdmin(inq, escapeHtml);
    await sendMessage(chatId, text, {
      reply_markup: inquiryActionsKeyboard(inq.id),
    });
  }
}

// ==================== Admin: Start Reply ====================
export async function handleInquiryReplyStart(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  inquiryId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const inq = await getInquiry(inquiryId);
  if (!inq || inq.status !== 'pending') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'الاستفسار غير موجود أو تمت معالجته');
    return;
  }

  await setSession(chatId, 'inquiry', 'awaiting_reply', {
    inquiry_id: inquiryId,
  });

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `💬 <b>الرد على استفسار</b>\n\n👤 ${escapeHtml(
      inq.student_name ?? 'غير معروف',
    )}\n\n❓ ${escapeHtml(inq.question)}\n\n✍️ اكتب ردك الآن:`,
    {
      reply_markup: {
        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '❌ إلغاء', callback_data: 'inq_cancel' }]],
      },
    },
  );
}

// ==================== Admin: Submit Reply ====================
export async function handleInquiryReplyText(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  adminChatId: number,
): Promise<void> {
  const session = await getSession(chatId);
  if (!session || session.flow_type !== 'inquiry') {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    return;
  }

  const inquiryId = session.flow_data.inquiry_id as string | undefined;
  if (!inquiryId) {
    await clearSession(chatId);
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      '❌ لم أجد الاستفسار، حاول مرة ثانية من القائمة.',
    );
    return;
  }

  const result = await answerInquiry({
    id: inquiryId,
    reply: text,
    adminChatId,
  });

  await clearSession(chatId);

  if (!result.ok || !result.inquiry) {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      `❌ فشل الحفظ: ${result.error ?? 'غير معروف'}`,
    );
    return;
  }

  const inq = result.inquiry;

  // إرسال الرد للطالب
  const studentLines: string[] = [];
  studentLines.push('📬 <b>ردّ الإدارة على استفسارك</b>');
  studentLines.push('');
  studentLines.push('❓ <b>سؤالك:</b>');
  studentLines.push(escapeHtml(inq.question));
  studentLines.push('');
  studentLines.push('💬 <b>الرد:</b>');
  studentLines.push(escapeHtml(text));

  try {
    await sendMessage(inq.chat_id, studentLines.join('\n'), {
      reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
    });
  } catch {
    await sendMessage(
      chatId,
      '⚠️ تم الحفظ لكن تعذّر إرسال الرد للطالب.',
    );
    return;
  }

  await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ تم إرسال الرد للطالب.');
}

// ==================== Admin: Close ====================
export async function handleInquiryClose(
  cb: {
    id: string;
    message?: { chat: { id: number }; message_id: number };
  },
  inquiryId: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const chatId = cb.message?.chat.id ?? 0;
  if (!chatId) return;

  const result = await closeInquiry(inquiryId);
  await answerCallbackQuery(
    cb.id,
    result.ok ? 'تم الإغلاق' : result.error ?? 'فشل',
  );

  if (result.ok && result.inquiry) {
    // إشعار الطالب بأن استفساره تم الاطلاع عليه
    try {
      await sendMessage(
        result.inquiry.chat_id,
        `📭 تم الاطلاع على استفسارك وإغلاقه. إن كان لديك سؤال آخر، أرسل استفساراً جديداً.`,
        { reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU },
      );
    } catch {
      /* ignore */
    }

    await sendMessage(chatId, '✅ تم إغلاق الاستفسار.');
  }
}

// ==================== Cancel ====================
export async function handleInquiryCancel(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  await clearSession(chatId);
  await sendMessage(chatId, '❌ تم الإلغاء.', {
    reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
  });
}

// ==================== Count ====================
export async function getPendingInquiriesCount(): Promise<number> {
  return countPendingInquiries();
}

// lib/telegram/handlers/student.ts
import {
  sendMessage,
  editMessageText,
  answerCallbackQuery,
  escapeHtml,
  STAGE_MAP,
  type InlineKeyboardMarkup,
} from '../../telegram';
import { getSupabaseAdmin } from '../../supabaseAdmin';
import { STAGES } from '../../constants';
import {
  getSubscriber,
  upsertSubscriber,
  isFullyOnboarded,
  groupLabel,
  groupEmoji,
} from '../subscribers';
import {
  STUDENT_MENU,
  STUDENT_MENU_TEXTS,
} from './menus';
import type {
  Subscriber,
  TelegramMessage,
  TelegramCallbackQuery,
  NotifyToggleKey,
} from '../types';
import { NOTIFY_TOGGLE_LABELS } from '../types';

// ==================== Keyboards ====================
function stageKeyboard(): InlineKeyboardMarkup {
  return {
    inline_keyboard: [
      [{ text: '📘 المرحلة الأولى', callback_data: 'stage:1' }],
      [{ text: '📗 المرحلة الثانية', callback_data: 'stage:2' }],
      [{ text: '📙 المرحلة الثالثة', callback_data: 'stage:3' }],
    ],
  };
}

function groupKeyboard(): InlineKeyboardMarkup {
  return {
    inline_keyboard: [
      [{ text: '🔵 كروب A', callback_data: 'group:A' }],
      [{ text: '🟡 كروب B', callback_data: 'group:B' }],
    ],
  };
}

function startKeyboard(baseUrl: string): InlineKeyboardMarkup {
  return {
    inline_keyboard: [
      [{ text: '⚙️ الإعدادات', callback_data: 'settings:show' }],
      [{ text: '🔄 تحديث التسجيل', callback_data: 'onboarding:restart' }],
      [{ text: '🌐 افتح المنصة', url: baseUrl }],
    ],
  };
}

// ==================== Public Menu (Reply Keyboard) ====================
/**
 * أرسل القائمة الثابتة للطالب.
 * تُستدعى عند أول /start أو عندما يطلبها.
 */
export async function sendStudentMenu(
  chatId: number,
  intro: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  return sendMessage(chatId, intro, {
    reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
  });
}

// ==================== /start ====================
export async function handleStart(
  msg: TelegramMessage,
  baseUrl: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!msg.from) return;
  const chatId = msg.chat.id;
  const firstName = msg.from.first_name ?? '';

  const existing = await getSubscriber(chatId);

  // ✅ مسجّل بالكامل — لا تطلب منه المرحلة من جديد
  if (isFullyOnboarded(existing) && existing) {
    const subjectCount = existing.subjects.length;
    const groupLine = `${groupEmoji(existing.group_name!)} <b>${groupLabel(
      existing.group_name!,
    )}</b>`;

    const lines: string[] = [];
    lines.push(
      `👋 <b>أهلاً من جديد${firstName ? `، ${escapeHtml(firstName)}` : ''}!</b>`,
    );
    lines.push('');
    lines.push(`📌 مرحلتك: <b>${escapeHtml(existing.stage!)}</b>`);
    lines.push(`👥 كروبك: ${groupLine}`);
    lines.push(
      `📚 موادك: <b>${subjectCount > 0 ? `${subjectCount} مادة` : 'الكل'}</b>`,
    );
    lines.push('');
    lines.push('👇 استخدم الأزرار بالأسفل للتنقل.');

    await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'), {
      reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
    });
    return;
  }

  // ===== مسجّل جزئياً أو جديد → ابدأ التسجيل =====
  await upsertSubscriber(msg.from, { onboarding_step: 'choosing_stage' });

  const greeting = firstName ? `، ${escapeHtml(firstName)}` : '';
  const text = existing
    ? `👋 أهلاً من جديد${greeting}!\n\nاختر مرحلتك الدراسية:`
    : `👋 أهلاً${greeting}!\n\nأنا <b>بوت لوازم</b> — سأخبرك بالجديد في مرحلتك مباشرة.\n\nاختر مرحلتك الدراسية:`;

  await sendMessage(chatId, text, { reply_markup: stageKeyboard() });
}

// ==================== Stage Selection ====================
export async function handleStageSelection(
  cb: TelegramCallbackQuery,
  code: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!cb.message) return;
  const chatId = cb.message.chat.id;
  const messageId = cb.message.message_id;

  const stage = STAGE_MAP[code];
  if (!stage) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'مرحلة غير معروفة');
    return;
  }

  await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, {
    stage,
    group_name: null,
    subjects: [],
    onboarding_step: 'choosing_group',
  });

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, `تم اختيار ${stage}`);
  await editMessageText(
    chatId,
    messageId,
    `📚 <b>${escapeHtml(stage)}</b>\n\nالآن اختر كروبك النظري:`,
    { reply_markup: groupKeyboard() },
  );
}

// ==================== Group Selection ====================
export async function handleGroupSelection(
  cb: TelegramCallbackQuery,
  code: string,
  baseUrl: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!cb.message) return;
  const chatId = cb.message.chat.id;
  const messageId = cb.message.message_id;

  if (code !== 'A' && code !== 'B') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'كروب غير معروف');
    return;
  }

  const before = await getSubscriber(chatId);
  const fromSettings = before?.onboarding_step === 'choosing_group_from_settings';

  if (fromSettings) {
    await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, {
      group_name: code,
      onboarding_step: 'idle',
    });
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, `تم اختيار ${groupLabel(code)}`);
    await sendSettings(chatId, messageId);
  } else {
    await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, {
      group_name: code,
      onboarding_step: 'choosing_subjects',
    });
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, `تم اختيار ${groupLabel(code)}`);
    await sendSubjectsKeyboard(chatId, messageId, before?.stage ?? '');
  }
}

// ==================== Subject Toggle ====================
export async function handleSubjectToggle(
  cb: TelegramCallbackQuery,
  subjectName: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!cb.message) return;
  const chatId = cb.message.chat.id;
  const messageId = cb.message.message_id;

  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);
  if (!sub) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'حدث خطأ، أعد /start');
    return;
  }

  const current = new Set(sub.subjects ?? []);
  if (current.has(subjectName)) {
    current.delete(subjectName);
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, `تم إلغاء ${subjectName}`);
  } else {
    current.add(subjectName);
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, `تم إضافة ${subjectName}`);
  }

  await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, { subjects: Array.from(current) });
  await sendSubjectsKeyboard(chatId, messageId, sub.stage ?? '');
}

// ==================== Subjects Keyboard ====================
export async function sendSubjectsKeyboard(
  chatId: number,
  messageId: number,
  stage: string,
): Promise<void> {
  const supabaseAdmin = getSupabaseAdmin();

  const { data } = await supabaseAdmin
    .from('subjects')
    .select('name')
    .eq('stage', stage)
    .order('name');

  const subjectNames = (data ?? []).map((s: { name: string }) => s.name);

  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);
  const selected = new Set(sub?.subjects ?? []);

  const text = `📚 <b>اختر موادك</b>

المرحلة: <b>${escapeHtml(stage)}</b>

اضغط على المواد التي تريد متابعتها فقط.
إذا لم تختر أي مادة → ستصلك تحديثات <b>كل المواد</b>.

المحددة حالياً: <b>${
    selected.size > 0 ? `${selected.size} مادة` : 'كل المواد'
  }</b>`;

  const rows: { text: string; callback_data: string }[][] = [];
  subjectNames.slice(0, 20).forEach((name) => {
    const isSelected = selected.has(name);
    rows.push([
      {
        text: `${isSelected ? '✅' : '⬜'} ${name}`,
        callback_data: `subj:${name.slice(0, 40)}`,
      },
    ]);
  });

  rows.push([{ text: '🎯 تم', callback_data: 'subj_done' }]);

  await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, text, {
    reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: rows },
  });
}

// ==================== Subjects Done ====================
export async function handleSubjectsDone(
  cb: TelegramCallbackQuery,
  baseUrl: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!cb.message) return;
  const chatId = cb.message.chat.id;
  const messageId = cb.message.message_id;

  const wasOnboarding = (await getSubscriber(chatId))?.onboarding_step === 'choosing_subjects';

  await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, { onboarding_step: 'idle' });

  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);

  // ✅ إشعار السوبر أدمن فقط بتسجيل طالب جديد
  if (wasOnboarding && sub) {
    const { notifySuperAdminsNewSubscriber } = await import('../notify-admins');
    void notifySuperAdminsNewSubscriber(sub);
  }

  // ✅ إشعار السوبر أدمن بتسجيل طالب جديد
  if (wasOnboarding && sub) {
    const { notifySuperAdminsNewSubscriber } = await import('../notify-admins');
    void notifySuperAdminsNewSubscriber(sub);
  }
  const subjectCount = sub?.subjects.length ?? 0;
  const groupLine = sub?.group_name
    ? `${groupEmoji(sub.group_name)} <b>${groupLabel(sub.group_name)}</b>`
    : '⚠️ غير محدد';

  const text = `✅ <b>تم التسجيل!</b>

📌 المرحلة: <b>${escapeHtml(sub?.stage ?? '')}</b>
👥 الكروب: ${groupLine}
📚 المواد: <b>${subjectCount > 0 ? `${subjectCount} مادة` : 'الكل'}</b>

من الآن، سأخبرك بالجديد المناسب لك مباشرة. 🎯

استخدم الأزرار بالأسفل للتنقل.`;

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'تم التسجيل بنجاح!');
  await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, text, {
    reply_markup: { inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '🌐 افتح المنصة', url: baseUrl }]] },
  });

  // بعد لحظة، أرسل الـReply Keyboard
  if (wasOnboarding) {
    setTimeout(() => {
      void sendMessage(chatId, '👇 <b>قائمتك الجديدة:</b>', {
        reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
      });
    }, 800);
  }
}

// ==================== /help ====================
export async function sendHelp(chatId: number, baseUrl: string): Promise<void> {
  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push('🧭 <b>قائمة الأوامر</b>');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('<b>⚙️ للمشتركين</b>');
  lines.push('<code>/start</code> — التسجيل / تعديل الإعدادات');
  lines.push('<code>/settings</code> — الإشعارات والكروب');
  lines.push('<code>/streak</code> — سلسلة أيامك');
  lines.push('<code>/ask</code> — إرسال استفسار للإدارة');
  lines.push('<code>/stop</code> — إلغاء الاشتراك');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push('💡 يمكنك أيضاً استخدام الأزرار بالأسفل 👇');
  lines.push('');
  lines.push(`<a href="${baseUrl}">🌐 افتح المنصة</a>`);

  await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'), {
    reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
  });
}

// ==================== /streak ====================
export async function sendStreak(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);
  if (!sub || !sub.stage) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, `أنت غير مشترك بعد.\nاكتب /start للتسجيل.`);
    return;
  }

  const streak = sub.streak_count ?? 0;
  const total = sub.total_opens ?? 0;

  const badges: string[] = [];
  if (total >= 1) badges.push('🌱 بداية الرحلة');
  if (total >= 10) badges.push('📚 قارئ');
  if (total >= 50) badges.push('💪 مذاكر جدي');
  if (total >= 100) badges.push('🏆 أسطورة');
  if (streak >= 3) badges.push(`🔥 ${streak} أيام متتالية`);
  if (streak >= 7) badges.push('⚡ أسبوع كامل');
  if (streak >= 30) badges.push('👑 شهر كامل');

  const lines: string[] = [];
  lines.push(`🔥 <b>سلسلتك</b>\n`);
  lines.push(`📅 <b>${streak}</b> ${streak === 1 ? 'يوم متتالي' : 'أيام متتالية'}`);
  lines.push(`📖 <b>${total}</b> ملزمة فتحتها من البوت`);

  if (badges.length > 0) {
    lines.push('\n<b>شاراتك:</b>');
    badges.forEach((b) => lines.push(b));
  } else {
    lines.push('\n💡 افتح ملزمة اليوم لتبدأ سلسلتك!');
  }

  await sendMessage(chatId, lines.join('\n'), {
    reply_markup: STUDENT_MENU,
  });
}

// ==================== /settings ====================
export async function sendSettings(
  chatId: number,
  messageId?: number,
): Promise<void> {
  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);
  if (!sub || !sub.stage) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, `اكتب /start للتسجيل أولاً.`);
    return;
  }

  const groupLine = sub.group_name
    ? `${groupEmoji(sub.group_name)} <b>${groupLabel(sub.group_name)}</b>`
    : '⚠️ <i>لم تُحدد بعد</i>';

  const text = `⚙️ <b>الإعدادات</b>

المرحلة: <b>${escapeHtml(sub.stage)}</b>
الكروب: ${groupLine}
المواد: <b>${sub.subjects.length > 0 ? sub.subjects.length : 'الكل'}</b>

اختر ما تريد استقباله:`;

  const check = (v: boolean) => (v ? '✅' : '⬜');

  const keyboard: InlineKeyboardMarkup = {
    inline_keyboard: [
      [
        { text: `${check(sub.notify_new_note)} ملزمة جديدة`, callback_data: 'tog:new_note' },
        { text: `${check(sub.notify_morning)} موجز صباحي`, callback_data: 'tog:morning' },
      ],
      [
        { text: `${check(sub.notify_streak)} تنبيه الستريك`, callback_data: 'tog:streak' },
        { text: `${check(sub.notify_weekly)} ملخص أسبوعي`, callback_data: 'tog:weekly' },
      ],
      [
        { text: `${check(sub.notify_trending)} محتوى رائج`, callback_data: 'tog:trending' },
      ],
      [
        { text: `${check(sub.notify_announcements)} 📢 تبليغات إدارية`, callback_data: 'tog:announcements' },
      ],
      [
        { text: '👥 تغيير الكروب', callback_data: 'settings:group' },
        { text: '📚 تغيير المواد', callback_data: 'settings:subjects' },
      ],
      [{ text: '🔄 تغيير المرحلة', callback_data: 'settings:stage' }],
    ],
  };

  if (messageId) {
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, text, { reply_markup: keyboard });
  } else {
    await sendMessage(chatId, text, { reply_markup: keyboard });
  }
}

// ==================== Toggle Notification ====================
const TOGGLE_MAP: Record<string, NotifyToggleKey> = {
  new_note: 'notify_new_note',
  morning: 'notify_morning',
  streak: 'notify_streak',
  weekly: 'notify_weekly',
  trending: 'notify_trending',
  announcements: 'notify_announcements',
};

export async function handleToggleNotification(
  cb: TelegramCallbackQuery,
  key: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!cb.message) return;
  const chatId = cb.message.chat.id;
  const messageId = cb.message.message_id;

  const column = TOGGLE_MAP[key];
  if (!column) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'خيار غير معروف');
    return;
  }

  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);
  if (!sub) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'حدث خطأ');
    return;
  }

  const current = sub[column] as boolean;
  await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, { [column]: !current } as Partial<Subscriber>);

  await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, !current ? 'تم التفعيل' : 'تم الإلغاء');
  await sendSettings(chatId, messageId);
}

// ==================== Settings Navigation ====================
export async function handleSettingsNavigation(
  cb: TelegramCallbackQuery,
  action: string,
): Promise<void> {
  if (!cb.message) return;
  const chatId = cb.message.chat.id;
  const messageId = cb.message.message_id;

  const sub = await getSubscriber(chatId);
  if (!sub || !sub.stage) {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'حدد المرحلة أولاً');
    return;
  }

  if (action === 'stage') {
    await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, { onboarding_step: 'choosing_stage' });
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
    await editMessageText(chatId, messageId, 'اختر مرحلتك:', {
      reply_markup: stageKeyboard(),
    });
    return;
  }

  if (action === 'group') {
    await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, {
      onboarding_step: 'choosing_group_from_settings',
    });
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
    await editMessageText(
      chatId,
      messageId,
      `📚 <b>${escapeHtml(sub.stage)}</b>\n\nاختر كروبك الجديد:`,
      { reply_markup: groupKeyboard() },
    );
    return;
  }

  if (action === 'subjects') {
    await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, { onboarding_step: 'choosing_subjects' });
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
    await sendSubjectsKeyboard(chatId, messageId, sub.stage);
    return;
  }

  if (action === 'show') {
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id);
    await sendSettings(chatId);
    return;
  }

  if (action === 'restart') {
    await upsertSubscriber(cb.from, {
      stage: null,
      group_name: null,
      subjects: [],
      onboarding_step: 'choosing_stage',
    });
    await answerCallbackQuery(cb.id, 'اختر مرحلتك من جديد');
    await editMessageText(
      chatId,
      messageId,
      '🔄 <b>إعادة التسجيل</b>\n\nاختر مرحلتك الدراسية:',
      { reply_markup: stageKeyboard() },
    );
    return;
  }
}

// ==================== /stop ====================
export async function handleStop(chatId: number): Promise<void> {
  const { deleteSubscriber } = await import('../subscribers');
  await deleteSubscriber(chatId);

  await sendMessage(
    chatId,
    `👋 <b>تم إلغاء اشتراكك</b>\n\nلن تصلك إشعارات بعد الآن.\nيمكنك العودة في أي وقت بـ /start`,
    { reply_markup: { remove_keyboard: true } },
  );
}

// ==================== Menu Buttons ====================
/**
 * يتعامل مع أزرار الـReply Keyboard الخاصة بالطالب.
 * يُرجع true إذا تعامل مع الزر، false إذا لا.
 */
export async function handleStudentMenuButton(
  chatId: number,
  text: string,
  baseUrl: string,
): Promise<boolean> {
  if (text === STUDENT_MENU_TEXTS.lawazem) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, `📚 <b>الملازم</b>\n\nاضغط الزر لفتحها:`, {
      reply_markup: {
        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '🌐 فتح الملازم', url: `${baseUrl}/lawazem` }]],
      },
    });
    return true;
  }

  if (text === STUDENT_MENU_TEXTS.dictionary) {
    await sendMessage(chatId, `🔍 <b>القاموس الطبي</b>\n\nاضغط الزر لفتحه:`, {
      reply_markup: {
        inline_keyboard: [[{ text: '🌐 فتح القاموس', url: `${baseUrl}/dictionary` }]],
      },
    });
    return true;
  }

  if (text === STUDENT_MENU_TEXTS.streak) {
    await sendStreak(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === STUDENT_MENU_TEXTS.settings) {
    await sendSettings(chatId);
    return true;
  }

  if (text === STUDENT_MENU_TEXTS.help) {
    await sendHelp(chatId, baseUrl);
    return true;
  }

  // 📮 استفسار → يُعالج في inquiries.ts
  return false;
}

```js
// public/sw.js
// Service Worker — لوازم
// استراتيجية: Network-first مع Cache fallback
// لا يخزّن: /api/ ولا Supabase ولا الطلبات غير GET

const CACHE_NAME = 'lawazem-v1';
const MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES = 60;

// ==================== Install ====================
self.addEventListener('install', () => {
  // تفعيل النسخة الجديدة فوراً بدل انتظار إغلاق كل التبويبات
  self.skipWaiting();
});

// ==================== Activate ====================
self.addEventListener('activate', (event) => {
  event.waitUntil(
    (async () => {
      // احذف كل الـcaches القديمة
      const keys = await caches.keys();
      await Promise.all(
        keys
          .filter((key) => key !== CACHE_NAME)
          .map((key) => caches.delete(key))
      );
      // تولّى السيطرة على كل التبويبات المفتوحة
      await self.clients.claim();
    })()
  );
});

// ==================== Fetch ====================
self.addEventListener('fetch', (event) => {
  const { request } = event;

  // تجاهل غير GET
  if (request.method !== 'GET') return;

  const url = new URL(request.url);

  // تجاهل كل الطلبات خارج الأصل (Supabase, Groq, ...)
  if (url.origin !== self.location.origin) return;

  // تجاهل API (محتوى حيّ)
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/api/')) return;

  // تجاهل طلبات Next.js dev/HMR (لو صار تشغيل محلي)
  if (url.pathname.startsWith('/_next/webpack-hmr')) return;

  event.respondWith(handleRequest(request));
});

// ==================== Handler ====================
async function handleRequest(request) {
  const cache = await caches.open(CACHE_NAME);

  try {
    // 1. جرّب الشبكة أولاً
    const response = await fetch(request);

    // خزّن فقط الاستجابات الناجحة
    if (response.ok && response.type === 'basic') {
      // نحفظ نسخة قبل ما نرجّع الأصل
      const clone = response.clone();
      cache.put(request, clone).catch(() => {});
      // نظّف cache لو كبر أكثر من اللازم
      trimCache(cache).catch(() => {});
    }

    return response;
  } catch {
    // 2. لو الشبكة فشلت، جرّب الـcache
    const cached = await cache.match(request);
    if (cached) return cached;

    // 3. لو ما فيه cache — جرّب الصفحة الرئيسية
    //    (تُخزَّن بعد أول زيارة ناجحة)
    const home = await cache.match('/');
    if (home) return home;

    // 4. لا شيء متاح — أرجِع صفحة offline بسيطة
    return new Response(offlinePage(), {
      status: 503,
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'text/html; charset=utf-8' },
    });
  }
}

// ==================== Trim Cache ====================
async function trimCache(cache) {
  const keys = await cache.keys();
  if (keys.length <= MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES) return;
  // احذف الأقدم (ترتيب الإدراج مضمون في Cache API)
  const toDelete = keys.slice(0, keys.length - MAX_CACHE_ENTRIES);
  await Promise.all(toDelete.map((key) => cache.delete(key)));
}

// ==================== Offline Fallback ====================
function offlinePage() {
  return `<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ar" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <title>لا يوجد اتصال — لوازم</title>
  <style>
    body {
      margin: 0;
      font-family: system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      background: #F7F6F2;
      color: #1A211F;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 100vh;
      padding: 24px;
      text-align: center;
    }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      body { background: #131918; color: #ECEFEE; }
      .card { background: #1B2220 !important; border-color: #2C3635 !important; }
    }
    .card {
      background: #FFFFFF;
      border: 1px solid #E4E0D6;
      border-radius: 24px;
      padding: 40px 24px;
      max-width: 380px;
      width: 100%;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 30px rgba(26,33,31,0.06);
    }
    .icon {
      width: 64px;
      height: 64px;
      margin: 0 auto 20px;
      background: rgba(14,74,74,0.10);
      border-radius: 20px;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      color: #0E4A4A;
    }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      .icon { background: rgba(77,184,184,0.20); color: #4DB8B8; }
    }
    h1 {
      font-size: 20px;
      font-weight: 900;
      margin: 0 0 8px;
    }
    p {
      font-size: 14px;
      line-height: 1.6;
      opacity: 0.6;
      margin: 0 0 20px;
    }
    button {
      background: #0E4A4A;
      color: #FFFFFF;
      border: 0;
      border-radius: 12px;
      padding: 12px 24px;
      font-size: 14px;
      font-weight: 700;
      cursor: pointer;
      width: 100%;
    }
    @media (prefers-color-scheme: dark) {
      button { background: #4DB8B8; color: #131918; }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="card">
    <div class="icon">
      <svg width="32" height="32" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round">
        <path d="M18.364 5.636a9 9 0 010 12.728m0 0l-2.829-2.829m2.829 2.829L21 21M15.536 8.464a5 5 0 010 7.072m0 0l-2.829-2.829m-4.243 2.829a4.978 4.978 0 01-1.414-2.83m-1.414 5.658a9 9 0 01-2.167-9.238m7.824 2.167a1 1 0 111.414 1.414m-1.414-1.414L3 3m8.293 8.293l1.414 1.414"/>
      </svg>
    </div>
    <h1>لا يوجد اتصال بالإنترنت</h1>
    <p>تحقق من اتصالك وحاول مرة ثانية. المحتوى الذي زرته مؤخراً قد يكون متاحاً في الـcache.</p>
    <button onclick="window.location.reload()">أعد المحاولة</button>
  </div>
</body>
</html>`;
}

# Anatomy model attribution

`head-neck.glb` is a simplified subset (head, neck, skull, cervical vertebrae, head and neck muscles) adapted from:

- BodyParts3D, © The Database Center for Life Science, licensed under CC BY-SA 2.1 Japan (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/2.1/jp/) and CC BY 4.0 (https://dbarchive.biosciencedbc.jp/en/bodyparts3d/lic.html).
- Z-Anatomy by Gauthier Kervyn, licensed under CC BY-SA 4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), for the facial muscles.
- Mesh selection and packaging via BodyExplorer by Johan Bellander (MIT): https://github.com/JohanBellander/BodyExplorer

Adaptations: axes converted (millimetres, Z-up to 100 mm units, Y-up), meshes welded, decimated with meshoptimizer, normals recomputed, selection limited to the head and neck.

This adapted model file is distributed under CC BY-SA 4.0. The application source code is not affected by this licence.
